2610.12707.result_en: Verifier-minted pairs reduce caption hallucination by 5.1 CHAIR points and raise image-generation pass rate by 5.4, while reward-benchmark scores worsen.
2610.12707.boundary_en: Included for verifier-driven reward adaptation and the benchmark–policy mismatch. One bootstrap turn does not prove indefinitely reliable co-evolution.
2610.12707.abstract_zh: 视觉—语言奖励模型通常在昂贵、可能意见不一致的标注偏好对上训练，并按基准准确率排名。我们无需人类偏好标签构建奖励模型：在冻结 Qwen3-VL 的中间层加入线性头，训练其把网页图像描述排在同一描述的扰动版本之上；带标签数据只用于选择层。层选择是决定因素，比最后一层高 5.8 点。一个无需重新调优的配方在 32B 规模的三个基准上优于或至少匹配 GPT-4o，在 VL-RewardBench 上领先 6.6 点，仅用数千参数，计算量约为微调的千分之一。在相同配对预算下，扰动数据比精选 RLAIF-V 对使冻结主干上的头高 3–5 点。主干冻结使目标凸，而扰动采样器定义奖励，基准不能识别该奖励：在相同扰动的两个不相交子集上训练的头，在基准上持平，却在幻觉判断上相差 6.4 点。用策略自身、由验证器标记的候选重新训练头，使描述幻觉降低 5.1 个 CHAIR 点、图像生成通过率提高 5.4 点，尽管所有奖励基准分数更低。中间层探针、无需标注的同图扰动与验证器驱动的自举回合，共同构成无需标注者、成本远低于微调的多模态奖励建模配方；其定义来自训练比较，而非基准排名。

(a) Best-of- N N on 160 held-out hard compositional prompts: verifier pass rate of the image each selector picks from N N Qwen-Image samples (bands: 75% binomial intervals; paired differences against random at N = 12 N{=}12 in the text). (b) One prompt and each selector’s pick out of twelve, judged by the GenEval-style OWLv2 verifier ( Ghosh et al., 2023 ; Minderer et al., 2023 ) on object presence, count, colour and relative position. 2610.13166.title: Scaling Agentic Data for Long-Horizon Terminal Intelligence
2610.13166.authors: Shun Zou, Ziyu Ma, Yi Zou, Yong Wang, Lin Chen, Zehui Chen, Guanhua Chen, Xiangxiang Chu, Feng Zhao
2610.13166.abstract_en: Terminal agents are moving beyond local operations toward completing real-world professional tasks. Short trajectories can demonstrate commands and tool calls, but they do not fully show how agents accumulate evidence through exploration, use it to inform judgments, continually adjust strategies based on feedback, and turn intermediate results into final deliverables. High-quality long-horizon trajectories capture these agentic behavioral patterns and their connections within a single problem-solving process, providing richer experience for sustained autonomous work. However, environment synthesis may complete or simplify the key work underlying these patterns in advance and thus remove the need for exploration, implementation, and verification that the agent was meant to perform. To address this, we introduce TerminalHorizon, a fully automated data synthesis engine for long-horizon terminal agents. Starting from real-world professional work, it uses independent execution to identify key work omitted during construction and uses the resulting evidence to guide environment reconstruction. To extend these patterns across stages, it progressively expands tasks under the same goal, introducing new requirements that build on prior results and call for further exploration and improvement. Using this engine, we construct 1.5K task environments and perform supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5-27B on the resulting dataset to obtain TerminalHorizon-27B. We achieve substantial performance gains on all 12 benchmarks spanning coding-agent tasks, agentic tasks in real-world production settings, and general reasoning. Multiple RSI case studies, each with a 12-hour research budget, further demonstrate the model's ability to continue experimenting beyond an initial solution, improve its methods based on feedback, and retain effective improvements in its final deliverables.
2610.13166.affiliation: USTC / AMAP, Alibaba Group / Southern University of Science and Technology
2610.13166.update_target: Synthesized task environments and a terminal model trained on retained trajectories
2610.13166.mechanism_en: Independent execution identifies missing work and guides environment reconstruction; same-goal task expansion carries prior results into later stages and research feedback guides retained method improvements.
2610.13166.result_en: 1.5K environments train TerminalHorizon-27B; all 12 benchmarks improve, with additional RSI case studies using 12-hour research budgets.
2610.13166.boundary_en: Separate environment-synthesis feedback, one-time SFT, and task-level RSI case studies. The abstract gives no numerical benchmark headline.
2610.13166.abstract_zh: 终端智能体正从局部操作转向完成现实专业任务。短轨迹能演示命令和工具调用，却不能完整展示智能体如何通过探索积累证据、用证据形成判断、依据反馈持续调整策略，并把中间结果变成最终交付。高质量长周期轨迹在一个求解过程中连接这些行为模式，为持续自主工作提供更丰富经验。但环境合成可能提前完成或简化这些行为背后的关键工作，去掉智能体本应执行的探索、实现和验证。为此，我们提出 TerminalHorizon，一个面向长周期终端智能体的全自动数据合成引擎。从真实专业工作出发，通过独立执行识别构造时遗漏的关键工作，并用证据指导环境重建。为跨阶段扩展行为模式，在同一目标下逐步扩展任务，引入依赖此前结果、需要进一步探索和改善的新要求。我们构建 1.5K 个任务环境，并在所得数据上监督微调 Qwen3.5-27B，获得 TerminalHorizon-27B。它在涵盖代码智能体、真实生产智能体和通用推理的全部 12 个基准上取得显著收益。多个 RSI 案例研究分别采用 12 小时研究预算，进一步展示模型能在初始解之后继续实验，依据反馈改进方法，并在最终交付中保留有效改进。
2610.13166.image_caption: Figure 1: Motivation for TerminalHorizon. Short trajectories can teach agents to perform terminal operations, but not to autonomously complete complex, long-horizon tasks. Our long-horizon trajectories connect agentic behavioral patterns, such as exploration, strategy revision, and verification, into a complete autonomous problem-solving process.

2610.13272.title: OWLET: On-Policy Weighted Learning via Evidence Transfer for Video Large Language Model Post-Training
2610.13272.authors: Qitan Lv, Ke Fan, Hong Wang, Wen Wu, Yilin Wang, Bowen Zhou, Feng Wu, Chao Zhang
2610.13272.abstract_en: Post-training has become a key stage for eliciting reasoning capabilities in Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs). Existing post-training methods mainly follow two paradigms: reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD). However, they do not fully exploit visual evidence for effective training. RL supervises the policy with a single trajectory-level reward, which is too coarse-grained for video reasoning: the same response-level advantage is applied to every generated token, disregarding that the tokens of a video response are grounded in the visual stream to very different degrees. OPD provides token-level supervision through output-distribution matching, but lacks direct supervision of the spatiotemporal representations that produce those outputs. We observe across extensive experiments that the same model reasons more accurately when its video view combines global temporal context with question-relevant details. Comparing the same student-generated response under this view and uniform sampling reveals changes in token likelihoods and internal representations, providing a training signal for evidence use. Building on this observation, we propose OWLET, an evidence-privileged RL method that derives training signals from a richer teacher view. This view couples uniform global context with question-conditioned local windows, providing visual evidence without requiring a larger model. To better exploit this privileged visual evidence, OWLET introduces (i) \textbf{evidence-aware credit redistribution}, which compares token likelihoods across the two views and redistributes positive response-level advantages according to their relative evidence support; and (ii) \textbf{spatiotemporal state alignment}, which aligns the two views' hidden states on verifier-accepted responses.
2610.13272.affiliation: USTC / Shanghai AI Laboratory / Tsinghua University
2610.13272.update_target: Video-policy token credit and spatiotemporal representations
2610.13272.mechanism_en: The same student response is compared under uniform and evidence-rich views; relative token likelihood redistributes positive advantage and verifier-accepted responses receive hidden-state alignment.
2610.13272.result_en: The abstract reports more accurate reasoning with global-plus-question-local evidence, then specifies the two training mechanisms without a quantitative benchmark result.
2610.13272.boundary_en: This is an evidence-privileged self-supervision mechanism, not an autonomous repeated agent-evolution result. Do not invent missing performance numbers.
2610.13272.abstract_zh: 后训练已成为激发视频大语言模型推理能力的关键阶段。现有方法主要采用强化学习和在策略蒸馏，却没有充分利用视觉证据。RL 用单个轨迹级奖励监督策略，对视频推理过于粗糙：所有生成 token 使用相同响应级优势，忽略了它们扎根于视觉流的程度不同。在策略蒸馏通过输出分布匹配提供 token 级监督，却不直接监督产生输出的时空表示。我们在广泛实验中观察到，同一模型的视频视图兼具全局时间上下文与问题相关细节时，推理更准确。对同一学生生成响应，比较丰富视图与均匀采样下的 token 似然和内部表示变化，可获得证据使用的训练信号。我们提出 OWLET，一种从更丰富教师视图获得训练信号的证据特权 RL 方法。该视图结合均匀全局上下文和问题条件局部窗口，无需更大模型。为更好利用特权视觉证据，OWLET 引入两项机制：证据感知信用再分配，比较两种视图下的 token 似然，按相对证据支持重分配正响应级优势；时空状态对齐，在验证器接受的响应上对齐两种视图的隐藏状态。
2610.13272.image_caption: Figure 1: Illustration of how OWLET improves video reasoning through evidence-guided post-training. Uniform frame sampling misses the temporal transitions needed to answer the question, whereas OWLET learns from a correct evidence-privileged teacher.

2610.13886.title: X-AgentRed: Red-Teaming Personal Agents in Evolving Multi-Service Ecosystems
2610.13886.authors: Yeonsung Jung, Zhiyuan Wang, Zifan Wang, Vítor Albiero, Benjamin Newman, Edoardo Debenedetti, Ivan Evtimov, Ninareh Mehrabi
2610.13886.abstract_en: Personal agents increasingly connect to services across the web and applications by using tools. As the effects of their actions accumulate and interact across services, unintended or harmful outcomes can arise when agents fulfill benign user requests. Proactively identifying these compositional failures requires systematically exploring diverse cross-service paths. Existing red-teaming methods often simply prompt LLMs to identify potentially harmful paths from task and environment descriptions or decompose harmful objectives specified by humans or LLMs into seemingly benign action combinations. However, generation is biased toward patterns learned during training, potentially favoring familiar tool combinations and leaving novel cross-service interactions underexplored. To address this, we propose X-AgentRed, a self-evolving red-teaming framework that discovers harmful tool call paths through a graph of tool dependencies and expands and refines them using execution feedback. By analyzing each tool's effects, potential harms, and preconditions for execution, the red-teaming agent constructs a directed graph that captures how one tool's effects can satisfy another's execution preconditions. Recipes sampled from this graph are instantiated as realistic scenarios in which agents can produce harmful outcomes. Execution feedback enables self-improvement by diversifying paths that produce harm through tool substitution and refining preconditions at blocked steps in unsuccessful paths to enable further execution. Across four frontier agentic models, X-AgentRed achieves $1.77\times$ the harmful path rate of STAC and explores a more diverse set of tools, yielding $2.99\times$ the tool coverage on average.
2610.13886.affiliation: Meta Reality Labs Research / Meta Superintelligence Labs / Meta / FAIR at Meta
2610.13886.update_target: Tool-dependency graph recipes and adversarial path preconditions
2610.13886.mechanism_en: Execution feedback diversifies successful harmful paths through tool substitution and revises blocked preconditions in unsuccessful paths for further exploration.
2610.13886.result_en: Across four frontier agentic models, harmful-path rate is 1.77x STAC and mean tool coverage is 2.99x.
2610.13886.boundary_en: This evolves a red-teaming search mechanism, not the target agent’s weights. Generated coverage and observed harm require separate measurement.
2610.13886.abstract_zh: 个人智能体通过工具连接网页和应用的不同服务。动作效果累积并跨服务相互作用时，即使完成良性请求也可能产生意外或有害结果。主动识别组合失败需要系统探索多样跨服务路径。现有红队方法往往直接提示 LLM 从任务和环境描述中识别有害路径，或把人类或 LLM 指定的有害目标分解为看似良性的动作组合。但生成偏向训练中学到的模式，可能偏爱熟悉工具组合，遗漏新跨服务交互。我们提出 X-AgentRed，一个自进化红队框架，通过工具依赖图发现有害调用路径，并用执行反馈扩展和细化路径。红队智能体分析工具效果、潜在危害和执行前置条件，构建有向图，表示一个工具的效果如何满足另一工具的前置条件。从图采样的配方被实例化为可能导致有害结果的现实场景。执行反馈通过两种方式支持自改进：对产生危害的路径替换工具以增加多样性，对失败路径中的阻塞步骤细化前置条件以支持继续执行。对四个前沿智能体模型，X-AgentRed 的有害路径率为 STAC 的 1.77 倍，探索工具更多，平均工具覆盖率为其 2.99 倍。

2610.13991.title: Predict Before You Modify: Learning Improvement Dynamics for Self-Evolving Agents
2610.13991.authors: Zixuan Xie , Chang Xu , Yuhua Jiang , Li Zhao
2610.13991.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents improve through repeated cycles of modification and evaluation. However, existing methods receive feedback on modifications only after costly evaluations, and aggregate scores may obscure distinctions between failures that require different repairs. We introduce predictive self-evolution through an editable Improvement Dynamics Model (IDM). Before evaluation, the IDM predicts task-level outcomes of a proposed modification and guides an optional revision. After evaluation, past modifications and their observed outcomes are used to improve the IDM, allowing predictive knowledge to accumulate across generations. The system can thus improve how it solves tasks, proposes modifications, and predicts their effects. Building on HyperAgents, we evaluate this approach across multilingual coding, paper review, robotics reward design, and Olympiad-level mathematical grading. Our approach outperforms HyperAgents across all four domains, with up to 46% higher average performance over generations. Gains also persist under matched token budgets that include both agent evolution and task evaluation, and extend to held-out tasks. Forecast accuracy improves as the IDM evolves, and the learned predictive knowledge transfers to improve evolution in a new domain.
2610.13991.affiliation: University of Virginia / Microsoft Research / Tsinghua University
2610.13991.mechanism_en: Predict modification outcomes before evaluation; observed outcomes revise an editable predictor used by later generations.
2610.13991.result_en: Up to 46% higher average performance across four domains; gains survive matched total-token budgets and transfer.
2610.13991.boundary_en: Finite experiments support predictive improvement, not unbounded growth; prediction and selection costs belong in the budget.
2610.13991.abstract_zh: 自进化智能体通过反复修改和评估实现改进。但现有方法只有在昂贵评估之后才能获得修改反馈，汇总分数也可能掩盖需要不同修复的失败差异。我们提出基于可编辑改进动力学模型（IDM）的预测式自进化。评估前，IDM 预测修改对各任务的结果，并指导可选修订；评估后，历史修改及其观测结果用于改进 IDM，使预测知识跨代积累。因此，系统不仅改进任务求解，也改进修改提案及效果预测。我们基于 HyperAgents，在多语言编码、论文评审、机器人奖励设计和奥林匹克级数学评分上评估。方法在四个领域均优于 HyperAgents，跨代平均表现最高提高 46%。收益在同时计入智能体进化与任务评估的匹配 token 预算下仍成立，并扩展到留出任务。IDM 演化使预测准确率提高，学得的预测知识还能迁移，改善新领域的进化。

2610.14118.title: ClawLoop: Self-Improving Agents via Harness-Native Training Loop
2610.14118.authors: Hansi Yang , Linji Hao , Hongyan Hao , An Wang , Han Wu , Qi Gu , Xunliang Cai
2610.14118.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has driven their deployment toward general-purpose harness environments, where LLM-based agents operate in sandbox workspaces and interact directly with file systems and shells. While numerous post-training pipelines exist for tool-use agents, their counterparts for harness-based agents remain scarce and are predominantly one-shot and teacher-dependent: a stronger external model synthesizes tasks and collects trajectories, the target agent is trained once, and evaluation results are consumed by human researchers rather than fed back into the loop. Such pipelines are inherently bounded by the capability of the external model and the scope of human prior, leaving no room for self-improvement. To address these limitations, we propose ClawLoop, a framework that enables self-improving without any external teacher model and with minimal prior dependencies. ClawLoop composes three phases into a self-sustaining cycle: Task Synthesis, which generates a diverse pool of training tasks via two complementary construction routines, applies diagnosis-conditioned difficulty growth followed by both agent-free and agent-based task validation; Training, which updates the agent via SFT and/or RL; and Diagnosis and Feedback, which analyzes the agent's rollout behaviors to produce a capability analysis report that will be used as feedback for task synthesis in the next iteration. Using Qwen3.6-27B as the loop model, ClawLoop yields consistent improvements on SkillsBench, Claw-Eval-Live, and ClawGym-Bench. The iteratively refined tasks are further transferred to smaller-scale Qwen3.5-4B and 9B models with gains across all benchmarks, validating data quality independently of the loop model.
2610.14118.mechanism_en: Task validation, SFT/RL, and rollout diagnosis form a cycle; diagnosis guides difficulty and synthesis in the next iteration.
2610.14118.result_en: Qwen3.6-27B improves on three harness benchmarks; evolved tasks also benefit 4B/9B learners.
2610.14118.boundary_en: Teacher-free means no external teacher model; task validation and prior construction assumptions still matter.
2610.14118.abstract_zh: LLM 的迅速进展推动其进入通用运行框架环境，智能体在沙箱工作区直接操作文件系统和 shell。虽然工具智能体已有大量后训练流水线，面向此类运行框架的训练却稀少，且大多一次性、依赖教师：更强外部模型合成任务并收集轨迹，目标智能体仅训练一次，评估结果由人类研究者消费而不反馈入循环。这限制于外部模型能力及人类先验范围，缺少自改进空间。我们提出 ClawLoop，无需外部教师模型且仅依赖少量先验的自改进框架。它把三阶段组成自维持循环：任务合成通过两种互补构造方式产生多样任务，按诊断提升难度，并进行无需智能体和依赖智能体的双重验证；训练通过 SFT 和/或 RL 更新智能体；诊断与反馈分析 rollout 行为，生成能力报告，指导下一轮任务合成。以 Qwen3.6-27B 为循环模型，ClawLoop 在 SkillsBench、Claw-Eval-Live、ClawGym-Bench 上持续提升。迭代细化的任务还能迁移至更小的 Qwen3.5-4B 和 9B，在所有基准上获益，独立于循环模型验证数据质量。

2610.14216.title: Cortex: Measurement-Gated Evolution and Pruning of Coding-Agent Skills and Rules
2610.14216.abstract_en: Coding agents such as Claude Code also follow text files that developers write for them: a project file, skills the agent may choose to open, and rules that load automatically when the agent reads matching files. We call these files the agent's harness. Developers add to it whenever they correct the agent, but one success proves little: the same agent can pass a task once and fail it the next time. We present Cortex, a tool that tests changes to the harness instead of trusting them. It saves fixes from the developer's sessions as replayable tasks, finds the corrections that recur, writes one skill or rule at a time, and keeps it only if repeated runs with and without it show a net gain and no task made noticeably worse. Existing text is tested the same way before it is deleted, and Cortex neither adds nor deletes text the agent never used. We tested Cortex with Claude Haiku 4.5 on a repository built for the purpose, with conventions the model tends to break, one area with nothing to learn, and a script playing the developer. On held-out tasks, the harnesses it built made the agent follow the conventions far more often than no skills or rules did, left the comparison area unchanged, and added no text read on every turn. Rules, which load automatically, did most of the work; skills helped only when offered with the files a task touches, and those offered on every turn were rarely opened. Cortex kept none of the useless or harmful suggestions we planted, but the agent never opened the useless ones or the harmful skills, and it reached no verdict on the harmful rules, so the test shows that Cortex keeps no unused text, not that it detects damage. Under the stronger Claude Sonnet 5 a single run's harness added little, and on a real open-source project, where the agent was rarely corrected, Cortex found nothing to learn. We release the tool, the lab and its data.
2610.14216.update_target: Coding-agent skills and automatically loaded rules
2610.14216.mechanism_en: Replay recurring developer corrections; paired repeated runs gate additions and pruning of text actually used.
2610.14216.result_en: Haiku benefits on held-out laboratory conventions; stronger-model and real-project gains are limited.
2610.14216.boundary_en: Unused harmful suggestions were not tested in action. Rejecting unused text does not demonstrate damage detection.
2610.14216.abstract_zh: Claude Code 等编码智能体也遵循开发者编写的项目文件、按需打开的技能，以及读取匹配文件时自动加载的规则。我们把这些文件称为运行框架。开发者常在纠正智能体后添加内容，但一次成功说明不了多少，同一智能体可能一次通过、下次失败。Cortex 测试框架变化，而非直接信任变化：把开发会话中的修复保存为可重放任务，发现重复纠正，每次编写一项技能或规则，仅在多次有无对照运行显示净收益且没有任务明显退化时保留。删除旧文本前也同样测试，不添加或删除智能体从未使用的文本。我们用 Claude Haiku 4.5 在专门构建的仓库评估，包含模型容易违反的约定、一个无须学习的区域及模拟开发者的脚本。留出任务上，生成的框架显著提高约定遵循，未改变对照区域，也没有添加每回合必读文本。自动加载的规则贡献最大；技能只有随任务涉及文件一起提供时才有用，每回合都提供的技能反而很少被打开。Cortex 未保留植入的无用或有害建议，但智能体从未打开无用建议和有害技能，对有害规则也未作结论，因此测试证明的是不保留未使用文本，而非能检测伤害。对更强 Claude Sonnet 5，单次运行得到的框架收益很小；在纠正很少的真实开源项目上，Cortex 未发现可学内容。我们发布工具、实验环境及数据。

2610.14224.title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
2610.14224.authors: Ruiyao Xu , Yanfei Chen , Zhongying CuiZhu , Bhavana Dalvi Mishra , Yifei Ming , Han Yu , Rujun Han , Chen-Yu Lee , Tomas Pfister
2610.14224.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.14224.abstract_en: LLM agents' capabilities depend not only on their underlying models but also on their execution harnesses. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a promising approach to automatically evolve these harnesses. However, deploying RSI in open-world settings still faces two critical challenges. First, open-world tasks are typically unseen during the harness design phase and novel at test time, leaving no ground-truth verifiers to reliably guide online harness edits. Second, the RSI process remains highly task-specific and fails to generalize to novel scenarios. We introduce Harness^2, a plug-and-play, recursive agent harnessing framework that addresses these challenges through two connected levels of recursion. Task-level recursion refines the current task's harness using a contrastive Propose-Probe-Compose step that reliably guides edits without ground-truth verifiers, and can be scaled further via parallel or sequential recursion. Harnessing-level recursion then extracts experience from these edits to update a continual improvement harness, enabling the agent to better adapt to future tasks. Across three professional benchmarks and four model-harness configurations, a single step consistently improves GLM-5 and Gemini 3.5 Flash over their base harnesses, yielding gains of up to 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench, 4.5 points on JobBench, and 11.8 percentage points on LAB, with further gains as the task-level recursion budget increases.
2610.14224.affiliation: Google Cloud AI Research / Northwestern University
2610.14224.update_target: Task harness and a continual improvement harness
2610.14224.mechanism_en: Contrastive propose–probe–compose edits solve current tasks; experience updates the mechanism that adapts future harnesses.
2610.14224.result_en: Single-step gains reach 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench and 11.8 percentage points on LAB.
2610.14224.boundary_en: No ground-truth verifier is assumed; assess contrastive feedback reliability separately from final scores.
2610.14224.abstract_zh: LLM 智能体能力既取决于底层模型，也取决于执行框架。递归自改进有望自动演化框架，但开放世界部署有两个难点：设计阶段未见、测试时新颖的任务没有真实验证器来可靠指导在线编辑；改进过程也往往任务专用，难以泛化。我们提出即插即用的 Harness²，通过两个相连层级的递归解决这些问题。任务级递归用对比式“提出—探查—组合”步骤，在没有真实验证器时指导当前任务的框架编辑，并可通过并行或顺序递归进一步扩展。框架级递归从编辑中提炼经验，更新持续改进框架，使智能体更好适应未来任务。在三个专业基准、四种模型—框架配置上，单步就能持续改善 GLM-5 与 Gemini 3.5 Flash，相比基础框架在 WorkBuddy-Bench 最高提高 11.5 点、JobBench 提高 4.5 点、LAB 提高 11.8 个百分点，增加任务级递归预算还能继续获益。

2610.14495.title: Reels-RSI: Program-Level Self-Improvement for Code-Rendered Explainer Videos
2610.14495.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Graphics (cs.GR); Multimedia (cs.MM); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
2610.14495.abstract_en: Explainer videos -- a worked geometry problem, why the sky is blue, how a dynasty fell -- are usually one more target for pixel video generation. We argue they are a different kind of artifact: a program (script, storyboard and per-frame animation code) that a deterministic renderer turns into frames. A program can be read, diffed, tested and audited; pixels can only be watched. Reels-RSI is an open-source reel director for any agent harness; its self-improvement happens at the program level rather than in weights or prompts. Every revision pass is logged with a code snapshot; a retrospective pairs each check finding with the diff that fixed it and proposes lessons; a lesson that a static check can catch is compiled into a rule with a must-fail and a must-pass example, so the memory is unit-tested; and a rule learned today runs over everything made before it. A bounded, benchmark-gated step lets an agent rewrite the director's playbook, kept only when blind pairwise judgments on held-out topics prefer it; nothing enters memory without a human decision. Across 111 reels -- a field study, two playbook evolutions, a 2x2 memory ablation, a weaker director, a 48-reel learning curve and a judge-reliability study -- we find that the rule learned in the field caught four latent defects in frames authored before it existed and none after; that rules are an audit for a strong director (eight unguarded reels, no violation) and a guard for a weaker one (thirty violations unguarded versus five); that lessons shorten revision loops but do not compound or move the judge; and that the first rewrite's 11--1 verdict was a position bias in our vote design (judges pick the second-shown reel 62--81% of the time), masking scripts that traded thirteen facts for craft. We document four failure modes of the preference signal, which check caught each, and the fixes. Code, rules, lessons and data are public.
2610.14495.update_target: Program rules, lessons, and a human-approved director playbook
2610.14495.mechanism_en: Check-to-diff retrospectives yield unit-tested rules; held-out blind comparisons gate bounded playbook rewrites.
2610.14495.result_en: 111 reels expose rule benefits, limited lesson compounding, and a position-biased 11–1 rewrite verdict.
2610.14495.boundary_en: Memory admission requires human decisions. Preference gains can reflect order bias and factual losses.
2610.14495.abstract_zh: 讲解视频，如几何解题、天空为何是蓝色或王朝如何衰落，通常被当作像素视频生成目标。我们认为它们是另一类产物：由脚本、分镜和逐帧动画代码组成、经确定性渲染器生成画面的程序。程序可读取、比较差异、测试和审计，像素只能观看。Reels-RSI 是适用于任意智能体框架的开源短视频导演，其自改进发生在程序层，而非权重或提示层。每轮修订保存代码快照；回顾把检查发现与修复差异配对并提出经验；能被静态检查捕获的经验被编译为含必失败、必通过样例的规则，从而对记忆做单元测试；新规则还追溯检查旧视频。受预算和基准约束的步骤允许改写导演手册，只有留出主题的盲配对判断更偏好新版才保留；任何记忆进入都需人类决定。在 111 个视频中，我们开展实地研究、两次手册进化、2×2 记忆消融、弱导演、48 视频学习曲线和评委可靠性研究。实地规则发现四个产生于规则之前的潜在画面缺陷，之后没有；规则对强导演主要用于审计（八个无护栏视频零违规），对弱导演则提供保护（无护栏三十次违规，有护栏五次）。经验缩短修订循环，却未复利增长或改变评委判断。第一次改写的 11–1 优势其实来自投票位置偏差：评委有 62%–81% 概率选后展示的视频，掩盖了脚本用十三项事实换取表现手法的问题。我们记录偏好信号四类失败、发现它们的检查及修复。代码、规则、经验和数据公开。

2610.14515.title: SEPM: Self-Evolving Procedural Memory Grounded in Task Graphs for Multi-Agent Collaboration
2610.14515.authors: Yi Liu , Junwei Zhao , Li Sun , Jiansong Zhang , Sen Su
2610.14515.abstract_en: Long-horizon multi-agent collaboration requires memory that preserves both successful actions and the coordination structure underlying them. Existing memory systems support information sharing or procedural reuse, but often leave the evolution of shared procedures disconnected from the task dependencies and execution states of collaborating agents. This coupling also limits the direct transfer of procedural memory designed for individual agents to team settings. We propose Self-Evolving Procedural Memory (SEPM), a framework that uses task dependency graphs as a common representation for online coordination and procedural memory evolution. During execution, a lightweight shared blackboard records structured evidence alongside task dependencies, supporting the detection of goal, plan, and world-state divergence and evidence-based realignment. After execution, verified actions and dependencies are distilled into reusable procedures, while recurring failures inform warnings and constraints. The shared procedure pool evolves through creation, refinement, specialization, and retirement, guided by success and cost utility and constrained by evidence and safety requirements. Together, these mechanisms preserve the collaborative structure and applicability conditions needed to reuse experience across tasks. Evaluations on ALFWorld, WebArena, and OfficeBench under AutoGen and DyLAN show that SEPM achieves the highest task scores among the compared methods in all six benchmark settings. Under AutoGen, it improves task scores over the no-added-memory baseline by 29.85, 25.86, and 13.00 percentage points, respectively. The codebase is available at this https URL .
2610.14515.affiliation: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications / China Telecom
2610.14515.update_target: Shared procedural memory with applicability conditions
2610.14515.mechanism_en: Task-graph evidence becomes reusable procedures; success/cost utility governs creation, refinement, specialization, and retirement.
2610.14515.result_en: AutoGen task-score gains over no added memory are 29.85/25.86/13.00 percentage points.
2610.14515.boundary_en: External procedural evolution is distinct from weight learning; coordination and safety constraints bound reuse.
2610.14515.abstract_zh: 长周期多智能体协作需要记忆同时保留成功行动及其协作结构。现有系统支持信息共享或过程复用，但共享过程的演化往往与任务依赖及各智能体执行状态脱节，这也限制单智能体过程记忆向团队迁移。我们提出 SEPM，以任务依赖图统一在线协作与过程记忆演化。执行中，轻量共享黑板结合任务依赖保存结构化证据，用于检测目标、计划和世界状态偏离，并据证据重新对齐。执行后，经验证的动作与依赖被蒸馏为可复用过程，重复失败转化为警告和约束。共享过程池依成功与成本效用创建、细化、专门化和退役，并受证据与安全要求约束，从而保留跨任务复用所需的协作结构和适用条件。在 AutoGen、DyLAN 下的 ALFWorld、WebArena、OfficeBench 六种设置中，SEPM 任务分数均为被比较方法最高；AutoGen 下，相比未增加记忆的基线分别提高 29.85、25.86、13.00 个百分点。代码见原摘要所附链接。

2610.14625.title: From Existing Methods to New Research Ideas: Two Perspectives on Recursive Self-Improvement
2610.14625.authors: Leijun Zhou , Yanke Yu , Zhihao Liu , Qu Xiang , Tiancheng Hu , Yiru Dong , Yihan Wu , Yangxi Xiang , Xuejun Wu , Xi Chen , Buyue Qian , Yaowei Zheng , Junhao Hu
2610.14625.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a route to AI systems that participate in their own continued development. Recent methods allow language agents to retain changes to their parameters, memory, skills, and code for subsequent execution and improvement. We examine how these methods can inform new research ideas through two complementary perspectives. First, we introduce a unified taxonomy with nine design dimensions organized into four groups: update targets, update organization, update schedule and scope, feedback and selection. This taxonomy places existing methods in a shared design space, where examining individual dimensions and their interactions can inspire new research ideas. Second, we examine how existing RSI methods draw on traditional deep learning, for example through optimization, regularization, data augmentation, continual learning, and adversarial learning. We develop further ideas by examining more specific learning mechanisms and drawing on evolutionary computation. We also review how existing benchmarks assess self-improvement under online, offline, and offline-to-online settings. Together, these perspectives help researchers develop new RSI research ideas from existing designs and learning mechanisms. RSI papers and resources are available at this https URL .
2610.14625.affiliation: PrismShadow / Peking University / Zhejiang University / New York University
2610.14625.update_target: A taxonomy and research-design analysis of RSI
2610.14625.mechanism_en: Nine dimensions organize update targets, organization, timing/scope, and feedback/selection; traditional learning mechanisms provide comparisons.
2610.14625.result_en: The paper synthesizes designs and online/offline evaluation settings rather than reporting a new empirical system.
2610.14625.boundary_en: Treat suggested research mechanisms as proposals, not demonstrated improvements.
2610.14625.abstract_zh: 递归自改进使 AI 系统有机会参与自身持续发展。近期方法让语言智能体保留对参数、记忆、技能和代码的修改，用于后续执行与改进。我们从两个互补视角研究如何利用这些方法产生新研究想法。首先，提出包含九个设计维度的统一分类，组织为更新对象、更新组织、更新时间与范围、反馈与选择四组。它把已有方法置于共同设计空间，研究各维度及相互作用可启发新想法。其次，考察已有 RSI 方法如何利用优化、正则化、数据增强、持续学习和对抗学习等传统深度学习机制，并结合更具体学习机制及进化计算发展进一步想法。我们还回顾基准如何在在线、离线、离线到在线设置中评估自改进。这些视角帮助研究者从现有设计与学习机制发展新 RSI 想法。论文和资源见原摘要所附链接。

2610.14662.title: Does Failure Feedback Direct Agent Self-Modification?
2610.14662.abstract_en: Self-improving agents use failure feedback to revise their code or instructions, but gains after selection do not establish target-specific repair or generalization. We measure directedness by comparing repair of a randomly selected target failure with repair of the parent's other failures. Across 145 eligible modifications in public Darwin Gödel Machine logs, we find no detectable target-specific advantage. Controlled instruction-revision experiments with small open models show that relevant feedback can improve target repair. In a second study with a pre-specified analysis plan, target feedback raised repair by 20 percentage points for Qwen3-4B relative to matched same-category feedback; the 7-point increase for Phi-4-mini was not significant. Target repair did not reliably imply held-out improvement. Held-out gains were concentrated in settings with identifiable, repairable failure mechanisms, including planted errors and natural tool-interface failures. Benefits of edit localization and regression screening varied across settings, while eight-step revision loops and GEPA ended at similar mean held-out accuracy. Evaluations should report target repair, transfer to related failures, and held-out net change separately.
2610.14662.update_target: Directed repair versus selection and held-out generalization
2610.14662.mechanism_en: Compare target failure repair with other failures, matched-category feedback, and held-out net change.
2610.14662.result_en: 145 DGM modifications show no detectable target advantage; Qwen3-4B gains 20 repair points in a controlled study.
2610.14662.boundary_en: Target repair does not reliably imply held-out gain; the Phi-4-mini increase is not significant.
2610.14662.abstract_zh: 自改进智能体使用失败反馈修改代码或指令，但选择后的收益不能证明针对性修复或泛化。我们通过比较随机选定目标失败的修复率与父版本其他失败的修复率，测量定向性。在公开 Darwin Gödel Machine 日志的 145 个合格修改中，未检测出目标专有优势。小型开放模型的受控指令修订实验表明，相关反馈可以改善目标修复。在第二项预先规定分析方案的研究中，相比匹配的同类别反馈，目标反馈使 Qwen3-4B 修复率提高 20 个百分点；Phi-4-mini 的 7 点提高不显著。目标修复并不可靠地意味着留出提升。留出收益集中在存在可识别、可修复机制的设置，包括植入错误和自然工具接口失败。编辑定位与回归筛查的收益随设置变化，八步修订循环与 GEPA 的最终平均留出准确率相近。评估应分别报告目标修复、相关失败迁移和留出净变化。

2610.14683.title: Triage-PiEvo: Evidence Admission for Principle-Evolving Scientific Agents
2610.14683.authors: Peize Li , Yingming Pu , Xingguo Xu , Yiming Cui , Yuansheng Gao , Tao Lin
2610.14683.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based AI Scientists advance scientific discovery, yet they suffer from inefficiencies due to noisy observations. Existing principle-evolving agents act on every anomaly, leaving its source unresolved: a new mechanism or an evaluation artifact, so invalid revisions bias evolution. To address this, we formulate revision as evidence admission: anomalies steer search immediately, but only independently verified evidence may rewrite persistent principles, and contradicted principles are retracted. We realize this in TRIAGE-PIEVO , which pairs an anomaly-responsive search portfolio with a staged verification gate that alone controls what enters principle state. Across four scientific tasks with three backbones, TRIAGE-PIEVO (1) attains the highest average solution quality with +7.5%~11.8% over the strongest baseline per backbone, matching the strongest baseline's full-budget quality with one-third of the evaluation budget on Qwen3-235B; and additional stress tests and cross-harness deployment demonstrate that (2) in constructed stress tests, it admits none of the corrupted, hidden-source, or exploit evidence that ungated variants admit, while missing no planted mechanism, and (3) plugged unchanged into three external research harnesses, it cuts false evidence admissions by over 60% and raises verified scores by 31%~43%.
2610.14683.affiliation: Westlake University / Kuaishou Technology / Zhejiang University / Dalian University of Technology / Hangzhou Dianzi University
2610.14683.update_target: Persistent scientific principles and search allocation
2610.14683.mechanism_en: Anomalies guide search, but only independently verified evidence changes principles; contradicted principles retract.
2610.14683.result_en: Solution-quality gains are 7.5–11.8%; external-harness false admissions fall over 60%.
2610.14683.boundary_en: Constructed stress tests and cross-harness transfer are different evidence; anomaly detection alone is not admission.
2610.14683.abstract_zh: LLM 科研智能体推动科学发现，却受噪声观测拖累。现有原理演化智能体对每个异常作出反应，却未厘清它来自新机制还是评估伪象，导致无效修订使演化偏移。我们把修订表述为证据准入：异常可以立即引导搜索，但只有独立验证的证据可改写持久原理，被反驳的原理则撤回。TRIAGE-PIEVO 将响应异常的搜索组合与分阶段验证门相结合，后者独占控制哪些内容进入原理状态。在四项科学任务、三个主干上，它的平均解质量最高，相比各主干最强基线提高 7.5%–11.8%；Qwen3-235B 仅用三分之一评估预算就匹配最强基线的完整预算质量。构造的压力测试中，它不接纳无门控变体会接纳的损坏、隐藏来源或利用型证据，同时没有漏掉植入机制。原样接入三个外部研究框架后，错误证据接纳减少超过 60%，验证分数提高 31%–43%。

2610.14977.title: EnactOpt: Diagnosis-Guided Harness Evolution for Embodied Agents
2610.14977.authors: ZhiYuan Feng , Zhuoshi Pan , Zhaolu Kang , Zhongxia Chen , Shuo Yang , Sen Ye , Heng Wang , Han Li
2610.14977.abstract_en: Embodied agents built on foundation models rely on an execution harness to organize observations, guide actions, and incorporate execution feedback into subsequent decisions. Failures can arise not only from limited model capabilities, but also from how the harness presents evidence and guides its use. These model-external mechanisms provide an adaptation target without updating model parameters, but task-specific interaction experience can be costly to collect. Task-level outcomes alone do not reveal whether relevant evidence was missing from the model input or was available but inadequately used. Moreover, these two aspects are coupled: effective action guidance may require evidence that the current context omits, while exposing that evidence alone does not ensure an appropriate response. We introduce EnactOpt, which uses limited execution feedback to jointly evolve reusable textual skills and context-construction code while keeping the underlying models and runtime fixed. It diagnoses adjacent decisions by relating action feedback to the actual model input and subsequent action. Structured episode summaries guide joint revisions through prompt-level edit operators, and candidate harnesses undergo compatibility checks and validation-based retention. Across VLABench, ALFWorld, and Embodied Agent Interface (EAI), EnactOpt improves task success by approximately 10-27 percentage points over the initial harnesses and outperforms the evaluated GEPA, TextGrad, and Trace2Skill baselines. These gains extend to task conditions not used for harness evolution or candidate selection. The results support a complementary route to embodied adaptation: turning limited execution experience into reusable behavioral improvements by jointly refining how evidence is presented and acted upon.
2610.14977.affiliation: Tsinghua University / Peking University / Kling AI / University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
2610.14977.update_target: Reusable text skills and context-construction code
2610.14977.mechanism_en: Diagnose feedback against actual inputs/actions; jointly revise components and retain compatible validation improvements.
2610.14977.result_en: Success rises approximately 10–27 percentage points across three embodied benchmarks, with held-out-condition transfer.
2610.14977.boundary_en: Models and runtime remain fixed; separate missing evidence from failure to use available evidence.
2610.14977.abstract_zh: 基于基础模型的具身智能体依靠执行框架组织观测、指导动作并把执行反馈纳入后续决策。失败不仅可能来自模型能力，也可能来自证据呈现和使用方式。这些模型外机制可在不更新参数时适配，但收集专用交互经验昂贵。任务结果本身不能揭示相关证据是未进入输入，还是已经可见却未被有效使用；两者又相互依赖：动作指导可能需要当前上下文遗漏的证据，单纯展示证据也不保证正确响应。EnactOpt 用有限执行反馈，联合演化可复用文本技能和上下文构造代码，保持模型与运行系统固定。它把相邻决策的动作反馈、真实模型输入及后续动作联系起来诊断，用结构化回合摘要和提示层编辑算子指导联合修订，候选经过兼容性检查和验证选择。在 VLABench、ALFWorld、EAI 上，任务成功率较初始框架约提高 10–27 个百分点，并优于比较的 GEPA、TextGrad、Trace2Skill。收益扩展到未参与演化或候选选择的任务条件。这支持通过联合改进证据呈现与行动方式，把少量执行经验变成可复用行为改进。

2610.15055.title: Trace Evolution Bench: Measuring Whether Agents Improve from Their Own Environment Traces
2610.15055.authors: Fangfei Li , Chenyang Zhao , Long Wang , Feng Tian , Lv Guo
2610.15055.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents are usually scored by endpoint Gain: held-out success after an update minus success before. That difference can credit a frozen rescore as evolution. We introduce Trace Evolution Bench (TEB), a protocol that separates that rescore from a context or weight update, together with three frozen 80/20/40 packs. An update is accepted only when validation does not fall, held-out identifiers never enter the update, and a text update is not ranked with a weight update. The primary scoreboard is coding, graded by hidden unit tests in a closed workspace. On that pack (40 held-out tasks, one family), DeepSeek v4 Pro under no_evolve never changes its policy yet moves 7.5, 5.0, and 12.5 percentage points across three seeds. Of nine text-update cells inspired by GEPA, ACE, and ExpeL, seven have positive excess above that seed's own band, and one gepa_llm seed moves down by the width of its band (-12.5, regression 0.48). GLM and MiniMax do not reproduce that seven-of-nine pattern. No method stays above its own band on every seed of all three models: GLM has two paired cells above their own bands, and MiniMax expel_llm seed 44 is a third (regression 0.30). The methods were fixed on a validation screen before held-out was read. Office, graded by rule-bounded delivery, and manufacturing table QA are separate packs: office DeepSeek does not exceed its own bands (widest 17.5 points), and manufacturing has no paired positive excess beyond its seed band.
2610.15055.update_target: Evaluation of trace-driven text or weight updates
2610.15055.mechanism_en: Frozen rescore controls establish seed bands; validation gates updates and held-out IDs stay outside training.
2610.15055.result_en: Frozen DeepSeek scores vary 5.0–12.5 points; no method exceeds its band on every seed/model.
2610.15055.boundary_en: Endpoint gain can be rescore noise. Text and weight updates are not a single interchangeable ranking.
2610.15055.abstract_zh: 自进化智能体通常按终点 Gain 评分，即更新后减更新前的留出成功率，但差值可能把冻结策略的重新评分误算为进化。我们提出 Trace Evolution Bench（TEB），将重新评分与上下文或权重更新分开，并提供三组冻结的 80/20/40 数据包。只有验证不下降、留出标识符不进入更新时才接纳更新，文本更新不与权重更新混排。主榜是在封闭工作区用隐藏单元测试评分的编码任务。在该包的四十个留出任务、一个家族上，DeepSeek v4 Pro 的 no_evolve 从不改策略，三个种子仍波动 7.5、5.0、12.5 个百分点。九个受 GEPA、ACE、ExpeL 启发的文本更新单元中，七个超过各自种子的波动带；一个 gepa_llm 种子下降一个带宽（−12.5，回归 0.48）。GLM 与 MiniMax 未复现七胜九的模式。没有方法在三个模型的每个种子上都超过自身波动带：GLM 有两个配对单元超过，MiniMax 的 expel_llm 种子 44 是第三个（回归 0.30）。方法在读取留出集前，已通过验证筛查固定。按规则约束交付评分的办公包、制造表格问答包另行评估：办公 DeepSeek 未超过自身波动带（最宽 17.5 点），制造包没有超过种子波动带的配对正收益。

2610.15150.title: Harmony Harness: Multi-Objective Self-Evolution of Agent Harnesses
2610.15150.authors: Weichen Yu , Lesly Miculicich , Bhavana Dalvi Mishra , Jiefeng Chen , Shuo Li , Matt Fredrikson , Tomas Pfister , Long T. Le
2610.15150.abstract_en: Recent work on self-evolving LLM agents treats the agent harness as an optimization target that can be iteratively improved through execution feedback. Existing approaches, however, largely optimize a single objective and evolve the harness as a monolithic artifact, limiting their ability to handle competing goals and to separate transferable design from environment-specific adaptation. We introduce Harmony Harness, a framework for multi-objective, compositional harness evolution. Harmony Harness formulates harness evolution as a multi-objective optimization problem and uses decomposition-based evolutionary search to maintain solutions across different regions of the Pareto frontier, avoiding reliance on a hand-designed structural diversity metric for repository-scale harnesses. In parallel, we introduce factorized evolution operators that separately refine general-purpose harness mechanisms and benchmark-specific adaptations, together with a dynamic composition workflow that integrates them at inference time. Across SecRepoBench and BaxBench, Harmony Harness consistently outperforms strong harness-evolution baselines, with gains exceeding 10% on both benchmarks. Our results show that explicitly modeling both objective trade-offs and harness structure yields substantially stronger and more transferable agent evolution than existing single-objective, monolithic approaches.
2610.15150.affiliation: Google Cloud AI Research / Google DeepMind / Carnegie Mellon University
2610.15150.mechanism_en: Decomposition-based Pareto search and factorized general/task operators evolve components composed at inference.
2610.15150.result_en: Reported gains exceed 10% on both SecRepoBench and BaxBench.
2610.15150.boundary_en: Tradeoff-frontier gains depend on objectives and composition; evaluate transferred general components separately.
2610.15150.abstract_zh: 近期自进化 LLM 智能体把运行框架视为可依执行反馈反复改善的目标，但通常只优化单一目标，并把框架作为整体演化，难以处理目标竞争及区分通用设计和环境专用适配。我们提出 Harmony Harness，用于多目标、组合式框架演化。它把框架演化表述为多目标优化，用基于分解的进化搜索，维护 Pareto 前沿不同区域的解，避免对仓库级框架手工设计结构多样性指标。同时，因子化进化算子分别细化通用框架机制和基准专用适配，再由动态组合工作流在推理时整合。在 SecRepoBench 与 BaxBench 上，它持续优于强框架进化基线，两个基准均获超过 10% 的收益。结果显示，同时显式建模目标权衡与框架结构，比现有单目标、整体式方法产生更强且更易迁移的进化。

2610.15221.title: HarnessNet: Feedback-driven Hierarchical Joint Harness Evolution for Multi-agent Systems
2610.15221.authors: Zhaoyuan Qiu , Sachith Seneviratne , Yu Xia , Saman Halgamuge
2610.15221.abstract_en: AI agents can evolve by using environment feedback to revise their harnesses, the software managing model inputs, tool use, memory, and execution, while keeping foundation models frozen. Existing studies focus on single agents, leaving joint harness evolution in multi-agent systems (MAS) underexplored. A single global optimizer faces growing context and workload as the system scales, while access restrictions may prevent sharing agent internals or system-wide feedback. We propose HarnessNet, a framework for hierarchical harness evolution in MAS. Its basic unit, Agentron, comprises an evolvable forward harness, a foundation model, and a local optimizer that can observe and modify only that harness. Agentrons form a layered graph through which environment feedback propagates backward, with upstream optimizers receiving node-specific feedback from the downstream layer. This decomposes joint harness evolution into smaller, coordinated tasks with separate contexts, reducing individual optimizers' context and workload while keeping access local. Optimizers need not access all agent trajectories or raw environment feedback. Experiments on AgentBench with multiple foundation models demonstrate the feasibility of training HarnessNet. Compared with a single global optimizer, HarnessNet achieves comparable performance gains while respecting local privacy and requiring fewer tokens and less time per optimizer call. A migration study shows that the evolved harnesses remain jointly effective after replacing the foundation models, suggesting transferability across models.
2610.15221.update_target: Joint harnesses in a layered multi-agent graph
2610.15221.mechanism_en: Local optimizers edit only their harness; node-specific downstream feedback propagates backward across Agentron layers.
2610.15221.result_en: AgentBench gains match a global optimizer with fewer tokens/time per call; harnesses transfer after model replacement.
2610.15221.boundary_en: Local access restrictions are architectural assumptions, not a general privacy proof.
2610.15221.abstract_zh: AI 智能体可利用环境反馈修订管理输入、工具、记忆和执行的软件框架，同时保持基础模型冻结。现有研究集中于单智能体，多智能体联合框架演化尚少。一位全局优化器会随系统规模增加而承受更多上下文和工作，访问限制也可能阻止共享内部状态或全局反馈。HarnessNet 提出层级框架演化。基本单元 Agentron 包含可进化前向框架、基础模型和只能观察、修改本地框架的优化器。各单元构成分层图，环境反馈向后传播，上游优化器接收下游层提供的节点专用反馈，把联合演化拆成协调的小任务，各有独立上下文，降低工作量并保持本地访问。优化器无需访问全部轨迹或原始环境反馈。多基础模型的 AgentBench 实验验证可训练性。相比全局优化器，HarnessNet 在满足本地隐私限制时取得相近收益，每次优化器调用 token 更少、耗时更短。迁移研究表明，替换基础模型后，演化框架仍联合有效，提示跨模型迁移能力。

2610.15368.title: ANTE: Anticipate, Then Execute -- Learning Internal World Models for Coding Agents from Verified Beliefs
2610.15368.authors: Yi Ge , Kangrui Ruan , Jifan Chen , Manish Prajapat , Christian Bock , Xiaoyang Wang , Rein Houthooft , Aritra Sengupta , Varun Kumar
2610.15368.abstract_en: Rapid advances in large language models have made software engineering agents capable of tackling complex coding tasks. Within a containerized environment, a coding agent receives tool responses or execution results, and determines its later actions by those earlier results. However, most existing coding agents never look ahead: their policies do not anticipate the consequences of actions, and the terminal reward barely attributes a failure to certain earlier steps, so an ill-judged edit can corrupt the repository state irreversibly before any signal arrives. Recent code world models aim to address these challenges, but they are either trained and then frozen before reinforcement learning (RL), or reduced to an auxiliary next-token loss on the environment's outputs. We present ANTE (Anticipate, Then Execute), an agentic RL framework that verifies the policy's pre-action predictions by real execution and turns them into per-step credit for its actions and trust-or-abstain decisions. With an internal belief stated before each action, Belief-Anchored Policy Optimization (BAPO) turns the settled predictions into per-step advantages by anchoring credit on the policy's own forecasts. To turn the trained forecasts into better actions at inference, thereby facilitating effective test-time scaling, ANTE-TTO (test-time optimization) selects among candidate actions without an external scorer. ANTE raises Qwen3-32B from 25.0% to 57.2% pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified, 6.2% above a matched GRPO baseline trained without the belief state; its world model's accuracy climbs from 44% to 69% during RL, and the learned foresight capability transfers across harnesses and out-of-distribution domains. In summary, we aim to build a code world model that knows what has happened, what holds now, and what the next action will achieve.
2610.15368.affiliation: University of Maryland, College Park / AWS AI Labs
2610.15368.mechanism_en: Real execution settles pre-action beliefs; BAPO anchors advantages to forecasts and test-time selection uses no external scorer.
2610.15368.result_en: SWE-bench Verified pass@1 rises 25.0% → 57.2%; forecast accuracy rises 44% → 69%.
2610.15368.boundary_en: The matched-baseline difference is reported as 6.2%; preserve source units and include belief-training cost.
2610.15368.abstract_zh: LLM 的进步使软件工程智能体能处理复杂代码任务。在容器中，智能体接收工具响应和执行结果，再决定后续动作，但大多不预判动作后果，终点奖励也很难把失败归因到早期步骤，糟糕编辑可能在反馈到达前就不可逆损坏仓库。近期代码世界模型要么在 RL 前训练后冻结，要么仅用环境输出的辅助下一 token 损失。我们提出 ANTE，以真实执行验证策略的动作前预测，并转化为动作及信任或拒答决策的逐步信用。每个动作前声明内部信念，信念锚定策略优化（BAPO）以自身预测为锚，将已判定预测转成逐步优势。推理时，ANTE-TTO 无需外部评分器，在候选动作中选择，把训练所得预测转化为更好动作，实现测试时扩展。ANTE 把 Qwen3-32B 在 SWE-bench Verified 的 pass@1 从 25.0% 提高到 57.2%，比未训练信念状态的匹配 GRPO 基线高 6.2%；世界模型准确率在 RL 中从 44% 升至 69%，预见能力可跨框架和域外领域迁移。我们旨在建立知道已经发生什么、当前成立什么、下一动作将实现什么的代码世界模型。

2610.15389.title: VideoEvoHarness: Self Evolving Agent Harness from Unlabeled Videos for Video Understanding
2610.15389.authors: Weixin Xu , Yifan Liu , Yi Wang , Mingfei Rong , Zhenyu Yang , Zhisheng Zhong , Shengsheng Qian , Changsheng Xu
2610.15389.abstract_en: Video understanding agents rely on a harness to acquire evidence, use tools, and reason, but improving it requires substantial effort. Recent self evolution methods seek to optimize harnesses through execution feedback to reduce human intervention. However, existing methods often rely on annotated video questions and answers or focus on updating model parameters, leaving harness evolution from unlabeled videos underexplored. VideoEvoHarness jointly evolves a Questioner and a Solver harness from unlabeled videos with frozen model parameters. The Questioner constructs questions and computes reference answers directly from video memory records. Question quality assessments and Solver execution trajectories guide question generation policy revisions. The Solver supports evolving skills, strategies, hyperparameters, and tools using execution feedback. Executable strategies define workflows in code, reducing repeated interpretation of natural language instructions. Each round, candidate harnesses are compared on identical validation questions, with validated improvements retained for later use. Experiments on benchmarks and a dedicated benchmark question set, using videos disjoint from evolution videos, show higher overall accuracy than initially and transfer gains across backbones. Overall accuracy on this set also improves progressively across rounds. This supports our foundational framework for harness evolution from unlabeled videos, opening a promising direction for self evolving video agents. Code is available at this https URL .
2610.15389.affiliation: Institute of Automation, CAS / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / Jiangsu University of Science and Technology / AICOMO / Inner Mongolia University / Tencent Hunyuan
2610.15389.update_target: Questioner and Solver harnesses with frozen models
2610.15389.mechanism_en: Video-memory answers and solver traces guide question revisions; identical validation questions gate retained solver changes.
2610.15389.result_en: Held-out-video accuracy improves across rounds and transfer backbones.
2610.15389.boundary_en: Video and validation separation matter; the abstract supplies no numerical headline.
2610.15389.abstract_zh: 视频理解智能体依赖框架获取证据、使用工具和推理，而改进框架耗费大量精力。自进化方法尝试借执行反馈减少人工干预，但往往依赖标注视频问答或更新模型参数，无标注视频上的框架演化研究不足。VideoEvoHarness 冻结模型，联合演化出题者与求解者框架。出题者根据视频记忆记录构造问题并直接计算参考答案，问题质量评估和求解轨迹指导问题生成策略修订；求解者根据执行反馈演化技能、策略、超参数和工具，可执行策略用代码定义工作流，减少反复解释自然语言指令。每轮在相同验证问题上比较候选框架，保留验证过的改进。在与演化视频不重叠的视频基准和专门问题集上，总体准确率高于初始设置，且跨主干迁移获益；专门问题集准确率随轮次逐步提高。结果支持从无标注视频演化框架，为自进化视频智能体提供方向。代码见原摘要所附链接。

2610.15708.title: SpecForge: Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents via Behavioral Specifications
2610.15708.authors: Yutong Cheng , Haifeng Chen , Peng Gao , Wei Cheng
2610.15708.abstract_en: Coding agents based on frozen language models can improve their performance by refining the external context they rely on, without updating model weights. We study recursive self-improvement through behavioral specifications: natural-language code documentation that describes the behavior of program entities and guides agents in generating correct code. We formulate a self-improvement loop in which an agent generates code from its current specifications, evaluates it with execution-verified tests, and refines the specifications based on observed failures. The improved specifications then guide subsequent generation, progressively improving the agent's understanding of the codebase. However, recursive refinement is challenging because program entities are interdependent. Improving the specification of one entity can inadvertently degrade the correctness of others, a phenomenon we call output coupling. This creates a whack-a-mole effect in which local improvements cause regressions elsewhere, preventing consistent progress. We introduce SpecForge, a multi-frontier tree search framework that addresses this challenge with three mechanisms: (i) Pareto-guided state selection preserves complementary specification states and prevents premature commitment; (ii) dependency-constrained entity selection prioritizes callee-before-caller refinement; and (iii) error-diversified expansion explores multiple refinements using different subsets of test failures. On DevEval+, SpecForge achieves the best performance across five backbone models, including a 94.9% solve rate with Claude-4.5-Sonnet and a 5.7-percentage-point average improvement over the strongest baseline. The improved specifications also make the agent better at tasks outside the loop: they transfer to cross-language translation and to new-feature implementation, where they outperform the benchmark-provided requirement documents.
2610.15708.update_target: Behavioral specifications used by a frozen coding model
2610.15708.mechanism_en: Execution-test failures revise documentation; Pareto states, dependency ordering, and diversified errors address output coupling.
2610.15708.result_en: 94.9% solve rate with Claude-4.5-Sonnet; average gain over the strongest baseline is 5.7 points.
2610.15708.boundary_en: Specification edits can regress dependent entities; transfer tasks should be evaluated outside the refinement loop.
2610.15708.abstract_zh: 基于冻结语言模型的编码智能体可通过细化外部上下文、而非权重更新改善表现。我们研究基于行为规范的递归自改进：自然语言代码文档描述程序实体行为，指导生成正确代码。循环由当前规范生成代码、用执行验证测试评估、按失败细化规范，再用改进规范指导后续生成，逐步提升对代码库的理解。但实体相互依赖，改进一个实体的规范可能损害其他实体正确性，即输出耦合，形成局部改进、别处回归的打地鼠效应。SpecForge 采用多前沿树搜索：Pareto 引导状态选择保留互补规范状态，避免过早承诺；依赖约束实体选择优先细化被调用者，再细化调用者；错误多样化扩展使用不同失败子集探索多种修订。在 DevEval+ 的五个主干上均取得最佳表现，Claude-4.5-Sonnet 解决率 94.9%，平均比最强基线高 5.7 个百分点。改进规范还迁移到循环外的跨语言翻译和新功能实现，并优于基准提供的需求文档。

2610.15772.title: RSIPO: Recursive Self-Improving Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning via Skill-Policy Co-Evolution
2610.15772.authors: Fan Zhang , Hao Wu , Jinyang Wu , Hongyu Qu , Zheng Lian , Xiao Luo , Yefeng Zheng , Bo Zhang , Haoxuan Li , Pheng-Ann Heng
2610.15772.abstract_en: Recent focus in agentic reinforcement learning (RL) seeks to improve credit assignment in long-horizon tasks. One promising direction combines reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), integrating trajectory-level advantages with dense token-level supervision. This line of work often conditions a teacher model on privileged context, such as agentic skills, to score tokens generated by the student policy. Despite their progress, they largely overlook the on-policy evolution of agentic skills and the reliability of teacher supervision. Towards this end, we introduce Recursive Self-Improving Policy Optimization (RSIPO), a self-evolving agentic RL framework that enables agentic skills and the policy model to co-evolve throughout the training process. Specifically, RSIPO enables the policy itself to extract skills from completed trajectories and explicitly optimizes its skill-generation capability through trajectory replay. It further employs empirical Bayes shrinkage to dynamically calibrate the student's trust in teacher scores, accounting for the fact that skill-enhanced teacher guidance can sometimes be less reliable. Experiments with Qwen-family models on embodied interaction and search-based agentic tasks demonstrate that RSIPO outperforms all the compared baseline approaches. With Qwen2.5-7B as the base model, RSIPO achieves an average success rate of 98.6\% on ALFWorld, yielding absolute improvements of 2.5\% and 17.4\% over the second-best baseline and standard GRPO, respectively.
2610.15772.affiliation: THU / NUS / Tongji University / UW-Madison / Westlake University / CUHK / Shanghai AI Laboratory / PKU (source abbreviations)
2610.15772.mechanism_en: The policy extracts skills, learns generation through replay, and calibrates teacher-score trust by empirical Bayes shrinkage.
2610.15772.result_en: Qwen2.5-7B reaches 98.6% ALFWorld success; absolute gains are reported as 2.5% and 17.4%.
2610.15772.boundary_en: Skill-enhanced supervision can be unreliable; co-evolution claims require calibrating rather than assuming teacher quality.
2610.15772.abstract_zh: 智能体 RL 近期关注长周期任务信用分配，一个方向结合可验证奖励 RL 与在策略自蒸馏，把轨迹优势与密集 token 监督融合，通常用技能等特权上下文条件化教师，为学生 token 评分。但技能的在策略演化及教师监督可靠性常被忽视。我们提出 RSIPO，让技能与策略在训练过程中共同演化。策略从完成轨迹中提取技能，并通过轨迹重放显式优化技能生成能力；经验贝叶斯收缩动态校准学生对教师分数的信任，因为技能增强教师有时也不可靠。Qwen 系列在具身交互和搜索任务上的实验中，RSIPO 优于所有比较基线。以 Qwen2.5-7B 为基础，在 ALFWorld 平均成功率 98.6%，比第二名和标准 GRPO 分别绝对提高 2.5% 和 17.4%。

2610.15782.title: Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement for Navigation via Policy-Synchronized Language-Action Dual Bootstrapping
2610.15782.authors: Songze Li , Haoming Gu , Ziyang Gong , Zhitong Wang , Gengze Zhou , Zun Wang , Yuhan Zhu , Tianxiang Jiang , Juanzi Li , Qi Wu , Weinan Zhang , Yu Qiao , Wenwei Zhang , Yi Wang
2610.15782.abstract_en: Vision-language navigation requires agents to follow natural-language instructions to reach target locations, making high-quality language supervision essential. Since human annotation is costly, prior work has explored scalable data synthesis methods. However, existing methods typically either use separate models for navigation and instruction generation or couple the two tasks through task-specific components; most also annotate the full trajectory corpus with a fixed model before updating, which can cause generated supervision to lag behind the evolving policy. Therefore, we introduce RSI-Nav, a data-centric recursive self-improvement framework for navigation via policy-synchronized language-action dual bootstrapping, which unifies vision-language-to-action instruction following and vision-action-to-language instruction generation within a shared model. Specifically, after supervised fine-tuning establishes fundamental capabilities, RSI-Nav progressively processes unlabeled trajectories in small shards. The current model generates instructions for these trajectories, executes them to evaluate goal completion and path efficiency, retains qualified samples, and immediately updates itself before processing the next shard. This shard-wise update keeps newly generated supervision aligned with the evolving policy. We also incorporate spatial understanding data, since stronger spatial reasoning benefits navigation. Extensive experiments show that RSI-Nav reaches 68.6% SR on R2R-CE and 72.4% SR on RxR-CE, while providing stronger instruction-generation utility and modestly improved spatial understanding after recursive evolution.
2610.15782.affiliation: Shanghai AI Laboratory / Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Tsinghua University / University of Adelaide / UNC Chapel Hill / Nanjing University / USTC / Harbin Institute of Technology / Fudan University
2610.15782.mechanism_en: Process trajectory shards: generate language, execute, filter by completion/efficiency, then update before the next shard.
2610.15782.result_en: Success reaches 68.6% on R2R-CE and 72.4% on RxR-CE.
2610.15782.boundary_en: Initial SFT and spatial data contribute; isolate synchronized bootstrapping from extra supervision.
2610.15782.abstract_zh: 视觉语言导航要求按自然语言指令到达目标，因此需要高质量语言监督。人工标注昂贵，既有合成方法通常分别使用导航和指令生成模型，或依赖专用组件耦合两者；多数还先用固定模型标注整个轨迹库再更新，监督可能落后于演化策略。RSI-Nav 提出与策略同步的语言—动作双自举，在共享模型内统一视觉语言到动作的跟随和视觉动作到语言的指令生成。SFT 建立基本能力后，逐个处理无标注轨迹小分片：当前模型生成指令，执行并评估目标完成和路径效率，保留合格样本，立即自我更新，再进入下一分片，使新监督与演化策略同步。方法还加入空间理解数据，因为更强空间推理有益导航。实验中，R2R-CE 成功率为 68.6%，RxR-CE 为 72.4%，递归演化还提高指令生成效用，并适度改善空间理解。

2610.15814.title: ReTrace: Cross-Stage Failure Attribution for Self-Improving Robotic Manipulation
2610.15814.authors: Yue Yu , Bin Zhu , Junhui Li , Jiayu Wang , Shijie Zhou , Jingjing Chen
2610.15814.abstract_en: General-purpose multimodal foundation models are increasingly capable of directly controlling robots, yet improving their manipulation capabilities through autonomous interaction remains challenging. A key challenge to such self-improvement is learning from failures in complex manipulation tasks involving cross-stage dependencies, where an action may succeed locally but cause a later stage to fail. To address this challenge, we introduce ReTrace, a self-improvement framework for robotic manipulation through autonomous physical interaction and retrospective reasoning, without provided demonstrations or model-parameter updates. ReTrace retrospectively traces downstream failures to earlier decisions, proposes targeted corrections, and evaluates them through subsequent interactions. Across attempts, ReTrace progressively consolidates validated corrections into a reusable manipulation skill that guide subsequent execution. We evaluate ReTrace on four real-world manipulation tasks using a Franka Research 3 robot. On the two tasks with strong cross-stage dependencies, GPT-6 Astra-low improves from 0% to 80% success on plug insertion and from 0% to 100% on ball pouring, while GPT-6 Sol-xhigh improves from 0% to 10% and 0% to 90%, respectively. The learned skills also transfer across model and reasoning configurations and reduce inference-time decision cost in most evaluated settings.
2610.15814.mechanism_en: Trace downstream failures to earlier actions, test targeted corrections physically, and consolidate validated changes.
2610.15814.result_en: Astra-low reaches 80% insertion and 100% pouring; Sol-xhigh reaches 10% and 90%, from zero.
2610.15814.boundary_en: Four physical tasks and model/configuration transfer are bounded evidence, not general autonomous robot improvement.
2610.15814.abstract_zh: 通用多模态基础模型越来越能直接控制机器人，但通过自主交互改善操作能力仍很困难。关键挑战是学习跨阶段依赖下的失败：动作可能局部成功，却导致后续失败。ReTrace 无需提供演示或更新模型参数，通过自主物理交互和回顾推理实现自改进。它把下游失败回溯到较早决策，提出针对性纠正，并通过后续交互评估；跨尝试把验证后的纠正逐渐巩固为可复用技能，指导后续执行。我们用 Franka Research 3 评估四项真实操作任务。在跨阶段依赖较强的两项任务中，GPT-6 Astra-low 的插头插入从 0% 提高至 80%，倒球从 0% 至 100%；GPT-6 Sol-xhigh 分别从 0% 至 10% 和 0% 至 90%。技能可跨模型与推理配置迁移，并在多数评估设置中降低推理决策成本。

2610.15915.title: VIEWCRAFT: Evolving What Multimodal Agents See and How They Read It
2610.15915.authors: Binxiao Xu , Ruichuan An , Bocheng Zou , Weihua Du , Xinyu Wei , Hangyu Guo , YiFan Zhang , Renye Yan , Chengqi Duan , Hang Hua
2610.15915.abstract_en: Reusable skills improve multimodal agents without updating model weights, but their effectiveness depends on both the evidence presented and the procedure used to read it. We introduce ViewCraft, which jointly evolves an executable evidence interface and its reading procedure. The interface selects, transforms, and organizes observations; the reader interprets the resulting views. Failure traces guide revisions, replay and paired evaluation retain useful changes, and interface projection recovers visual edits from eligible rejected joint proposals. Across eight benchmarks, ViewCraft improves over direct execution by an average of $6.1$ points in task score, with gains on every benchmark. The advantage persists at a matched input-token budget. On all five multi-source tasks, the learned interface uses 8%-15% fewer input tokens than Initial skill. The learned skills also transfer across executors and outperform direct execution in every evaluated transfer, supporting evidence construction and reading as a coupled, reusable skill.
2610.15915.affiliation: PKU / MIT-IBM Computing Research Lab / UW-Madison / CASIA / CMU / PolyU / HKU (source abbreviations)
2610.15915.update_target: Executable observation interface and reading procedure
2610.15915.mechanism_en: Failure-guided joint edits are tested by replay/paired evaluation; projection recovers eligible rejected visual edits.
2610.15915.result_en: Eight-benchmark mean gain is 6.1 points; five multi-source tasks use 8–15% fewer input tokens.
2610.15915.boundary_en: Interface and reader gains are coupled; transfer and matched-token comparisons help attribute them.
2610.15915.abstract_zh: 可复用技能能在不更新权重时改善多模态智能体，但效果同时取决于所呈现证据和读取证据的过程。ViewCraft 联合演化可执行证据接口及其读取程序；接口选择、变换、组织观测，读取者解释所得视图。失败轨迹指导修订，重放和配对评估保留有效变化，接口投影从符合条件但被拒绝的联合提案中恢复视觉编辑。八个基准上，平均任务分较直接执行高 6.1 点，每个基准均获益；匹配输入 token 预算后优势仍成立。五项多源任务中，学得接口比初始技能少用 8%–15% 输入 token。技能还能跨执行器迁移，在每个迁移评估中优于直接执行，支持把证据构造与读取作为耦合、可复用技能。

2610.15924.title: Scalable Weak-to-Strong Verifier Hardening for Agent Environments
2610.15924.authors: Chong Zeng , Ziqian Zhong , Kexun Zhang , Ivan Bercovich , Ivgeni Segal , Yuzhen Mao , Shashwat Saxena , Aditi Raghunathan
2610.15924.categories_text: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
2610.15924.abstract_en: Agent environments are essential for large language model (LLM) development. They use programmatic verifiers to turn complex outcomes into rewards. Verifiers can be attacked into awarding full credit to cheating agents without completing the intended task, causing inaccurate evaluation and misalignment in training. As agent environments scale in numbers and difficulty, so must the repairing of exploitable verifiers. To this end, we ask whether today's model with scaled compute can automatically harden agent environments to prevent potentially stronger future models from reward hacking. We introduce a scalable, fully automatic approach to weak-to-strong verifier hardening. It first sets up an isolated verifier sandbox that agents cannot directly modify, then uses a hacker-fixer loop to find and repair remaining verifier vulnerabilities. We apply this loop to Terminal Bench, KernelBench, and SETA, substantially reducing attack success across these agent environments. The iterative design scales with the hardening budget, producing progressively stronger defenses as the number of loop iterations increases and outperforming the static, non-iterative baseline. An earlier version of our hacker-fixer loop has been adopted by the official Terminal Bench repository as a way to audit exploits in its environments. Project page: this https URL .
2610.15924.affiliation: Stanford University / Carnegie Mellon University / Fewshot Corp / Independent Researcher
2610.15924.mechanism_en: Isolate a verifier sandbox; an iterative hacker–fixer loop finds and repairs exploitable reward paths.
2610.15924.result_en: Attack success falls on Terminal Bench, KernelBench, and SETA as hardening budget grows.
2610.15924.boundary_en: Lower measured attack success does not establish resistance to all stronger future attackers.
2610.15924.abstract_zh: 智能体环境通过程序验证器，把复杂结果转为奖励，因此对 LLM 发展至关重要。但验证器可被攻击，使作弊智能体未完成目标却获满分，造成评估失真和训练错位。环境数量与难度扩展时，可利用验证器的修复也须扩展。我们研究当代模型增加计算后，能否自动加固环境，阻止未来更强模型利用奖励。方法先建立智能体不能直接修改的隔离验证沙箱，再用攻击者—修复者循环寻找和修补其余漏洞。应用于 Terminal Bench、KernelBench、SETA 后，攻击成功率显著下降。随着加固预算和循环次数增加，防御逐渐增强，并优于静态非迭代基线。较早版本已被 Terminal Bench 官方仓库采用，用于审计环境利用漏洞。项目页见原摘要所附链接。

2610.15964.title: Small but Mighty: Test Suites as Improvement Signals for Self-Evolving Agents
2610.15964.authors: Yutong Cheng , Wei Cheng , Wenchao Yu , Dawei Zhou , Haifeng Chen
2610.15964.abstract_en: A self-evolving agent rewrites its own harness and must decide which rewrites to keep, so its improvement signal is the check a rewrite has to pass. Verifying a rewrite by agent rollout is expensive and subjective, while executable checks such as the repository's own tests are too sparse to catch behavior-changing rewrites, rejecting only a quarter of them. We instead take test feedback as the executable signal, and search for test suites that are both small and strong with a quality-diversity evolutionary algorithm, so that the signal is dense and informative. TeSearch treats suite size as a behavior descriptor, so that quality is pursued at every size and a small, strong suite is reachable, and learns a transition kernel during the search that denoises the LLM as an actuator on that descriptor. Across 129 real-world modules and three backbones, TeSearch delivers the highest-quality suites of any method compared, LLM-driven evolutionary search included, and the smallest of any LLM-based one. Used as the improvement signal of a self-evolving agent, it rejects 59.9% of behavior-changing rewrites against 25.3% for the repository's tests, at a 4.0% false-alarm rate and 3.5 s per decision. The code and data are available at this https URL .
2610.15964.update_target: Small test suites as harness-admission signals
2610.15964.mechanism_en: Quality-diversity search optimizes test quality at each suite size and learns a transition kernel.
2610.15964.result_en: Rejects 59.9% of behavior-changing rewrites versus 25.3%, with 4.0% false alarms and 3.5 s decisions.
2610.15964.boundary_en: Behavior-changing is not automatically harmful; sensitivity and false alarms both matter.
2610.15964.abstract_zh: 自进化智能体改写自身框架，必须决定保留哪些改写，因此改进信号就是改写必须通过的检查。通过智能体 rollout 验证昂贵且主观，仓库测试等可执行检查又过于稀疏，只拒绝约四分之一改变行为的改写。我们转而以测试反馈作为可执行信号，用质量—多样性进化算法寻找既小又强的测试套件，使信号密集且有信息。TeSearch 把套件大小作为行为描述符，在每种大小上追求质量，从而能找到小而强的套件；搜索中学习转移核，降低 LLM 作为描述符执行器的噪声。在 129 个真实模块和三个主干上，TeSearch 的套件质量优于全部比较方法，包括 LLM 进化搜索，规模也是所有 LLM 方法中最小。作为自进化智能体的改进信号，它拒绝 59.9% 改变行为的改写，仓库测试为 25.3%，误报率 4.0%，每次决定耗时 3.5 秒。代码数据见原摘要所附链接。

2610.16078.title: Heterogeneous Agentic Coevolution
2610.16078.authors: Wenqian Ye , Ziwei Guan , Zi Yang , Shivani Modi , Cici Cong Wu , Yunlong He , Yuxin Chen , Zhengyu Zhang , Liang Luo , Venkatesh Ranganathan , Jianhui Sun , Yantao Yao , Wenlin Chen , Buyun Zhang , Ellie Dingqiao Wen , Henry Kautz , Aidong Zhang
2610.16078.abstract_en: Recent advances in self-improving LLM agents have demonstrated the potential of AI systems that drive their own intelligence. However, many domain-specific applications rely on specialized foundation models that possess strong domain expertise but remain dependent on human-designed improvements. Extending recursive self-improvement to these models presents a key challenge: as a specialist improves, the strategies used to advance it must also adapt. To address this challenge, we propose Heterogeneous Agentic CoEvolution (HACE), a framework that jointly evolves specialized foundation models and LLM agents through reciprocal learning. HACE improves the specialist through supervised learning while training the agent with on-policy reinforced self-training, guided by verified performance gains on the current specialist. The agent's exploration, in turn, informs subsequent specialist training, enabling both models to adapt to each other's progress. To sustain this reciprocal learning, HACE further employs evolutionary search to optimize their interaction harness, adapting how the models exchange information and select training experiences as their capabilities evolve. We evaluate HACE across three challenging domains: recommendation systems, protein function prediction in biology, and crystal stability prediction in material discovery. We show that HACE outperforms the evaluated self-improving methods on the primary task metrics across all three domains. These results shed light on heterogeneous coevolution as a universal approach to improving specialized foundation models through reciprocal interaction with a learning agent.
2610.16078.update_target: Specialist model, learning agent, and interaction harness
2610.16078.mechanism_en: Verified specialist gains train the agent; agent exploration guides specialist supervision, while search adapts their interface.
2610.16078.result_en: Primary task metrics outperform evaluated self-improving methods in recommendation, proteins, and crystal stability.
2610.16078.boundary_en: Reciprocal training and harness search must be budgeted together; the abstract gives no numeric headline.
2610.16078.abstract_zh: 近期自改进 LLM 智能体展现 AI 驱动自身智能发展的潜力，但领域应用依赖的专门基础模型虽有强领域知识，仍依赖人工设计改进。把 RSI 扩展到专门模型的关键是：专家模型改善时，促进其进步的策略也必须适配。HACE 通过相互学习，联合演化专门基础模型和 LLM 智能体。专家通过监督学习改善；智能体采用在策略强化自训练，以当前专家上经验证的性能收益作为指导。智能体探索又指导下一轮专家训练，使双方适应彼此进展。HACE 还用进化搜索优化交互框架，随能力变化调整信息交换和训练经验选择。在推荐系统、生物蛋白功能预测、材料晶体稳定性预测三个领域，它的主要任务指标均优于被评估自改进方法。结果揭示异构共同演化可通过学习智能体与专门模型相互作用，改善专门基础模型。

2610.16491.title: Drafting Agents, Not Just Tokens: Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement for Agentic Systems
2610.16491.authors: Xin Xu , Ke Cheng , Hao Wang , Yangru Huang , Yanghao Xiao , Zhichao Chen , Zhisheng Zhong , Xun Liu , Yi Li , Qian Li , Haibin Lv , Jun Zhang , Jie Jiang , Zhouchen Lin
2610.16491.abstract_en: Improving an agent through successive revisions requires balancing exploration and evaluation under a limited budget. A narrow search can miss useful sequences of edits, while fully evaluating every intermediate version can exhaust the budget before those sequences yield a verified improvement. We introduce Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement (SpecRSI), which drafts executable successor agents before their predecessors are fully evaluated, while requiring complete verification before adoption. Verification-Aware Tree Search (VATS) allocates the budget between further edits and outstanding checks using the predicted verified return of a continuation. Group Verification Optimization (GVO) learns the improver from completed searches while keeping the real evaluator fixed. In the main scientific comparison, terminal gains exceed Janus by 33.3%--40.0%. Additional evaluations show that SpecRSI outperforms Janus in all 50 scientific backbone--task pairs and exceeds MetaRSI-v1 by 1.85%--2.38% in macro-average system score across twenty backbones. Coding-validation success reaches 69.4% versus HGM's 64.3% at a 20.8% lower target-cost index.
2610.16491.affiliation: Tencent AMS / Xiaohongshu / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / Peking University / Tencent Hunyuan / Beihang University
2610.16491.update_target: Successor agents and a trained improver
2610.16491.mechanism_en: Draft descendants before predecessor checks finish; VATS allocates search/check budgets and GVO learns from completed searches.
2610.16491.result_en: Scientific terminal gains exceed Janus by 33.3–40.0%; coding validation is 69.4% versus 64.3%.
2610.16491.boundary_en: Adoption still requires complete verification; speculative drafting is not permission to bypass acceptance checks.
2610.16491.abstract_zh: 连续修订智能体时，有限预算必须平衡探索与评估。狭窄搜索可能漏掉有益编辑序列，完整评估每个中间版本又可能在得到验证改进前耗尽预算。SpecRSI 在前代尚未完成评估时，就起草可执行后继智能体，但只在完整验证后接纳。验证感知树搜索（VATS）根据后续序列的预测已验证回报，在继续编辑和待完成检查之间分配预算；组验证优化（GVO）利用已完成搜索训练改进者，同时保持真实评估器固定。主要科学比较中，终点收益比 Janus 高 33.3%–40.0%。额外评估中，全部五十种科学主干—任务组合都优于 Janus，在二十个主干的宏平均系统分数上，比 MetaRSI-v1 高 1.85%–2.38%。代码验证成功率为 69.4%，HGM 为 64.3%，目标成本指数还低 20.8%。

2610.16500.title: Self-Verifier Capture in Unified Visual Generators: Diagnosing and Repairing Closed-Loop Self-Reward
2610.16500.abstract_en: Image-space reward requires decoding and a separate judge; unified visual generators can instead reuse their understanding pathway for decode-free, self-supplied reward. Optimizing against this verifier closes the self-reward loop; shared trainable weights let one update move generation and scoring even with the reward gradient stopped. We call the resulting failure self-verifier capture: self-reward rises while independently measured quality falls. Matched semantic/denoising by shared/frozen cells on Scale-RAE isolate two routes: the policy exploits on-manifold blind spots of a frozen semantic judge, while shared updates additionally rewrite the judge. A frozen judge also becomes stale, and repeated self-refresh yields progressively weaker recoveries. The diagnosis yields a two-part repair: locking the warmed reward read blocks rewriting, while sparse, parameter-disjoint external anchors counter residual exploitation. Unanchored rollouts retain semantic reward across multiple latent noise levels, providing dense latent reward that terminal image-space judging cannot supply, while a drift-triggered controller allocates anchors to high-drift rollouts and propagates their calibration within each group. At matched budgets, the controller improves on fixed-dose anchoring, increasingly so as coverage tightens. Both the unanchored failure and the repair transfer to the higher-performing, architecturally distinct Show-o2. Across both bases, the complete method significantly outperforms a construct-matched every-rollout judge on GenEval and DPG-Bench while externally scoring only 1/16 of rollouts. At 1/32 coverage, it scores higher in all four comparisons and remains jointly non-inferior.
2610.16500.affiliation: University of Science and Technology of China
2610.16500.update_target: Reliability of shared visual self-reward loops
2610.16500.mechanism_en: Shared/frozen crossed controls isolate exploitation and judge rewriting; lock reward reads and add sparse disjoint anchors.
2610.16500.result_en: With 1/16 externally scored rollouts, the complete method outperforms the matched every-rollout judge on two bases.
2610.16500.boundary_en: Self-reward can rise while external quality falls; sparse-anchor coverage and independent quality must be reported.
2610.16500.abstract_zh: 图像空间奖励需要解码及独立评委，而统一视觉生成器可复用理解通路，提供无需解码的自身奖励。但闭合自奖励循环后，即使停止奖励梯度，共享可训练权重仍使一次更新同时改变生成与评分。我们称之为自验证器俘获：自奖励上升，独立测量质量下降。Scale-RAE 上语义/去噪、共享/冻结的匹配对照分离出两条路径：策略利用冻结语义评委的流形内盲点，共享更新还会改写评委。冻结评委也会过时，反复自刷新只能带来越来越弱的恢复。修复包括锁定预热后的奖励读取以阻止改写，以及稀疏、参数不相交的外部锚点抑制剩余利用。无锚 rollout 在多个潜噪声层级保留语义奖励，提供终点图像评分无法提供的密集潜奖励；漂移触发控制器把锚点分配给高漂移 rollout，再向组内传播校准。匹配预算下，控制器优于固定剂量锚定，覆盖越低优势越大。失败与修复都迁移到架构不同、表现更强的 Show-o2。在两个基础模型上，完整方法仅外部评分 1/16 rollout，就在 GenEval 和 DPG-Bench 上显著优于构造匹配、每条轨迹都评分的评委；1/32 覆盖下，四种比较得分均更高，且仍联合非劣。

2610.16523.title: EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents
2610.16523.authors: Min Cai , Dan Zhang , Gao Xing , Libin Ma , Zhaohui Xu , Xi Ye
2610.16523.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
