2610.16523.abstract_en: Training LLM agents to interact with users over multiple turns is challenging because the learning signal depends not only on the agent, but also on the user simulator and environment, which jointly shape the agent's experience. Simulated users can be stochastic or inconsistent, while environments may contain unreliable tools, incomplete state coverage, and incorrect verifiers. Prior work mainly addresses the resulting instability through reward shaping or denser supervision, while treating these components as fixed. We instead introduce EAU, a meta-agent framework for environment--agent--user co-evolution. During training, EAU monitors trajectories, tool traces, rewards, and training statistics; diagnoses failures and uninformative interactions; and proposes targeted modifications to the user simulator, environment, reward design, and RL configuration. Validated changes are hot-swapped into the ongoing run, allowing the training setup to evolve together with the policy. These adaptations also persist across runs, so later training can build on previously discovered improvements rather than restarting from a fixed setup. We enable this process through an editable symbolic representation of user and environment dynamics, while the agent remains a neural LLM optimized with RL. Across three interactive-agent benchmarks and two backbone models, EAU consistently outperforms prior RL methods, improving the overall score over the strongest baseline by 14.7--15.0% and increasing successful task completion on ColBench by up to 36.7%, showing that co-evolving the training system with the policy can substantially improve multi-turn RL.
2610.16523.affiliation: University of Alberta / National University of Singapore / Kuaishou Technology / Independent Researcher / Amii
2610.16523.update_target: User simulator, environment, RL setup, and policy
2610.16523.mechanism_en: A meta-agent diagnoses traces and proposes validated hot-swapped symbolic setup changes retained across runs.
2610.16523.result_en: Overall scores improve 14.7–15.0% over the strongest baseline across three benchmarks/two backbones.
2610.16523.boundary_en: Changing verifiers or rewards can change the objective; independent evaluation must remain interpretable.
2610.16523.abstract_zh: 训练多轮用户交互智能体很困难，因为学习信号同时依赖智能体、用户模拟器和环境。模拟用户可能随机或不一致，环境可能工具不可靠、状态覆盖不全、验证器错误。此前多用奖励塑形或密集监督处理不稳定，却把这些组件固定。EAU 是环境—智能体—用户共同演化的元智能体框架，训练中监测轨迹、工具痕迹、奖励和统计，诊断失败及无信息交互，针对用户模拟器、环境、奖励设计、RL 配置提出修改。经验证变化热切换进正在进行的训练，让训练设置与策略一起演化；适配跨运行保留，后续可继承已发现改进。方法用可编辑符号表示描述用户和环境动力学，智能体仍为 RL 优化的神经 LLM。在三个交互基准、两个主干上，它持续优于此前 RL 方法，相比最强基线总体分数高 14.7%–15.0%，ColBench 成功完成最高增加 36.7%，说明共同演化训练系统与策略能显著改善多轮 RL。

2610.16679.title: EvoSpatial: Experience-Driven Skill and Tool Evolution for Spatial Reasoning Agents
2610.16679.authors: Bin Yu , Shijie Lian , Zhaolong Shen , Xiaopeng Lin , Yao Zhang , Haishan Liu , Haotian Li , Yuliang Wei , Kai Hu , Yichao Du , Zhirui Zhang , Bailing Wang , Kai Chen
2610.16679.abstract_en: Tool-augmented vision-language agents compose perception and measurement to reason about spatial relationships, but effective execution also requires tracking geometric assumptions and checking intermediate evidence. Preserving this experience across tasks requires retaining procedural knowledge together with the computations it governs. We introduce EvoSpatial, an experience-driven framework that evolves a library of linked skills and tools. Our key insight is that successful and failed spatial trajectories reveal both how to compute and when to trust the result. EvoSpatial retrieves skills, reuses tools, and synthesizes reusable computational functions (generated helpers) during reasoning. After answer submission, supervised outcome feedback guides skill refinement and tool consolidation for subsequent tasks. Across 20 benchmarks, EvoSpatial attains the highest average score among the compared spatial agents, exceeding SpatialClaw by 4.0 percentage points. Further experiments show cross-benchmark transfer and improved reasoning through skill-guided distillation without external skills at evaluation. These results support accumulating spatial experience for both inference-time reuse and trajectory-based training.
2610.16679.affiliation: Harbin Institute of Technology / Zhongguancun Academy / Zhongguancun Institute of Artificial Intelligence / HKUST (Guangzhou) / DeepCybo / Huazhong University of Science and Technology / Wuhan University / Beihang University
2610.16679.update_target: Linked spatial skills and executable helper tools
2610.16679.mechanism_en: Submitted-answer feedback guides skill refinement and tool consolidation for future tasks.
2610.16679.result_en: Across 20 benchmarks, mean score exceeds SpatialClaw by 4.0 points, with transfer/distillation evidence.
2610.16679.boundary_en: Supervised outcome feedback is part of the mechanism; do not describe it as unsupervised autonomous discovery.
2610.16679.abstract_zh: 工具增强视觉语言智能体结合感知和测量推理空间关系，但有效执行还需要跟踪几何假设、检查中间证据。跨任务保留经验，需要同时保存过程知识及其控制的计算。EvoSpatial 演化相互关联的技能与工具库，核心是成功和失败的空间轨迹同时揭示如何计算及何时信任结果。推理时检索技能、复用工具，并合成可复用计算函数。提交答案后，监督结果反馈指导技能细化和工具巩固，服务后续任务。二十个基准上，它在比较的空间智能体中平均分最高，比 SpatialClaw 高 4.0 个百分点。进一步实验显示跨基准迁移，以及技能引导蒸馏后无需评估时外部技能也能提升推理，支持将空间经验积累用于推理复用及轨迹训练。

2610.16725.title: Trace-to-Architecture: Capability Bottleneck Diagnosis for Harness Revision
2610.16725.authors: Wenfeng Wang , Jianrui Shi , Mingang Guo , Jiayuan Ma , Yuqi Lu , Jiajun Sun , Guojiang Zhao , Jing Li
2610.16725.abstract_en: Improving an LLM agent requires knowing what to change when it fails. Similar failures can require different fixes, and resolving one problem can expose another. We introduce Trace-to-Architecture (T2A), a framework that uses execution trajectories to determine what to change in an agent's harness and when those changes apply. A development agent diagnoses failures using execution evidence from successful and failed tasks, revises the corresponding harness components, and then checks whether target tasks improve, selected successful tasks remain successful, and the edits are actually triggered. New execution evidence guides subsequent diagnosis and revision. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and AppWorld, T2A achieves the highest aggregate score for all three evaluated task agents, exceeding their respective strongest baselines by 6.2--30.3 points. We also integrate T2A's diagnosis and validation procedures into Meta-Harness, improving the resulting harnesses' mean ScienceWorld score by 21.6 points from the same starting harness.
2610.16725.affiliation: University of Pennsylvania / Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen / DP Technology
2610.16725.update_target: Harness components selected by bottleneck diagnosis
2610.16725.mechanism_en: Successful/failed traces guide edits; checks require target gain, preserved successes, and actual edit activation.
2610.16725.result_en: Highest aggregate scores for three task agents; gains over strongest baselines range 6.2–30.3 points.
2610.16725.boundary_en: An inactive edit cannot explain a gain; targeted and regression evaluations should stay distinct.
2610.16725.abstract_zh: 改善 LLM 智能体需要在失败时知道应改什么。相似失败可能需要不同修复，解决一个问题也可能暴露另一个。Trace-to-Architecture（T2A）使用执行轨迹确定应修改哪些框架组件，以及变化何时适用。开发智能体依据成功与失败任务的执行证据诊断，修订对应组件，再检查目标任务是否改善、选定成功任务是否仍成功、编辑是否真的被触发；新执行证据继续指导诊断与修订。在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、AppWorld 上，T2A 对三个任务智能体均取得最高汇总分，分别比各自最强基线高 6.2–30.3 点。将其诊断与验证流程加入 Meta-Harness，从相同初始框架出发，最终框架的平均 ScienceWorld 分数再提高 21.6 点。

2610.16870.title: SpecGuardBench: Can Coding Agents Construct Reliable Validation Harnesses from Natural Language Specifications?
2610.16870.authors: Zhiqing Zhong , Mingyu Chen , Aoyang Fang , Yuzhong Zhang , Haoye Tian , Lionel Briand , Boxi Yu , Pinjia He
2610.16870.abstract_en: As coding agents become more capable, tests remain the primary evidence for judging whether their code is correct. Yet passing available tests does not establish that an implementation satisfies its natural language specification. Reliable validation requires checks that faithfully capture the specification and scenarios that thoroughly exercise the code, but current benchmarks provide limited insight into whether agents can construct such evidence themselves. We introduce SpecGuardBench, a benchmark of 291 tasks from 13 real-world repositories, covering 8 types of verification logic such as functional postconditions and interaction protocols. Given a natural language specification, repository context, and a reference implementation, an agent constructs a validation harness comprising executable checks and test scenarios. The checks should reject implementations that violate the specification while accepting those that satisfy it, and the scenarios should thoroughly exercise the code. Across four proprietary and open-weight coding agents, none constructs a harness scored as faithful on the benchmark's implementations for more than 63% of the tasks. The bottleneck lies less in exploring test scenarios than in constructing checks that faithfully reflect the specification. Specifically, the agents show a clear tendency to write checks that mirror the reference implementation rather than the specification, and therefore reject implementations that the specification permits.
2610.16870.affiliation: CUHK Shenzhen / Aalto University / Lero / University of Limerick / University of Ottawa
2610.16870.mechanism_en: 291 tasks from 13 repositories test accepting specification-valid implementations and rejecting invalid ones.
2610.16870.result_en: No evaluated agent constructs faithful checks on more than 63% of tasks.
2610.16870.boundary_en: Reference-implementation mimicry can reject other valid solutions; test coverage alone is insufficient.
2610.16870.abstract_zh: 测试是判断编码智能体代码正确性的主要证据，但通过现有测试不证明满足自然语言规范。可靠验证需要忠实表达规范的检查和充分执行代码的场景，现有基准却较少评估智能体能否自己构建这些证据。SpecGuardBench 包含十三个真实仓库的 291 个任务，覆盖功能后置条件、交互协议等八类验证逻辑。给定规范、仓库上下文和参考实现，智能体构建包含可执行检查与场景的验证框架。检查应拒绝违反规范的实现、接受满足规范的实现，场景应充分执行代码。在四个专有与开放权重编码智能体中，没有一个能在超过 63% 任务上构建被基准实现集判为忠实的框架。瓶颈更多是检查是否忠实于规范，而非场景探索；智能体倾向模仿参考实现编写检查，因而拒绝规范允许的其他实现。

2610.17114.title: D-World: An Explicit World-Language-Action Model with Recursive Self-Improvement under Dual Control
2610.17114.abstract_en: Frontier large language models (LLMs) now reason about space well enough to program robots, yet the world models behind robot policies are implicit, held in network weights or predicted video, and cannot be inspected or corrected directly. We present D-World, an explicit world-language-action model built on the Sense, Plan and Act decomposition. A perception agent writes the scene as an executable digital twin using generated vision and geometry code. A planning agent searches for actions in simulation and, after each executed action chunk, revises the twin's object states and named physical parameters against what the robot measured. A parameter revision is accepted only if replaying the latest chunk does not increase any measured residual beyond its tolerance, and every chunk is checked in the updated twin before it runs. Structural mismatches return to perception for reconstruction. We call this measurement-grounded cycle of correction and revision recursive self-improvement (RSI), in which the LLM stays frozen while the world it acts in improves. We model the choice of actions that both advance the task and expose model error as a dual control problem and show that the cost of incorporating evidence into the twin sets the threshold at which probing pays, so cheap local revision counteracts the turn-off of cautious controllers. Each episode runs a real-to-sim-to-real loop, and its recorded twins can be refitted and re-rendered offline into higher-fidelity environments for post-training. Because perception and planning communicate only through the twin and language, either can be replaced by a learned model, and since inference dominates the loop, the loop speeds up with faster models. On a dual-arm robot, towel and toaster tasks show local revisions, such as one reducing the bread's rendered-depth residual from 22.4 to 1.5 mm, that let execution continue without reconstruction.
2610.17114.update_target: Explicit digital-twin states and physical parameters
2610.17114.mechanism_en: Measured action chunks revise the twin; replay gates parameter changes and structural mismatch triggers reconstruction.
2610.17114.result_en: Dual-arm cases include bread-depth residual reduction from 22.4 to 1.5 mm.
2610.17114.boundary_en: The reported loop is primarily within episodes with a frozen LLM; offline post-training reuse is an additional possibility.
2610.17114.abstract_zh: 前沿 LLM 已能通过编程控制机器人，但策略背后的世界模型通常隐含在权重或预测视频里，无法直接检查、纠正。D-World 以感知—规划—行动分解构建显式世界—语言—动作模型。感知智能体用生成的视觉和几何代码，把场景写成可执行数字孪生；规划智能体在仿真搜索动作，并在每个真实动作片段后，依据测量修订对象状态和具名物理参数。只有重放最新片段后，没有任何测量残差超出其容差而增加，参数修订才被接纳；每个片段执行前都在更新孪生中检查。结构错配返回感知重建。我们把这一测量驱动修订循环称为 RSI，LLM 冻结而其行动世界逐步改善。把同时推进任务、暴露模型错误的动作选择建模为双重控制，表明向孪生纳入证据的成本决定探测何时划算，廉价局部修订可对抗谨慎控制器的关闭现象。每回合运行真实—仿真—真实闭环，记录的孪生还可离线重拟合和重渲染为更高保真后训练环境。感知与规划只通过孪生和语言通信，因此任一方都可替换为学习模型；推理占主导，模型变快也会加速循环。双臂毛巾与烤面包机任务展示局部修订，例如把面包渲染深度残差从 22.4 降至 1.5 毫米，使执行无需重建即可继续。

2610.17370.title: HarnessTTT: Learn to Optimize Harness at Test-Time for Scientific Discovery
2610.17370.authors: Yingzi Ma , Yulong Cao , Nanxi Li , Fang Wu , Yizhe Zhang , James Zou , Yejin Choi , Chaowei Xiao
2610.17370.abstract_en: Scientific discovery with language models requires finding the best valid solution within a finite computational budget. We study how feedback from this search can improve the procedure used to conduct it. We introduce HarnessTTT, a test-time learning framework that trains a harness proposer while keeping the executor frozen. The proposer generates executable harnesses comprising system prompts, reusable skills, tools, middleware, and execution controls. Each harness guides a budgeted discovery rollout, whose outcome provides feedback for updating the proposer. A discovery-oriented policy-gradient objective combines gap-normalized rewards, leave-one-out advantages (RLOO), and max-sharpening to favor high-performing proposals. Generated components are validated before execution, and the search retains the best valid solution and selected harnesses across rounds. Across fourteen discovery tasks in mathematics, systems, GPU kernels, heuristic programming, astrodynamics, and biology, HarnessTTT with a frozen 9B executor improves on OpenEvolve with the same executor on all eleven benchmark tasks (e.g., from 1.17 to 2.64 on circle packing), improves on the discovery-fine-tuned Finch-9B by up to 92%, holds the best open-weight sub-10B result on nine, and reaches 0.380919 on Erdős minimum overlap, better than the best human reference of 0.380927. Scaling the proposer and frozen executor to 27B improves on eleven of fourteen tasks, and transferring the learned harnesses to GPT-5.5 matches or exceeds the strongest reported system of any backbone on nine of fourteen tasks. Together, these results show that harness search can itself be learned at test time: a trained proposer lets a small frozen executor search effectively, and the harnesses it finds carry over to stronger executors.
2610.17370.affiliation: University of Wisconsin-Madison / NVIDIA / Johns Hopkins University / Stanford University / Meta
2610.17370.update_target: A trainable harness proposer with frozen executor
2610.17370.mechanism_en: Budgeted discovery rollouts train proposal policy; generated components validate before use and selected harnesses persist.
2610.17370.result_en: A frozen 9B executor beats same-executor OpenEvolve on all eleven benchmark tasks; larger runs cover fourteen tasks.
2610.17370.boundary_en: Compare full proposer-training/search budgets; transferred harness results do not imply executor-weight improvement.
2610.17370.abstract_zh: 语言模型科学发现需要在有限计算预算内找到最佳有效解。我们研究如何用搜索反馈改进搜索程序，提出 HarnessTTT：训练框架提案者、冻结执行器的测试时学习方法。提案者生成含系统提示、可复用技能、工具、中间件和执行控制的可执行框架，每个框架指导预算内发现 rollout，其结果反馈用于更新提案者。面向发现的策略梯度目标结合差距归一奖励、留一优势（RLOO）和最大值锐化，偏向高表现提案。生成组件在执行前验证，跨轮保留最佳有效解及选定框架。在数学、系统、GPU 内核、启发式编程、天体动力学、生物十四项任务中，冻结 9B 执行器在全部十一个基准任务上优于同执行器的 OpenEvolve，例如圆填充从 1.17 至 2.64；比发现专用微调 Finch-9B 最高改善 92%，九项获得开放权重十 B 以下最佳结果，Erdős 最小重叠为 0.380919，优于最佳人类参考 0.380927。提案者和冻结执行器扩到 27B 后，十四项中十一项改善；把框架迁移至 GPT-5.5，九项匹配或超过所有主干最强报告系统。结果表明，训练提案者可让小型冻结执行器高效搜索，框架还可迁移至更强执行器。

2610.17488.title: Origin Attribution for Unsafe Behavior in Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Coding Systems
2610.17488.abstract_en: As language-model-based coding agents evolve their programs and reuse code from one another, safety failures can acquire a history that extends beyond the agent in which they are detected. An unsafe change may originate in one agent, propagate through intermediate recipients, and survive subsequent revisions before an audit reveals it. Understanding this history is important for identifying the introducing change and distinguishing inherited behavior from independently occurring failures. We study origin attribution in self-evolving multi-agent coding systems: recovering the agent and program version that introduced an observed unsafe behavior into the target's code lineage, or determining that it arose locally. This task is challenging because rewriting obscures textual similarity, independent occurrences confound temporal ordering, and intermediate recipients can resemble the source. We propose a method that combines behavioral fingerprint matching with historical localization and recursive tracing. It compares candidate implementations beyond the unsafe outcome, retains evidence from multiple historical versions, and follows matching candidates upstream. On 158 queries across 85 controlled scenarios, the method achieves 96.8% exact attribution accuracy, compared with 77.2% for exhaustive fingerprint matching without recursion. Component ablations and evaluation on 34 additional queries using the same method and hyperparameters demonstrate the complementary roles of multiple representatives and recursive tracing. Further checks extend the evaluation to approval-boundary and resource-owner errors. Together, these results show how behavioral and historical evidence can recover the origins of unsafe behavior through code revision and cross-agent propagation.
2610.17488.affiliation: University of Southern California / Virginia Tech
2610.17488.update_target: Origins of inherited unsafe coding behavior
2610.17488.mechanism_en: Behavioral fingerprints, historical versions, and recursive upstream tracing distinguish lineage from local recurrence.
2610.17488.result_en: Exact attribution is 96.8% on 158 queries/85 scenarios versus 77.2% without recursion.
2610.17488.boundary_en: Controlled attribution accuracy is not proof that all unsafe propagation can be prevented.
2610.17488.abstract_zh: 语言模型编码智能体演化程序、互相复用代码时，安全失败的历史可能超出被检测的智能体：不安全修改可起源于一方，经中间接收者传播，在后续修订中保留，最后才被审计发现。识别这段历史，有助定位引入变化，并区分继承行为与独立失败。我们研究源头归因：找出在目标代码谱系中引入不安全行为的智能体和程序版本，或判定其本地产生。代码改写模糊文本相似性，独立发生混淆时间顺序，中间接收者可能与源头相似。方法结合行为指纹匹配、历史定位和递归追踪，比较不安全结果之外的实现特征，保留多个历史版本证据，并向上游追查匹配候选。在 85 个受控场景的 158 个查询中，精确归因准确率 96.8%，不带递归的穷尽指纹匹配为 77.2%。消融及保持相同方法和超参数的额外 34 查询评估，展示多代表和递归追踪的互补性；进一步检查扩展到审批边界与资源所有者错误。行为和历史证据可恢复经历代码修订与跨智能体传播的不安全行为起源。

2610.17544.title: Many Steps into One: Reasoning Contraction and the Limits of Safe Memory Reuse for LLM Agents
2610.17544.authors: Jianghong Zhou , Hao Rong , Chen Lin , Daoan Zhang
2610.17544.abstract_en: Thought templates, skill libraries, agent memories and caches turn many reasoning steps into one. We call this reasoning contraction. A contracted memory saves reasoning steps and errors until its facts change, then quietly answers wrong. Most systems trust memories by counting successes and failures. We prove that such counters are badly tuned change detectors: a symmetric counter notices a partial change only after a power of its false-alarm horizon, and an unclipped one may never notice it. On five LLMs answering multi-hop questions over edited facts, ExpeL- and ACE-style counters serve 7.0-13.5x more stale answers than certified memories given the same information, and on code tasks with an exact verifier 35-73x more. Safety also has a price. When facts change and each memory is judged only by its own verified outcomes, one number, the certification load, sets how much reasoning any safe memory can skip, and under Zipf demand it yields a scaling law. Our recipe weighs each memory's failures by its own likelihood ratio, certifies its utility against live reasoning, and restarts the certificate when facts change, with the likelihood-ratio detector as the safety net for unannounced changes; for large edits it also invalidates the memory.
2610.17544.update_target: Safe reuse of contracted reasoning memories
2610.17544.mechanism_en: Likelihood-ratio failure weighting certifies utility against live reasoning and restarts or invalidates after changes.
2610.17544.result_en: Counter memories emit 7.0–13.5x more stale QA answers and 35–73x more stale code answers than certified memory.
2610.17544.boundary_en: Theoretical safety costs depend on the observation and demand assumptions; retention is not automatically safe.
2610.17544.abstract_zh: 思维模板、技能库、智能体记忆和缓存把多步推理压成一步，我们称之为推理收缩。收缩记忆在事实不变时节省推理与错误，事实变化后却会悄悄答错。多数系统通过成功、失败计数信任记忆。我们证明计数器是不良变化检测器：对称计数器识别部分变化需等待其误报时间尺度的一个幂，不截断的计数器甚至永远无法发现。五个 LLM 在事实编辑后的多跳问答中，ExpeL 和 ACE 式计数器比获得相同信息的认证记忆多提供 7.0–13.5 倍过时答案；带精确验证器的代码任务中为 35–73 倍。安全也有成本：事实改变且每项记忆只能按自身验证结果评判时，“认证负载”决定任何安全记忆最多能跳过多少推理，并在 Zipf 需求下形成尺度规律。方法按各记忆自身似然比加权失败，相对实时推理认证效用，事实变化后重启证书，以似然比检测器应对未预告变化；大编辑还会使记忆失效。

2610.17609.title: Verifier-Harness Co-Evolution for Training-Free Self-Improvement on Open-Ended Tasks
2610.17609.authors: Tianyi Xu , Yaolun Zhang , Yiran Wu , Joe Nguyen , Shengyu Dai , Saba Moeinizade , Zhenwen Shao , Qingyun Wu , Huazheng Wang
2610.17609.abstract_en: Training-free self-improvement lets an agent use feedback to revise the response it is about to return and to update the harness state that shapes how it handles later tasks. On open-ended tasks that feedback rarely comes from reference answers or executable tests, so the agent has to rely on a model-based verifier. When the verifier is wrong, the current response can get worse, and misleading experience can persist across the task stream. A verifier that never changes also grows stale as the agent's responses improve and task demands shift. We introduce Unified Co-Evolution (UCoE), a training-free method that evolves an executable verifier program together with the agent's harness state while all model parameters stay fixed. UCoE synthesizes candidate verifier programs and tests them on response contrasts, pairs of responses that differ in one declared property and have a known preferred side. It selects the candidate whose discrimination on its weakest contrast family is highest, a quantity we call driving capacity. The selected verifier diagnoses one weakness in each draft, guides a single repair, decides which response is served, and determines whether the accepted repair may enter the harness state. As tasks complete, their diagnostics seed new candidate verifiers, which must beat the current verifier on the same contrasts before adoption. Across six open-ended benchmarks, UCoE averages 59.00% preference against matched direct generation with Qwen3-8B and 57.19% with Qwen3.8-27B, margins of 9.00 and 7.19 percentage points. On three verifiable benchmarks, the same method raises the mean from 36.06% for direct generation to 38.48%. Code is available at this https URL .
2610.17609.affiliation: Oregon State University / Pennsylvania State University / Johnson & Johnson / AG2 AI
2610.17609.update_target: Executable verifier and persistent harness state
2610.17609.mechanism_en: Known-preference response contrasts select by weakest-family discrimination; task diagnostics seed better verifier candidates.
2610.17609.result_en: Open-task preference is 59.00%/57.19%; verifiable-task mean rises 36.06% → 38.48%.
2610.17609.boundary_en: Contrast correctness and coverage bound reliability; model parameters remain fixed.
2610.17609.abstract_zh: 无需训练的自改进允许智能体据反馈修订当前响应，并更新影响后续任务的框架状态。开放任务通常没有参考答案或可执行测试，只能依赖模型验证器；验证器出错会恶化当前响应，还会让误导经验持久保留。固定验证器又随响应改善和任务变化而过时。UCoE 保持全部模型参数固定，联合演化可执行验证程序与框架状态。它生成验证器候选，在仅一项声明属性不同、偏好方向已知的响应对上测试，以最弱对比家族的最高区分能力选择候选，称为驱动能力。验证器诊断草稿的一项弱点、指导一次修复、决定服务哪个响应，以及修复是否可进入框架状态。任务结束后，诊断生成新候选，必须在相同对比集上优于当前验证器才能接纳。在六个开放基准中，Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3.8-27B 相比匹配直接生成的平均偏好分别为 59.00% 和 57.19%，优势 9.00 和 7.19 个百分点；三个可验证基准的均值从直接生成的 36.06% 提高到 38.48%。代码见原摘要所附链接。

2610.17718.title: ECG-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Targeted Electrocardiogram Waveform Evolution
2610.17718.authors: Xiaoliang Wang , Zhuo Chen , Chuanyang Zheng , Jiangwei Lao , Quanbin Wang , Honglin Lin , Jiajia Liu , Zhihong Lu , Hao Jin , Jian Wang , Lijun Wu
2610.17718.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Machine Learning (cs.LG); Signal Processing (eess.SP); Quantitative Methods (q-bio.QM)
2610.17718.abstract_en: Electrocardiogram (ECG) models need supervision that targets evolving weaknesses and remains faithful to waveform evidence. We introduce ECG-RSI, a recursive self-improvement framework combining verified waveform synthesis with feedback-guided intervention search. Signal remeasurement verifies waveform edits; construction errors guide generator repair, while learner errors motivate interventions compared on a separate selection set. Across seven benchmarks, three rounds raise Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's mean question-answering accuracy from 34.57% to 56.04% and mean classification F1 from 24.27 to 34.03. Across the retained trajectory, the preferred supervision shifts from direct reinforcement to confusion-focused contrasts. Continued feedback correction yields diminishing external gains. These results motivate separating error diagnosis from intervention selection and checking whether gains on the feedback set transfer to independent benchmarks.
2610.17718.affiliation: Zhejiang University / Ant Group / Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory / Shanghai Jiao Tong University
2610.17718.update_target: Waveform generator, intervention selection, and ECG learner
2610.17718.mechanism_en: Remeasure edits, repair construction errors, and compare learner-targeted interventions on separate selection data.
2610.17718.result_en: Three rounds raise QA 34.57% → 56.04% and classification F1 24.27 → 34.03 across seven benchmarks.
2610.17718.boundary_en: Diminishing external gains require independent tests; this is model evaluation, not patient-level clinical validation.
2610.17718.abstract_zh: 心电图模型需要针对不断变化弱点、且忠实于波形证据的监督。ECG-RSI 把经过验证的波形合成与反馈引导的干预搜索结合。信号重新测量验证波形编辑，构造错误指导生成器修复，学习器错误则提出在独立选择集上比较的干预。七个基准上，三轮将 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 平均问答准确率从 34.57% 提高到 56.04%，平均分类 F1 从 24.27 提高到 34.03。保留轨迹中，优选监督从直接强化转向聚焦混淆的对比。持续反馈纠正的外部收益逐渐减小。结果提示应将错误诊断与干预选择分开，并检查反馈集收益能否迁移到独立基准。

2610.17740.title: Coupled Harness--Model Evolution for Scientific Equation Discovery
2610.17740.authors: Pengze Li , Jiaquan Zhang , Encheng Su , Yunbo Long , Zihang Zeng , Xinping Liu , Han Zhang , Junchi Yu , Shixiang Tang , Aoran Wang , Xi Chen
2610.17740.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to discover scientific equations from experimental data. Such a discovery system has two parts that must work together: a library of executable computational tools and the model's tool-use policy. The tools supply the solving capability, from diagnosing structure in the data to fitting candidate equations; the policy plans and orchestrates their use. Yet existing systems adapt only one part, keeping either the toolset or the model fixed, which leaves the corresponding failures uncorrectable. We develop a coupled evolution framework that improves both parts from the same verifiable fit-error signal. In the tool-evolution phase, an agent grows an executable tool library from a small set of generic numerical operations by diagnosing its own failures: it authors a new tool when a capability is missing and revises its selection rules when the right tool went unused. In the policy-evolution phase, a small open model (roughly 3B active parameters) is fine-tuned on successful tool-use trajectories collected with the frozen library, on training formulas screened to be disjoint from all evaluation benchmarks. Ablations show the two phases are complementary: with no tool library at all the same model solves almost nothing, the tools account for most of the gain, and trajectory training adds a further gain that is largest on the most difficult problems. The full system solves 79.1/71.3\% of LSR-Synth problems at fit tolerances $10^{-2}$/$10^{-3}$, reaches 63.8\% pooled accuracy on the distributionally different SRSD-Feynman panel, and obtains a normalized CP3-28 aggregate of $-7.27$. These results suggest a broader recipe for scientific agents: let the model and its instruments improve each other under verifiable feedback.
2610.17740.affiliation: Fudan University / USTC / University of Cambridge / Peng Cheng Laboratory / University of Oxford / CUHK / Shanghai AI Laboratory
2610.17740.update_target: Executable scientific tools and tool-use policy
2610.17740.mechanism_en: Fit errors guide new tools or routing rules; successful trajectories with a frozen library train a small model on disjoint formulas.
2610.17740.result_en: LSR-Synth solves 79.1%/71.3% at two tolerances; SRSD-Feynman pooled accuracy is 63.8%.
2610.17740.boundary_en: Tools account for most gains, with complementary trajectory learning; do not attribute all gain to weight updates.
2610.17740.abstract_zh: LLM 越来越多地从实验数据发现科学方程。这类系统包含必须协同的两部分：可执行计算工具库，以及模型的工具使用策略。工具提供从结构诊断到方程拟合的求解能力，策略规划和编排使用方式；现有系统往往只适配其中一方，使另一方失败无法纠正。我们用相同的可验证拟合误差信号共同演化两者。工具演化阶段，智能体从少量通用数值操作出发，诊断自身失败：缺能力时编写新工具，正确工具未被使用时修订选择规则。策略演化阶段，用冻结工具库收集成功轨迹，在已筛除所有评估基准重叠的训练公式上微调约三 B 激活参数的开放模型。消融显示两阶段互补：同模型没有工具几乎不能求解，工具贡献大部分收益，轨迹训练进一步提升，尤其困难题最明显。完整系统在 LSR-Synth 的 10⁻²、10⁻³ 容差下分别解决 79.1%、71.3%，在分布不同的 SRSD-Feynman 面板汇总准确率 63.8%，归一 CP3-28 汇总为 −7.27。结果支持科学智能体通过可验证反馈让模型与其仪器共同改进。

2610.17860.title: Socratic Skill Learning: Interleaving Teaching and Practice for Transferable Agent Skills
2610.17860.authors: Letian Zhu , Han Li , Yifan Yao , Xinping Lei , Xinyu Che , Jiahao Wang , Dianyi Wang , Yucheng Fu , Jiakai Wang , Zhiqi Bai , Wenbo Su , Jiaheng Liu
2610.17860.abstract_en: Agent Skills improve LLM agents by making task knowledge reusable across sessions. Learning transferable Skills requires evidence about a procedure and its conditions of use, which a successful task attempt can leave untested. We introduce Socratic Skill Learning (SSL), which interleaves expert teaching with Student practice. An Educator guides investigation while the Student remains the sole environment operator and Skill author, able to question, test, and adapt advice. To test reuse beyond the learning task, we construct SkillTransferBench, with 35 task families and 408 executable cases, pairing public variation specifications with held-out evaluation in fresh solver sessions. On the main 22-family, 155-case cohort, Fixed-Window SSL reaches 0.801 utility, versus 0.723 without a Skill, 0.761 for adapted Trace2Skill (trajectory distillation), and 0.751 for adapted SKILL-KD (contrastive distillation). Across three model pairs on shared families, interleaved guidance outperforms expert authoring and post-hoc teaching. Process analysis links guidance to Student writing and package revision; a case study shows the Student testing and refining a proposed procedure for later reuse. As demand for new lessons falls, the cost of fixed-window review grows. Issue-Guided SSL tracks unresolved questions across Skill revisions to select and focus review, reaching 0.805 utility with 61.7% fewer Educator tokens and 16.9% fewer total acquisition tokens than Fixed-Window SSL on the main cohort.
2610.17860.mechanism_en: Expert teaching interleaves with student-only environment practice; unresolved issues select later review.
2610.17860.result_en: Issue-Guided SSL reaches 0.805 utility with 61.7% fewer educator tokens than fixed-window SSL.
2610.17860.boundary_en: External expert guidance remains part of acquisition; held-out fresh sessions assess actual reuse.
2610.17860.abstract_zh: 智能体技能让任务知识可跨会话复用，但学到可迁移技能需要检验过程及使用条件，一次成功可能没有覆盖这些条件。Socratic Skill Learning（SSL）交错专家教学与学生实践。教育者指导调查，学生始终是唯一环境操作者和技能作者，可以质疑、测试和调整建议。为评估学习任务外的复用，我们构建 SkillTransferBench：35 个任务家族、408 个可执行案例，结合公开变化规范与新求解会话中的留出评估。主要二十二家族、一百五十五案例中，固定窗口 SSL 效用为 0.801，无技能为 0.723，适配的 Trace2Skill 为 0.761，SKILL-KD 为 0.751。共享家族的三组模型配对中，交错指导优于专家直接编写及事后教学。过程分析把指导与学生写作、包修订联系起来，案例展示学生测试和细化拟议过程以备复用。随着新课程需求降低，固定窗口审阅成本上升。Issue-Guided SSL 跨技能版本跟踪未解问题，选择和聚焦审阅，在主要样本上达到 0.805 效用，相比固定窗口少用 61.7% 教育者 token、16.9% 总获取 token。

2610.18067.title: WorkRover: Scaling Long-Horizon Cowork Agent Training Via Recursive Environment Evolution
2610.18067.authors: Hang He , Linting Wang , Guanming Liu , Bo Mao , Jinxiu Liu , Yiran Suo , Maosen Zhou , Zhiheng Xi , Guanting Dong , Zhou Shao , Rui Zheng , Jie Zhou , Chengcheng Wan , Tao Gui , Qi Zhang , Xipeng Qiu , Xuanjing Huang
2610.18067.abstract_en: Scaling interactive environments is important for training long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning. These environments often require further testing and refinement after initial generation, and correcting defects in a task may also require updating its work context and verifier. However, existing construction pipelines offer limited support for such iterative refinement while keeping these components aligned. We introduce WorkRover, a framework for training long-horizon cowork agents through recursive environment evolution. Its harness-driven synthesis enables construction agents to jointly build and validate semantically aligned work contexts, executable tasks, and evidence-grounded verifiers, adapting their actions to workspace state and execution feedback rather than following a fixed construction workflow. To support environment evolution, we introduce Factorial Compatibility Replay (FCR), which uses rollout feedback to evaluate combinations of component revisions through dependency-closed replay and selects the smallest validated repair among tested candidates while preserving task requirements and evaluation constraints. To provide finer-grained training signals, we propose Verifier-to-Turn Credit Assignment (VTCA), which augments trajectory-level GRPO advantages with signals from deterministic workspace-progress checks and assigns a bounded share of positive-progress credit to prerequisite turns using recorded tool-output and artifact dependencies. Using WorkRover, we post-train Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to obtain WorkRover-35B-A3B and evaluate it on several cowork-agent benchmarks. Its reported scores exceed those of Qwen3.5-35B-A3B by 26.27 percentage points on JobBench, 29.32 percentage points on OfficeQA Pro, and 413.25 Elo points on GDPval v2. These results suggest that WorkRover offers a promising foundation for scalable training of long-horizon cowork agents.
2610.18067.affiliation: Fudan University / East China Normal University / Renmin University of China / Shanghai Qiji Zhifeng / Shanghai Innovation Institute
2610.18067.update_target: Aligned environments, tasks, verifiers, and trained cowork policy
2610.18067.mechanism_en: Dependency-closed factorial replay selects minimal compatible repairs; deterministic progress checks assign turn credit.
2610.18067.result_en: JobBench/OfficeQA Pro gains are 26.27/29.32 points, with +413.25 Elo on GDPval v2.
2610.18067.boundary_en: Separate recursive environment construction from subsequent policy training and preserve fixed evaluation constraints.
2610.18067.abstract_zh: 交互环境扩展对长周期智能体 RL 很重要，初次生成后常需测试和细化，修复任务还可能要求同步更新工作上下文与验证器；现有流水线较少支持保持组件一致的迭代改进。WorkRover 通过递归环境演化训练长周期协作工作智能体。框架驱动合成让构建智能体联合构造、验证语义一致的工作上下文、可执行任务、证据支撑验证器，依工作区状态和执行反馈调整动作，而非固定流程。因子兼容性重放（FCR）利用 rollout 反馈，通过依赖闭合重放评估组件修订组合，保留任务要求与评估约束，在已测试候选中选最小有效修复。验证器到轮次信用分配（VTCA）以确定性工作区进展检查增强轨迹 GRPO 优势，并依据工具输出和产物依赖，向前置轮次分配有界正进展信用。我们后训练 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 得到 WorkRover-35B-A3B，在 JobBench 高 26.27 个百分点，OfficeQA Pro 高 29.32 个百分点，GDPval v2 高 413.25 Elo 点，显示其可支持可扩展的长周期协作智能体训练。

2610.18083.title: AReaL-RSI: Adaptive Scaling and Coordination of Recursive Self-Improvement
2610.18083.authors: Wenhao Zhou , Jiajun Song , Haitao Wang , Zipeng Qiu , Yingqi Peng , Ruida Xu , Jiale Li , Wenshuang Li , Shusheng Xu , Wei Dong , Hao Dai , Tongkai Yang , Yi Gao , Binhang Yuan
2610.18083.abstract_en: Scaling recursive self-improvement requires additional computation to produce useful research progress in reaching persistent objectives. Intuitively, more researcher agents can explore more hypotheses, but early evaluation scores might misrepresent their promise, shared findings could lose their applicability conditions, and useful procedures could remain confined to completed investigations. In this paper, we present AReaL-RSI, a framework for organizing a persistent research team of agents without updating backbone LLM weights. We formulate the scaling problem in terms of evaluated outcomes and whole-system resource expenditure. Concretely, a leader agent selects task-appropriate research orientations and guides ongoing investigations; conditional memory sharing distinguishes unresolved problems from supported findings and enables recipient adaptation. During recursive evolution, after each campaign, evidence-based review revises researcher orientation, knowledge, and skills for later campaigns. Experiments compare AReaL-RSI with Codex-Goal on downstream harness optimization, GPU kernel optimization, and AI research tasks using two backbones. Under the reported resource allocations, AReaL-RSI improves Terminal Bench performance by 2.2 percentage points for each backbone and increases mean KernelBench speedup by 32.2-36.8%; further scalability comparisons favor the design of AReaL-RSI over native scaling: combining experience sharing with specialized researcher roles yields 1.9-27.5% lower kernel latency than independent exploration and 1.3-33.9% lower latency than sharing alone across all seven comparable task-backbone pairs.
2610.18083.update_target: Persistent research orientations, knowledge, and skills
2610.18083.mechanism_en: Leaders guide investigations; conditional sharing preserves evidence scope, and campaign reviews revise later researcher behavior.
2610.18083.result_en: Terminal Bench gains are 2.2 points per backbone; mean kernel speedup improves 32.2–36.8%.
2610.18083.boundary_en: Include all researchers and shared-memory costs; comparisons depend on reported whole-system allocations.
2610.18083.abstract_zh: 扩展 RSI 要让额外计算转化为面向持久目标的有效研究进展。更多研究智能体可探索更多假设，但早期分数可能误导，分享发现可能丢失适用条件，有用过程也可能困在已结束调查中。AReaL-RSI 组织持久研究团队而不更新主干权重，以评估结果和全系统资源消耗刻画扩展。领导者选择任务适配研究方向、引导调查；条件化记忆共享区分未解决问题和已获支持发现，并允许接收者适配。每轮研究后，证据审阅修订研究者方向、知识、技能，服务后续轮次。两个主干上，与 Codex-Goal 比较下游框架优化、GPU 内核优化、AI 研究。在报告资源分配下，两个主干的 Terminal Bench 均提高 2.2 个百分点，平均 KernelBench 加速提高 32.2%–36.8%。扩展比较中，经验共享结合专门角色优于原生扩展：七个可比任务—主干组合中，相比独立探索内核延迟低 1.9%–27.5%，相比仅共享低 1.3%–33.9%。

2610.18388.title: ReDiS: Reasoning-Diagnosis Self-Evolution for Multimodal Reasoning in Remote Sensing
2610.18388.authors: Yi Liu , Wentao Jiang , Shuo Ni , Zhiming Luo , Di Wang , Zengmao Wang , Jing Zhang , Bo Du
2610.18388.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for remote sensing understanding, yet reliable reasoning remains challenging when tasks require fine-grained visual grounding and multi-step inference. Existing approaches typically rely on either costly pre-constructed reasoning trajectories or self-generated signals such as response consistency, which can reinforce shared errors and provide unreliable supervision. We introduce \textbf{Reasoning--Diagnosis Self-Evolution (ReDiS)}, a framework that separates reasoning exploration from candidate evaluation while allowing the two processes to evolve jointly. ReDiS instantiates two role-specific experts from a shared multimodal backbone: a \textbf{Reasoner} that explores diverse visual evidence--answer candidates and a \textbf{Diagnoser} that jointly evaluates the complete candidate set and provides credibility-aware feedback. As the Reasoner evolves, it exposes new candidate distributions and failure modes; the Diagnoser adapts to these changes and, in turn, reshapes the learning signal for subsequent exploration. To handle groups in which all sampled answers are incorrect and group-relative advantages vanish, we further introduce \textbf{Failure-Triggered Recovery (FTR)}, which provides minimal outcome-level correction without prescribing intermediate reasoning trajectories. Experiments on LHRS-Bench, MME-RS, and CHOICE show consistent improvements over Qwen3.5 backbones at 0.8B, 2B, and 4B scales. ReDiS improves category-averaged accuracy by 6.47 percentage points at 0.8B, while ReDiS-4B achieves the highest average performance among the compared remote sensing MLLMs.
2610.18388.affiliation: Wuhan University / Zhongguancun Academy / Beijing Institute of Technology
2610.18388.mechanism_en: Candidate/failure distributions update the diagnoser, whose credibility feedback shapes later reasoning; FTR handles all-wrong groups.
2610.18388.result_en: 0.8B category-mean accuracy gains 6.47 points; 4B has the highest compared remote-sensing average.
2610.18388.boundary_en: Minimal outcome correction is extra supervision; shared-backbone errors still require independent assessment.
2610.18388.abstract_zh: 多模态 LLM 在遥感理解中潜力很大，但精细视觉定位与多步推理仍难可靠完成。既有方法依赖昂贵预构造轨迹，或响应一致性等自生成信号，可能强化共同错误。ReDiS 将推理探索与候选评估分开，同时让二者共同演化。共享多模态主干形成两个专用专家：推理者探索多种视觉证据—答案候选；诊断者联合评估完整候选集并提供可信度感知反馈。推理者演化暴露新候选分布和失败模式，诊断者适配变化，再改变后续探索的学习信号。对于采样答案全错、组相对优势消失的情况，失败触发恢复（FTR）提供最少的结果级纠正，不规定中间推理轨迹。在 LHRS-Bench、MME-RS、CHOICE 上，Qwen3.5 的 0.8B、2B、4B 均持续提升；0.8B 类别平均准确率提高 6.47 个百分点，ReDiS-4B 在所比较遥感 MLLM 中平均表现最高。

2610.18427.title: Reliable Memory from Unstable Growth: Curating Self-Written Agent Playbooks with Randomized Experiments
2610.18427.authors: Hoang Pham , Cong-Duy Nguyen , Dong Le , Ponhvoan Srey , Anh Tuan Luu
2610.18427.abstract_en: Persistent textual memory lets language-model agents reuse lessons from past tasks to improve on future multi-step tasks without retraining. Systems such as ACE and Dynamic Cheatsheet keep it as a playbook: lessons the agent writes after each task and reads in its prompt. A key challenge is to decide which lessons improve later tasks. Current systems leave the decision to the agent itself, which makes performance unstable: the same procedure can write a playbook that helps or one that falls up to 69.6 points below no playbook. These findings motivate valuing lessons by their measured effect on task success rather than by the agent's judgment. We propose Randomized Block Curation (RBC), which measures this effect with a randomized experiment on practice tasks. It groups related lessons into blocks large enough to move success measurably and, on each practice task, includes or leaves out every block at random. Random inclusion makes tasks with and without a block comparable, so the gap in their success estimates the block's effect. RBC keeps the blocks that help and, since the same procedure can write a helpful or a harmful playbook, grows several and serves whichever curated, whole or no playbook scores best on fresh practice episodes. Across two memory systems, three models and three benchmarks, RBC raises average success to 66.9, against 55.5 with the whole playbook, 54.1 with no playbook and 53.8 when the agent's own judgment picks the lessons to keep.
2610.18427.mechanism_en: Random block inclusion estimates causal utility on practice tasks; choose curated, full, or no playbook on fresh episodes.
2610.18427.result_en: Mean success is 66.9 versus 55.5 full, 54.1 none, and 53.8 agent-selected lessons.
2610.18427.boundary_en: Selection and practice budgets matter; self-written content can be harmful rather than uniformly useful.
2610.18427.abstract_zh: 持久文本记忆让语言智能体不训练也能复用旧任务经验，改善未来多步任务。ACE、Dynamic Cheatsheet 等把经验写成每次任务后更新、提示中读取的行动手册，但关键是判断哪些经验真正有用。目前由智能体自行判断，表现不稳定：同一流程可能写出有益手册，也可能比无手册低最多 69.6 点。因此，我们主张以任务成功的测量效果评价经验，而非自身判断。随机区组筛选（RBC）在练习任务上做随机实验：把相关经验分成足以可测影响成功的区组，每项练习随机包含或排除每个区组，使有无区组任务可比，由成功率差估计效果。保留有益区组；因生成过程可能有益也可能有害，它生成多个手册，在新练习回合选择筛选版、完整版或无手册中最佳者。两个记忆系统、三个模型、三个基准上，RBC 平均成功率 66.9，完整手册为 55.5，无手册 54.1，智能体自行选经验 53.8。

2610.18449.title: Autonomous Science Bench: Evaluating AI Agents for Autonomous Scientific Discovery
2610.18449.abstract_en: AI agents for autonomous scientific discovery must decide which experiments to run under a limited budget. Most benchmarks for science agents provide fixed datasets, while others that support active experimentation largely rely on simulation. We introduce Autonomous Science Bench, an initial release comprising six budgeted design-build-test-learn campaigns grounded in published experiments across biology, chemistry, and materials science. Agents select batches of designs, receive measurements from a lab service, and use the results to guide subsequent experiments before delivering a predictive model. Success requires passing two calibrated gates: a discovery gate, which evaluates the designs the agent measured, and a learning gate, which evaluates its model's ranking of held-out designs. In a pilot evaluation of eight agent-model configurations and 144 trials, the best configuration succeeds in 67% of trials, while the hardest campaign is solved in only three of 24 attempts. The two gates reveal different weaknesses: some agents build accurate rankings but find too few promising designs, while others find promising designs but fail to predict which unseen designs will perform well. These differences are obscured by overall success rates alone. We release version 0.1 of the campaigns, lab runtime, and public leaderboard at this https URL .
2610.18449.update_target: Budgeted autonomous discovery and learned rankings
2610.18449.mechanism_en: Six lab-service campaigns require both measured-design discovery and held-out model-ranking gates.
2610.18449.result_en: Eight configurations/144 trials yield 67% best success; the hardest campaign is solved in 3/24 attempts.
2610.18449.boundary_en: Published-experiment-grounded services are not evidence of autonomous new physical experiments in every evaluation.
2610.18449.abstract_zh: 自主科学发现智能体必须在有限预算下选择实验。多数科学基准使用固定数据，支持主动实验的又多依赖仿真。Autonomous Science Bench 初版包含六个预算约束的设计—构建—测试—学习研究轮次，依据生物、化学和材料领域已发表实验建立。智能体批量选择设计，从实验室服务获得测量，用结果指导后续实验，最后交付预测模型。成功须同时通过两个校准门：发现门评估实际测量的设计，学习门评估模型对留出设计的排序。八种智能体—模型配置、一百四十四次试验的初步评估中，最佳配置成功率 67%，最难研究轮次仅二十四次中的三次解决。双门揭示不同弱点：有些能准确排序却未找到足够优良设计，另一些发现优良设计却不能预测未见设计。总体成功率会掩盖这种差异。我们发布研究轮次、实验室运行系统和公开排行榜的 0.1 版，见原摘要链接。

2610.18484.title: ReTerm: Recovery Training for Self-Improving Terminal Agents
2610.18484.authors: Wei Xie , Kaituo Feng , Shiming Fu , Yong Liu , Xiangyu Yue , Shuangjia Zheng
2610.18484.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Machine Learning (cs.LG); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
2610.18484.abstract_en: Terminal agents have shown strong abilities in complex coding tasks. However, they often struggle to recover from errors during long-running execution (e.g., command errors, faulty implementations), eventually leading to task failures. To this end, we present ReTerm, a self-improving terminal agent trained by learning how to recover from its own failed terminal tasks. To support its training, we construct a customized data pipeline and produce ReTerm-10K, a high-quality dataset that provides effective recovery demonstrations for SFT cold start. Furthermore, we propose ReTerm-GRPO, an online RL algorithm that forks from the agent's own failure states to generate multiple independent self-recovery attempts. By learning from whether these attempts successfully complete the task, the agent self-improves through its own recovery experience. Built on Qwen3.5-9B, our ReTerm-9B achieves 34.8% Pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 2.0, improving over the base model by 14.6 points. Further analysis shows that our method achieves consistently higher recovery rates across diverse error categories compared with standard GRPO training. All code, data and model are released at this https URL .
2610.18484.affiliation: Fudan University / CUHK MMLab / Shanghai Jiao Tong University
2610.18484.update_target: Recovery policy trained on self-generated failure branches
2610.18484.mechanism_en: SFT recovery demonstrations bootstrap online GRPO that forks independent recovery attempts from policy failures.
2610.18484.result_en: ReTerm-9B reaches 34.8% Terminal-Bench 2.0 Pass@1, +14.6 points over base.
2610.18484.boundary_en: Separate cold-start demonstrations from online self-recovery gains.
2610.18484.abstract_zh: 终端智能体擅长复杂代码任务，但长时间执行中的命令错误、错误实现等常难恢复，最终导致任务失败。ReTerm 通过学习从自身失败终端任务恢复实现自改进。专门数据流水线构建高质量 ReTerm-10K，为 SFT 冷启动提供恢复演示；在线 ReTerm-GRPO 从自身失败状态分叉，生成多个独立恢复尝试，按能否完成任务学习，从自身恢复经验改善。基于 Qwen3.5-9B 的 ReTerm-9B 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 达到 34.8% Pass@1，比基础模型高 14.6 点。进一步分析显示，多种错误类别的恢复率持续高于标准 GRPO。全部代码、数据和模型已通过原摘要链接发布。

2610.18688.title: RSIgen: Reciprocal Self-Improvement for Agentic Visual Generation
2610.18688.authors: Yidi Liu , Haozhe Wang , Jie Xiao , Kai Zhu , Xueyang Fu , Zheng-Jun Zha
2610.18688.abstract_en: Agentic visual generation produces experience that can improve the native understanding (agent) and generation roles of a unified multimodal backbone, but task success alone does not determine which role should learn. Generator updates can also make the agent's action supervision stale. We introduce RSIgen, a task-centric reciprocal self-improvement framework linking learning allocation, supervision refresh, and recursive curriculum construction. Dynamic Responsibility Routing (DRR) uses matched interventions on evidence, inputs, and supported actions to select learning recipients and construct compatible training targets. After generator learning, RSIgen re-evaluates the relative utility of tested actions with branch inputs held fixed to refresh agent supervision; the retained roles then construct the next curriculum. Across BAGEL, Qwen-Image, and Wan-Image-7B, RSIgen improves AgentGen-Bench Full Overall9 by 3.2--3.3 points over a three-cycle SearchGen adaptation with action costs. Wan controls support allocation gains at matched role-level training exposure, refresh gains at a matched adaptation budget, and benefits from updated curriculum sources while recipients continue learning. In blind evaluation on 200 real-user requests, pooled tie-adjusted preference scores against the same baseline reach 70.0% for task completion and 64.9% for visual quality.
2610.18688.affiliation: University of Science and Technology of China / Wan Team, Alibaba Group / Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
2610.18688.update_target: Visual agent/generator roles and refreshed action supervision
2610.18688.mechanism_en: Matched interventions allocate learning; generator changes trigger action-utility refresh before retained roles build the next curriculum.
2610.18688.result_en: Overall9 improves 3.2–3.3 points; 200-request blind preferences are 70.0% completion and 64.9% quality.
2610.18688.boundary_en: Responsibility routing and refresh need matched role exposure and adaptation budgets; preferences are author reports.
2610.18688.abstract_zh: 智能体视觉生成的经验可以改善统一多模态主干的理解与生成角色，但任务成功本身不能决定谁应学习，生成器更新也会使智能体动作监督过时。RSIgen 以任务为中心，将学习分配、监督刷新、递归课程构造联结成相互自改进框架。动态责任路由（DRR）对证据、输入、受支持动作进行匹配干预，选择学习接收方并构建兼容目标。生成器学习后，在分支输入固定时重新评估测试动作的相对效用，刷新智能体监督；保留的角色再构建下一课程。在 BAGEL、Qwen-Image、Wan-Image-7B 上，相比考虑动作成本的三周期 SearchGen 适配，AgentGen-Bench Full Overall9 高 3.2–3.3 点。Wan 的受控实验在匹配角色训练暴露下支持分配收益、匹配适配预算下支持刷新收益，并显示接收方持续学习时，更新课程来源的益处。在二百个真实用户请求的盲评中，相比同基线，汇总、平局校正偏好分数达到任务完成 70.0%、视觉质量 64.9%。

2610.18792.title: SEAR: Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics
2610.18792.authors: Xinyi Wang , Bangzheng Li , Hanyu Wang , Lin Zhang , Andrea Yaoyun Cui , Zhenggang Tang , Shyamal Buch , Dejia Xu
2610.18792.categories_text: Robotics (cs.RO) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2610.18792.abstract_en: Frontier language-model agents can now improve robots on their own: they write control code, test it, and keep what works as skills and memories for the next task. We introduce SEAR (Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics), a framework and benchmark built around two questions. Is the agent really learning, or just trying more often? And does what it learns still help on new tasks, in a new simulator, and on a real robot? The framework runs an agent in three modes: it writes code that becomes the policy (code-as-policy), acts live in the control loop (agent-as-policy), or works as a researcher that fine-tunes a vision-language-action model (auto-research). The benchmark adds controls that separate retained experience from repeated attempts, familiar tasks, privileged simulator state, larger budgets, and luck. Across seven frontier language models, 330 simulated and five physical tasks, and over four years of agent runtime, we highlight three findings. First, the learning curve of a robotic agent depends both on the overall time budget and the task difficulty relative to model capability. Harder tasks make longer sessions worthwhile; on easier tasks, re-rolling short attempts does just as well. Second, control code and shared routines transfer across tasks and simulators, while task-specific solutions do not. On a real robot, we observe a performance gap between agent-designed practice and novel human-designed scenes. Third, different models evolve more effectively in different ways. Some do best acting live, others writing code first. And a text-only model keeps pace with a comparable multimodal one: perception helps with error assessment, but agentic reasoning and tool use can matter more. We release the benchmark and codebase to support future research.
2610.18792.update_target: Durable robotic experience versus repeated attempts
2610.18792.mechanism_en: Three execution modes and controls isolate retention, task familiarity, privileged state, budgets, and luck.
2610.18792.result_en: Seven models cover 330 simulated/five physical tasks; shared routines transfer, while task-specific solutions do not.
2610.18792.boundary_en: More attempts can match learning on easy tasks; agent-designed practice differs from novel human scenes.
2610.18792.abstract_zh: 前沿语言模型智能体可以编写机器人控制代码、测试，并把有效内容保存为后续任务的技能和记忆。SEAR 框架与基准关注两问：究竟在学习还是仅多次尝试？学到的内容能否迁移至新任务、新仿真器和真机器人？框架含三种模式：代码成为策略、智能体在线控制、研究者微调 VLA。基准用对照区分保留经验与重复尝试、熟悉任务、特权仿真状态、更大预算及运气。七个前沿模型、330 个仿真任务、五个物理任务、合计超过四年智能体运行中有三项发现。第一，学习曲线取决于总时间及任务相对能力的难度；难题使长会话更有价值，易题反复短尝试一样有效。第二，控制代码和共享例程可跨任务、仿真器迁移，专用任务解不能；真机器人中，智能体设计练习与人类新设计场景存在表现差距。第三，不同模型适合不同进化方式，有些在线行动最好，有些先编代码最好；纯文本模型能匹配相近多模态模型，感知有助错误评估，但智能体推理和工具使用可能更关键。我们发布基准与代码。

2610.18807.title: SkillScaffold: Scaffolding Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Policy-Adaptive Skill Credit Assignment and Selective Injection
2610.18807.authors: Wenlin Zhong , Hao Wang , Kun Yuan , Fan Yang , Jinluan Yang , Dian Jin , Xu Tan , Yiquan Wu , Kun Kuang
2610.18807.abstract_en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to learn from multi-turn interactions with verifiable outcomes. Textual skills can improve exploration by distilling prior interactions into reusable guidance. However, existing skill-based RL approaches often either assume skill injection is beneficial or rely on indirect feedback or rollout-intensive evaluation to assess its utility. Our pilot studies show that rollout-based utility estimation for skill credit assignment is costly and unstable under limited sampling, while skill benefits vary across candidates and depend on the current policy's competence on each query. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillScaffold, a policy-adaptive training scaffold that combines low-cost skill-utility estimation with selective skill injection. By reusing outcome-verified training trajectories, SkillScaffold generates candidate skills and estimates their utility through outcome-aware likelihood comparisons, without candidate-specific environment rollouts. The resulting utility guides whether and which skill to inject, retaining skill-free execution when no candidate is estimated to help. Joint training enables the Generator to produce skills tailored to the evolving Executor. Scaffolded RL encourages skill internalization for skill-free inference. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, ScienceWorld, and $\tau^2$-Bench demonstrate gains over strong agentic-RL and skill-based RL baselines across both short- and long-horizon tasks. Ablations and further analyses support the importance of utility-based selection and abstention. Our code is available at this https URL .
2610.18807.affiliation: Zhejiang University / Kuaishou Technology / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / Zhejiang University of Science and Technology
2610.18807.mechanism_en: Verified trajectories estimate outcome-aware skill utility without per-candidate rollouts; selective injection co-adapts with executor learning.
2610.18807.result_en: Four interactive benchmarks show gains and ablations support selection and abstention.
2610.18807.boundary_en: Estimated utility can be noisy; absence of a useful skill should permit skill-free execution.
2610.18807.abstract_zh: 智能体 RL 可从具有可验证结果的多轮交互学习，文本技能把旧交互蒸馏成可复用指导，改善探索。但已有技能 RL 常假设注入有益，或依赖间接反馈、高 rollout 成本评估效用。先导研究显示，有限采样下基于 rollout 的效用估计昂贵、不稳定，技能收益还随候选及当前策略对查询的能力变化。SkillScaffold 结合低成本效用估计与选择性注入，复用结果已验证的训练轨迹生成技能，通过结果感知似然比较估计效用，无需为候选单独运行环境。估计决定是否注入、注入哪个技能；没有候选有望有益时保持无技能执行。联合训练让生成者产出适应持续演化执行者的技能，支架式 RL 鼓励技能内化，以备无技能推理。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld、τ²-Bench 的长短周期任务上，均优于强智能体 RL 与技能 RL 基线；消融支持效用选择和拒绝注入的重要性。代码见原摘要链接。

2610.18813.title: Self-Evolving Agent Harness
2610.18813.authors: Chuyang Wei , Haoxiang Guan , Minghang Zhu , Kexin Zhou , Jiyan He , Xiren Zhou , Huanhuan Chen , Yifei Shen
2610.18813.abstract_en: Harness self-evolution revises an agent's software scaffolding, including prompts, memory, workflows, and executable components, while keeping model weights fixed. We formalize a feedback-driven process in which accepted revisions persist across runs. The framework separates update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms. It distinguishes changes to interpreted state from revisions to tools and code, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. We characterize search through evolutionary optimization and examine its reliability through continual PAC-learning. Under explicit assumptions, the analysis yields an expected generalization bound, a retention bound conditional on historical regression budgets, and a high-probability admission rule using fresh, independent validation data. We examine how persistent harness revisions affect knowledge sharing and organizational workflows, with implications for scientific reliability, physical safety, and institutional accountability. Cases from prior work illustrate model--harness co-design, distributed execution, and plugin reuse. Reliable deployment requires continual validation as task distributions and evaluators change, with independent safeguards for learning, runtime privileges, and consequential actions. We provide a comprehensive 66-page discussion of related work, theory, algorithms, evaluation, applications, and the broader impact of Harness RSI, together with continuously updated code and supplementary materials, at this https URL .
2610.18813.affiliation: Zhongguancun Academy / USTC / Zhongguancun Institute of Artificial Intelligence
2610.18813.update_target: Formal foundations of persistent harness evolution
2610.18813.mechanism_en: Separate update targets/admission; conditional PAC analysis derives generalization, retention, and fresh-validation rules.
2610.18813.result_en: A 66-page synthesis provides theory and prior-work cases rather than a new independently verified universal RSI system.
2610.18813.boundary_en: Bounds require explicit assumptions and continually independent validation as tasks/evaluators change.
2610.18813.abstract_zh: 框架自进化在冻结权重时，修订提示、记忆、工作流和可执行组件。我们形式化反馈驱动、获准修改跨运行持久保留的过程，区分更新对象与提案、准入机制，并区分解释型状态、工具代码、仓库级控制逻辑、插件组合的变化。用进化优化刻画搜索，用持续 PAC 学习分析可靠性。在明确假设下，给出期望泛化界、以历史回归预算为条件的保留界，以及依靠新鲜独立验证数据的高概率准入规则。我们讨论持久修订对知识共享和组织工作流的影响，以及科学可靠性、物理安全、制度责任。已有案例说明模型—框架协同设计、分布执行与插件复用。任务分布和评估器变化时，可靠部署需要持续验证，并对学习、运行权限及有后果动作设置独立保障。我们提供六十六页关于相关工作、理论、算法、评估、应用和广泛影响的综合讨论，以及持续更新代码与补充材料，见原摘要链接。

2610.18842.title: Who Improves the Robot? Toward Physical Recursive Self-Improvement
2610.18842.authors: Hai Zhou , Fan Yang , Zeyi Chen , Lejun Zhang , Chenyang Fu , Jianping Li , Jiayi Zhu , Xianyang Liu , Yingxuan Yang , Lili Meng , Lu Wang , Xinyang Han , Jiankai Sun , Weirui Ye , Guanchu Wang , Wanhua Li , Ming Zhou , Boyi Li , Ming Jin , Kun Shao , Muhao Chen , Guang Chen , Lei Ma , Joey Tianyi Zhou , Costas Spanos , Xia Hu , Mac Schwager , Weinan Zhang , Qian Feng , Shangding Gu
2610.18842.abstract_en: Robots are increasingly autonomous in task execution, yet their improvement remains largely human-driven. This study investigates Physical Recursive Self-Improvement (Physical RSI), in which physical experience guides lasting updates to both a robot's capabilities and its improvement procedure, making subsequent improvement more effective across tasks. Physical RSI faces challenges from noisy observations, continuous dynamics, costly trials, and irreversible consequences. We present an L0-L5 framework that differentiates capability-level from meta-level updates and within-task from across-task gains, reserving L5 for independently verified recursive gain. We study existing methods around harness adaptation and model training, alongside safety and control mechanisms that govern execution and successive updates. Our analysis reveals that, despite substantial progress in self-improvement, the surveyed literature does not yet demonstrate Physical RSI as defined by our framework. We identify research priorities in reliable feedback, causal attribution, safety preservation, and benchmarking, outlining a path toward robots that autonomously improve how they learn while ensuring safety. The GitHub repository for Physical RSI is available at this https URL .
2610.18842.affiliation: Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Google / Microsoft / UC Berkeley / Stanford University / MIT / Shanghai AI Laboratory / Nanyang Technological University / NVIDIA / Virginia Tech / Xiaomi / UC Davis / Tongji University / University of Tokyo / Singapore Management University / Technical University of Munich
2610.18842.update_target: A taxonomy for physical capability versus meta-improvement
2610.18842.mechanism_en: L0–L5 separates task scope and update level, reserving L5 for independently verified recursive gain.
2610.18842.result_en: The surveyed literature does not demonstrate Physical RSI under the paper’s definition.
2610.18842.boundary_en: This is an analytical framework; avoid treating every capability gain as improved improvement machinery.
2610.18842.abstract_zh: 机器人任务执行越来越自主，但改进仍主要由人类推动。本文研究物理递归自改进：物理经验指导机器人能力及其改进程序的持久更新，使后续跨任务改进更有效。挑战包括噪声观测、连续动力学、昂贵试验和不可逆后果。我们提出 L0–L5 框架，区分能力与元层级更新、任务内与跨任务收益，L5 专指独立验证的递归收益。围绕框架适配和模型训练研究已有方法，并考察治理执行和连续更新的安全控制机制。分析显示，尽管自改进已有显著进展，所综述文献仍未展示符合本文定义的物理 RSI。我们提出可靠反馈、因果归因、安全保持和基准等研究重点，勾勒机器人自主改善学习方式且保持安全的路径。物理 RSI 的 GitHub 仓库见原摘要链接。

2610.18867.title: EmbodiedEvo: Self-improving Coding Agents for Physical Intelligence
2610.18867.authors: Wenyi Li , Yizhe Chi , Youjie Zheng , Chunyu Liu , Xiaoqiu Wang , Mingju Gao , Zheng Jiang , Deyao Hong , Calvin Xiao , Kaisen Yang , Qinhuai Na
2610.18867.abstract_en: Bringing general-purpose agents into the physical world calls for an executable representation of physical intelligence. Compared with vision-language-action (VLA) models, which map observations and language instructions directly to actions, code makes control logic explicit and reusable. Code can serve not only as a policy representation but also as the workspace in which the agent solves a task. Rather than following a prescribed workflow of planning, execution, and verification, the agent can autonomously inspect the state, revise and execute code, and use feedback to choose the next step. The success of this SWE-style loop in digital environments motivates its extension to physical tasks. Yet physical execution remains prone to recurring failures. To retain and refine experience for later scenes, we introduce EmbodiedEvo, where a coding agent evolves reusable Skills and Lessons through feedback on a single Playground scene, then freezes the resulting harness for diverse new scenes. On RoboDojo-Sim, EmbodiedEvo achieves an average score of 44.48 and a success rate of 37.82\%, surpassing all officially verified results. Paired tests show the largest gains on memory-dependent tasks and successful reuse of coordinated procedures, while fine contact control remains difficult. Experience from stronger models also improves weaker executors: Astra's experience raises Sol and Luna's success rates by 8.86 and 5.50 percentage points over no experience. Compared with raw interaction history, Skills and Lessons achieve comparable task performance at 53.0\% lower execution cost.
2610.18867.affiliation: Navers Lab / Einsia.AI / Tsinghua University (as stated)
2610.18867.update_target: Reusable Skills and Lessons learned in one physical playground
2610.18867.mechanism_en: A coding agent learns from scene feedback, then freezes its harness for diverse unseen scenes.
2610.18867.result_en: RoboDojo-Sim score is 44.48, success 37.82%; execution cost falls 53.0% versus raw history at comparable performance.
2610.18867.boundary_en: These headline results are simulation evidence; fine contact remains difficult and frozen transfer is not ongoing test-time evolution.
2610.18867.abstract_zh: 把通用智能体带入物理世界，需要可执行的物理智能表示。相比把观测和指令直接映射为动作的 VLA，代码让控制逻辑显式、可复用，也可作为智能体解决任务的工作空间。智能体无需遵循预定规划—执行—验证流程，可自主检查状态、改写和运行代码，并据反馈选择下一步。数字环境中软件工程式循环的成功，推动其扩展到物理任务，但物理执行仍易出现重复失败。EmbodiedEvo 让编码智能体在单个 Playground 场景中，依据反馈演化可复用技能和经验，再冻结所得框架用于不同新场景。在 RoboDojo-Sim 上，平均分 44.48、成功率 37.82%，超过所有官方验证结果。配对测试中，记忆依赖任务收益最大，协作过程成功复用，但细致接触控制仍困难。强模型经验还能帮助弱执行器：Astra 经验使 Sol、Luna 成功率相比无经验高 8.86、5.50 个百分点。相比原始交互历史，技能与经验在相近表现下减少 53.0% 执行成本。

2610.15617.title: Screening Collapse under Recursive Synthetic Data
2610.15617.abstract_en: Recursive synthetic-data training can degrade a fitted model, but its effects on the variable-screening stage that precedes model fitting are less understood. When each generation labels data for the next, a marginal screener ranks variables against the current pseudo-label target rather than the original response. Across generations, this target drift can erode or reverse the active--inactive score margin and cause screening to discard variables that clean-label screening would retain. We call this process \emph{screening collapse}. In a Gaussian linear model with minimum-norm recursive generators, we establish finite-sample screening bounds, characterize a late-generation information-loss limit, and derive a minimax impossibility result. Screening collapse can precede and compound ordinary model collapse: omitted variables incur a covariance-weighted loss that no refit restricted to the selected variables can eliminate, while recursive labels further degrade estimation on the retained variables. We also examine two approaches to mitigating screening collapse. Fixed-fraction real-label retention preserves a clean-label component but leaves resolution fixed, whereas data accumulation can avoid screening collapse if the pooled target preserves a positive margin and the growing sample resolves it. Numerical experiments on gene-expression data support the theoretical findings.
2610.15617.affiliation: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics / Southern University of Science and Technology
2610.15617.mechanism_en: Gaussian theory tracks score-margin drift, omitted-variable loss, real-label retention, and growing-data conditions.
2610.15617.result_en: Finite-sample bounds, a minimax limitation, and gene-expression experiments support screening collapse before fitting.
2610.15617.boundary_en: Conditional theory is not a claim that all synthetic-data training collapses; mitigation requires margin and sample conditions.
2610.15617.abstract_zh: 递归合成数据训练会使拟合模型退化，但对拟合前变量筛选的影响尚不清楚。每代给下一代标注时，边缘筛选器依据当前伪标签而非原响应排序变量。跨代目标漂移会侵蚀甚至反转活跃与非活跃变量的分数间隔，丢弃干净标签筛选本会保留的变量，我们称之为筛选崩塌。在采用最小范数递归生成器的高斯线性模型中，建立有限样本筛选界，刻画后期信息损失极限，并给出极小极大不可能结果。筛选崩塌可早于、并加剧普通模型崩塌：遗漏变量造成协方差加权损失，仅在所选变量上重新拟合无法消除，递归标签还恶化保留变量上的估计。我们考察两种缓解方法：固定比例保留真实标签可保留干净成分，却保持固定分辨率；数据积累若维持正间隔、增长样本能分辨该间隔，则可避免筛选崩塌。基因表达数据的数值实验支持理论。

2610.19062.title: RLPE: Teaching LLMs to Prompt with Reinforcement Learning
2610.19062.authors: Rahul Singhal , Karime Maamari , Pradyumna Tambwekar
2610.19062.abstract_en: Prompting is a widely used method for adapting general-purpose LLMs to domain-specific tasks. Effective prompts can be tedious to create manually, so prompt writing is increasingly handed to LLMs, with recent work training LLMs to write prompts for other models. These techniques either write prompts without observing how the task model behaves, blind to the failure modes the prompt should address, or must run alongside the task LLM at inference time, adding overhead to every query. Neither reflects how prompt engineering is often practiced. To close this gap, we introduce Reinforcement Learned Prompt Engineering (RLPE), which trains a model to analyze traces of a separate task model and write a prompt targeting the failures it observes. RLPE rewards the trained model strictly on prompt performance, so it learns the prompting strategies that improve the task model. The prompt is generated once and reused across the task, so inference does not require the trained model. Since RLPE needs only query access to the model it prompts, it is also compatible with closed-source models. We apply RLPE to Enigmata, BIG-Bench Extra Hard, and PlanBench. We train a 9B-parameter model that writes better prompts than state-of-the-art frontier models (gpt-5.6-sol and claude-opus-5) and prompt optimizers (GEPA and TextGrad) on 2/3 benchmarks. Although the model is never explicitly trained to iterate on prompts, this capability emerges at a level that matches or beats frontier models. The learned prompting capability also generalizes, with the trained model improving task models 6x larger than the one it trained with, including ones from entirely different model families, and matching claude-opus-5 on a fourth benchmark held out from training.
2610.19062.abstract_zh: 提示是一种广泛用于将通用大语言模型适配到特定领域任务的方法。编写有效提示往往繁琐且费力，因此这项工作越来越多地交给大语言模型，近期研究也开始训练模型为其他模型编写提示。这些技术要么在不观察任务模型行为的情况下编写提示，因而不了解提示应解决的失败模式；要么必须在推理时与任务大语言模型并行运行，为每次查询增加开销。这两种方式都不符合实际提示工程的常见做法。为弥合这一差距，我们提出强化学习提示工程（RLPE），训练一个模型分析独立任务模型的执行轨迹，并编写针对所观察失败的提示。RLPE 严格依据提示的任务表现奖励受训模型，使其学会能够改进任务模型的提示策略。提示只生成一次，随后在整个任务中复用，因此推理阶段不需要受训的提示模型。由于 RLPE 只需查询被提示模型，它也兼容闭源模型。我们将 RLPE 应用于 Enigmata、BIG-Bench Extra Hard 和 PlanBench。我们训练了一个 9B 参数模型，其编写的提示在三个基准中的两个上优于最先进的前沿模型（gpt-5.6-sol 和 claude-opus-5）及提示优化器（GEPA 和 TextGrad）。虽然模型没有被显式训练为迭代修改提示，但它涌现出的迭代能力达到或超过前沿模型。所学提示能力也具有泛化性：受训模型能够改进规模为训练时任务模型六倍的模型，包括来自完全不同模型家族的模型，并在第四个、训练时完全留出的基准上达到 claude-opus-5 的水平。
2610.19062.update_target: Prompt-writing model weights and reusable task prompts
2610.19062.mechanism_en: Task-model traces expose failures; prompt performance rewards train the writer, and the generated prompt is reused without the writer at inference.
2610.19062.result_en: A 9B prompt writer beats compared frontier writers and optimizers on two of three benchmarks; transfer includes models six times larger.
2610.19062.boundary_en: Iterative prompting emerges without explicit iteration training; count writer training and trace collection, not just deployment cost.

2610.19422.title: AgentSafeEvo: Adversarial Co-Evolution for LLM Agent Safety
2610.19422.authors: Chenxu Wang , Xiaoyu Wen , Han Qi , Ziyuan Zhou , Cheng Jin , Chaochao Lu , Qiaosheng Zhang
2610.19422.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents accomplish complex tasks through multi-turn interactions with external tools. However, malicious content embedded in user queries, tool descriptions, or environment observations can manipulate their decisions and induce unsafe actions. Adversarial co-evolution has emerged as an effective approach to strengthening LLM safety, but existing work primarily focuses on language-level safety or indirect prompt injection in web tasks. In this paper, we introduce AgentSafeEvo, a co-evolutionary reinforcement learning framework for agent safety built on an attacker-defender game spanning diverse tasks and attack types. The attacker learns to construct adversarial agent tasks that expose weaknesses in the defender's tool use, while the defender learns to complete tasks safely under these attacks. We further introduce learnability-guided task weighting, which uses within-task defender-reward variability to adjust each task's contribution to attacker and defender updates. Extensive experiments on agent safety and general capability benchmarks demonstrate that our method improves adversarial robustness while maintaining general agent capabilities.
2610.19422.affiliation: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory / Fudan University / Shanghai Jiaotong University / Zhejiang University
2610.19422.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过与外部工具的多轮交互完成复杂任务。然而，嵌入用户查询、工具描述或环境观测中的恶意内容能够操纵其决策并诱发不安全行为。对抗协同进化已成为增强大语言模型安全性的有效途径，但现有研究主要关注语言层面的安全性，或网页任务中的间接提示注入。本文提出 AgentSafeEvo，一种面向智能体安全的协同进化强化学习框架，以覆盖多样任务和攻击类型的攻击者—防御者博弈为基础。攻击者学习构建能够暴露防御者工具使用弱点的对抗性智能体任务，防御者则学习在这些攻击下安全地完成任务。我们进一步提出由可学习性引导的任务加权，利用同一任务内防御者奖励的变异程度，调整各任务对攻击者和防御者更新的贡献。在智能体安全和通用能力基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在保持通用智能体能力的同时提高了对抗鲁棒性。
2610.19422.mechanism_en: Adversarial tasks expose tool-use weaknesses; within-task defender-reward variability weights reciprocal RL updates.
2610.19422.result_en: Agent-safety and general-capability evaluations show improved measured robustness with general capability maintained.
2610.19422.boundary_en: This is bounded adversarial co-training; robustness to evaluated attackers does not establish safety against arbitrary future opponents.

2610.19424.title: VideoHarness-SRSI: Structured Recursive Self-Improvement for Video Understanding Harness
2610.19424.authors: Zihao Lin , Haoyu Dong , Haobo Xu , Chi-Chih Chang , Xuying Ning , Yinglong Xia , Shuang Yang , Zhuokai Zhao , Xinying Song , Dongfang Liu , Lifu Huang , Yang Song , Qifan Wang
2610.19424.categories_text: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
2610.19424.abstract_en: LLM system capabilities depend not only on model parameters but also on the executable harnesses that organize information acquisition, tool use, reasoning, and memory. Recursive harness evolution can automate their design, but how it can reliably discover generalizable systems from limited, noisy, and repeatedly reused feedback remains unclear. We study this question in agentic video understanding, where rich multimodal evidence and coupled mechanisms make harness optimization challenging. We first introduce VideoHarness-BRSI, a recursive self-improvement framework that evolves video harnesses around a frozen vision-language model. Analyzing over 4,000 evolved candidates, we find it competitive with hand-engineered systems but identify three interconnected failure modes: validation overfitting, search-budget dilution, and the early-experience trap. We trace all three to a common root: the same imperfect validation evidence drives both harness revisions and the proposer's search strategy. We therefore propose VideoHarness-SRSI, an evidence-governed framework in which every search decision rests on evidence that is transferable, sufficient, and gathered before the search commits. It restricts the proposer to content-free feedback, informs exploration with instrumented warm-up experiments, and develops mechanisms in isolated probe-race branches before factorial composition and joint refinement. Across four video understanding benchmarks, VideoHarness-SRSI improves the equally weighted mean held-out score by 6.2% relative to VideoHarness-BRSI and reduces the mean validation-test gap by 37.9%. Reliable harness evolution thus depends on how search is organized and informed, not only on how well it optimizes validation performance.
2610.19424.affiliation: University of California, Davis / Meta MRS Research / Duke University / University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign / Cornell University / Purdue University
2610.19424.abstract_zh: 大语言模型系统的能力不仅取决于模型参数，也取决于组织信息获取、工具使用、推理和记忆的可执行运行框架。递归框架进化可以自动设计这些系统，但在反馈有限、有噪声且被反复使用的情况下，它如何可靠地发现具有泛化能力的系统仍不清楚。我们在智能体视频理解场景中研究这一问题；丰富的多模态证据和相互耦合的机制使框架优化尤为困难。我们首先提出 VideoHarness-BRSI，一种围绕冻结视觉语言模型进化视频框架的递归自我改进方法。通过分析超过 4,000 个进化候选，我们发现它能够与人工设计的系统竞争，但存在三个相互关联的失败模式：验证集过拟合、搜索预算稀释和早期经验陷阱。我们将三者追溯到同一个根源：相同的不完美验证证据同时驱动框架修改和提议者的搜索策略。因此，我们提出证据约束的 VideoHarness-SRSI，要求每个搜索决策所依据的证据具有可迁移性、充分性，并在搜索作出承诺之前获得。它限制提议者只接收不包含具体内容的反馈，通过带有仪器化记录的预热实验指导探索，并先在隔离的探测竞赛分支中发展机制，再进行析因组合与联合细化。在四个视频理解基准上，VideoHarness-SRSI 相对于 VideoHarness-BRSI 将等权平均留出分数提高 6.2%，并将平均验证—测试差距缩小 37.9%。因此，可靠的框架进化取决于搜索如何组织及获取信息，而不只是验证性能优化得如何。
2610.19424.update_target: Executable video harness and the proposer search process
2610.19424.mechanism_en: Content-free feedback, instrumented warm-up and isolated probe-race branches precede factorial composition and refinement.
2610.19424.result_en: Across four benchmarks, held-out mean improves 6.2% relative to BRSI; mean validation-test gap falls 37.9%.
2610.19424.boundary_en: More than 4000 baseline candidates reveal overfitting and budget dilution; improvement is to frozen-model harness/search organization, not model weights.

2610.19454.title: AdCoEvo: A Co-Evolving Multi-Agent Advertising Delivery System
2610.19454.authors: Tianzhu Hu , Hang Yu , Zeyuan Zhao , Zeyu Pan , Huan Luo , Chun Gan , Mingzhe Cao , Liubin Wang , Mingming Li , Jiao Dai , Jizhong Han , Songlin Hu
2610.19454.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Information Retrieval (cs.IR); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
2610.19454.abstract_en: Digital advertising is an important means for platforms to reach potential users and drive business growth. Advertising delivery is the core link between marketing objectives and actual returns. Existing methods have achieved partial automation in individual tasks such as bidding and budget allocation, but they still rely on human operators for overall coordination, making it difficult to support large-scale operations. They also often fail to achieve optimal performance, and individual experience remains difficult to turn into reusable operational capabilities. In addition, as advertising markets change, advertising delivery systems need timely strategy updates to remain effective in dynamic markets. To automate the entire advertising operations process and improve adaptability to market changes, we propose AdCoEvo, a co-evolving multi-agent advertising delivery system. Specifically, the system connects delivery decisions across different timescales and operational granularities through role specialization. Diagnostic results guide account planning and strategy adjustment in the next period. The multi-agent system updates its model parameters based on actual delivery outcomes and continually improves delivery strategies through mutual feedback among planning, adjustment, and diagnosis, thereby achieving co-evolution. Experiments show that, relative to the rule-based operational baseline (Rule), AdCoEvo increases advertiser value by 14.02% while reducing cost per acquisition by 7.07%. Compared with a multi-agent system with fixed parameters, AdCoEvo increases advertiser value by 3.96% and reduces cost per acquisition by 1.24%, indicating that co-evolution can yield greater delivery returns.
2610.19454.affiliation: Institute of Information Engineering, CAS / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences / University of Sydney / JD.COM
