2610.19454.abstract_zh: 数字广告是平台触达潜在用户、推动业务增长的重要手段，广告投放是连接营销目标与实际回报的核心环节。现有方法已实现竞价、预算分配等单项任务的部分自动化，但整体协调仍依赖人工运营，难以支撑大规模操作；它们也常常无法达到最优效果，个体经验难以转化为可复用的运营能力。此外，广告市场不断变化，投放系统需要及时更新策略，才能在动态市场中保持有效。为实现广告运营全流程自动化并提高市场变化适应能力，我们提出协同进化多智能体广告投放系统 AdCoEvo。具体而言，系统通过角色分工连接不同时间尺度和运营粒度的投放决策，诊断结果指导下一周期的账户规划和策略调整。多智能体系统根据实际投放结果更新模型参数，并通过规划、调整和诊断之间的相互反馈持续改进投放策略，从而实现协同进化。实验表明，相对于基于规则的运营基线（Rule），AdCoEvo 将广告主价值提高 14.02%，同时将单次获客成本降低 7.07%；相对于参数固定的多智能体系统，AdCoEvo 将广告主价值提高 3.96%，将单次获客成本降低 1.24%，说明协同进化能够带来更高的投放回报。
2610.19454.update_target: Planning, adjustment and diagnosis model parameters
2610.19454.mechanism_en: Settled delivery outcomes train role parameters; diagnosis guides the next period and roles exchange feedback.
2610.19454.result_en: Versus fixed-parameter agents, advertiser value rises 3.96% and acquisition cost falls 1.24%; rule-baseline gains are larger.
2610.19454.boundary_en: Keep fixed-agent and rule comparisons separate; business outcomes do not by themselves isolate general improvement of the learning algorithm.

2610.19725.title: TimeRSI: Towards Self-Improved Agentic Deployment for Time-Series Foundation Models
2610.19725.authors: Haoxin Liu , Deqing Fu , Lucheng Fu , Yiqiao Jin , Rushi Qiang , Harshavardhan Kamarthi , B. Aditya Prakash
2610.19725.abstract_en: Time-series foundation models provide strong zero-shot forecast, but deployment for real-world applications still requires task-specific designs for model inputs and outputs. Direct inference can leave domain knowledge and recurring forecast errors unaddressed, while tailored pipelines require substantial human expertise and effort. We introduce TimeRSI, a self-improving agentic deployment system around frozen forecasting models. A coding agent translates task descriptions into executable pipeline changes. It tests each revision on historical forecasting windows and uses observed errors to guide subsequent revisions. During deployment, an adaptive selector chooses among the resulting pipelines using completed forecasts under similar conditions. Across 198 tasks on TIME and fev-bench, TimeRSI outperforms all submissions on six point and probabilistic forecasting metrics. Controlled comparisons support the value of feedback-guided revision over non-iterative pipeline search. Further experiments verify the generalization with different coding agents and forecasting models. Code is available at this https URL .
2610.19725.affiliation: Georgia Institute of Technology / University of Southern California / Samay AI
2610.19725.abstract_zh: 时间序列基础模型具有很强的零样本预测能力，但在真实应用中部署时，仍需要针对任务设计模型输入和输出。直接推理可能无法处理领域知识和反复出现的预测错误，而定制流程需要大量人工专业知识和投入。我们提出 TimeRSI，一种围绕冻结预测模型构建的自我改进智能体部署系统。编码智能体将任务描述转换为可执行的流程修改，在历史预测窗口上测试每次修改，并利用观察到的错误指导后续修改。部署时，自适应选择器根据相似条件下已经完成的预测，从得到的流程中进行选择。在 TIME 和 fev-bench 的 198 项任务上，TimeRSI 在六项点预测及概率预测指标上优于所有参评方案。受控比较支持反馈引导修改相对于非迭代流程搜索的价值。进一步实验验证了不同编码智能体和预测模型下的泛化能力。代码见原文所链接的地址。
2610.19725.update_target: Executable forecast pipelines and a deployment selector
2610.19725.mechanism_en: Historical-window errors guide iterative pipeline edits; completed forecasts under similar conditions inform subsequent pipeline selection.
2610.19725.result_en: Evaluated on 198 TIME/fev-bench tasks and six forecast metrics; controls favor feedback-guided revision over non-iterative search.
2610.19725.boundary_en: Forecasting models remain frozen. Completed-window timing must prevent future-data leakage; headline rankings are author reports.

2610.19799.title: Evolve Together, Fall into Place: How Social Scaffolding Shapes Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems
2610.19799.authors: Seojin Hwang , Youngmin Choi , Hwanhee Lee
2610.19799.abstract_en: Recent work lets LLM agents evolve their own harness, up to the team itself. Yet in human groups, the same abilities achieve different outcomes under different social conditions. Borrowing the notion of scaffolding from developmental psychology, we investigate whether the social scaffolding of a self-evolving multi-agent system (MAS), namely its team composition and structure of interdependence (e.g., collaboration, conformity, or competition), shapes how the team evolves. We present AGORA (Agents Growing through Organization and Relational Arrangements), a framework that varies the two axes independently across three evolution mechanisms. Across web search, codebase understanding, and document QA, we find that (1) evolution alone rarely helps, while the right scaffolding surpasses a strong agent evolved alone by up to 25 points; (2) it does so by moving authority to the most capable member while the others step back; and (3) this member, having grown within the team, outperforms the same model alone. Designing a self-evolving MAS thus requires designing its social scaffolding, which shapes not only how its agents learn, but who gets to lead.
2610.19799.abstract_zh: 近期研究允许大语言模型智能体进化自身的运行框架，甚至进化整个团队。然而在人类群体中，相同能力在不同社会条件下会产生不同结果。借用发展心理学中的支架概念，我们研究自我进化多智能体系统（MAS）的社会支架，即团队组成和相互依赖结构（例如协作、从众或竞争），是否会塑造团队的进化方式。我们提出 AGORA（通过组织与关系安排成长的智能体），在三种进化机制下独立改变这两个维度。跨网页搜索、代码库理解和文档问答任务，我们发现：（1）仅有进化很少带来收益，而恰当的支架能够比单独进化的强智能体高出最多 25 分；（2）这一收益通过将权威转移到最有能力的成员、其他成员退居辅助位置来实现；（3）在团队中成长的这一成员，表现优于同一模型独自运行时。因此，设计自我进化多智能体系统需要设计其社会支架，它不仅决定智能体如何学习，也决定谁获得领导权。
2610.19799.mechanism_en: AGORA varies composition and interdependence independently across three evolution mechanisms; evolved team members are evaluated alone too.
2610.19799.result_en: Appropriate scaffolding exceeds a strong independently evolved agent by up to 25 points across the studied tasks.
2610.19799.boundary_en: Evolution alone rarely helps; gains depend on social structure and whole-team budgets, not simply more agents.

2610.19951.title: AtomSearch: Evidence-Grounded Tree Search for Agent Skill Optimization
2610.19951.authors: Jia Tong , Senyou Deng , Min Peng , Jianfeng Pan
2610.19951.categories_text: Computation and Language (cs.CL) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.19951.abstract_en: Agent skills adapt frozen models through editable external instructions. Revising several rules at once makes changes difficult to inspect, while judging each local edit only by its immediate score can discard useful intermediate states. We introduce AtomSearch, which keeps revision actions local while using subsequent skill states to guide search. Contrastive atomic editing links each primitive rule edit to failed and successful executions, a behavioral hypothesis, and an intended scope. Skill-State Tree Search (STS) evaluates short edit compositions and selectively retains them as executable states that can be revisited and extended. Outcome memory supplies later proposals with observed repair and regression statistics. We evaluate AtomSearch across four tasks and five target models. With deepseek-v4-flash, it exceeds SkillOpt on three of four tasks, including a 9.68-percentage-point gain on LiveMathematicianBench, and SkillOpt's final skills contain 2.3-19.7 times as many characters. In 67% of completed searches, the best validation state passes through an ancestor that was not highest-scoring at its depth. These results show how local rule edits can support the exploration of useful revision paths and yield compact skills, with additional offline evaluations used to explore alternative states.
2610.19951.abstract_zh: 智能体技能通过可编辑的外部指令使冻结模型适应任务。同时修改多条规则会使变化难以审查，而仅按即时分数评估每次局部编辑，又可能丢弃有用的中间状态。我们提出 AtomSearch，在保持修改动作局部化的同时，利用后续技能状态指导搜索。对比式原子编辑将每个基本规则修改与失败及成功执行、行为假设和预期作用范围联系起来。技能状态树搜索（STS）评估较短的编辑组合，有选择地保留它们作为可执行状态，以便重新访问并继续扩展。结果记忆为后续提议提供已观察到的修复和退化统计。我们在四项任务和五个目标模型上评估 AtomSearch。使用 deepseek-v4-flash 时，它在四项任务中的三项上优于 SkillOpt，其中在 LiveMathematicianBench 上提高 9.68 个百分点，而 SkillOpt 最终技能的字符数是其 2.3—19.7 倍。在 67% 的已完成搜索中，验证表现最佳的状态经过了一个在其所在深度并非得分最高的祖先状态。这些结果表明，局部规则修改能够探索有用的修改路径并形成紧凑技能，但探索不同状态需要额外的离线评估。
2610.19951.update_target: External skill rules, search states and outcome memory
2610.19951.mechanism_en: Atomic edits cite contrasting executions and scope; tree search evaluates compositions, retains states and reuses repair/regression statistics.
2610.19951.result_en: With deepseek-v4-flash, gains over SkillOpt occur on three of four tasks, including 9.68 points on LiveMathematicianBench.
2610.19951.boundary_en: 67% of completed searches use a non-leading ancestor, but alternative-state exploration costs additional offline evaluations.

2610.20431.title: SwarmRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Scientific Agent Swarm
2610.20431.authors: Qianru Meng , Xi Zhang , Konstantinos Papakostas , Congfeng Cao , Wenxiang Hu , Tianyi Lu , Xiao Zhang , Lun Zhou , Zaiqiao Meng , Zhaochun Ren , Xiaohui Yan , Yougang Lyu
2610.20431.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) in scientific research aims to improve agents' research capabilities through their own experimental experience. Scientific agent swarms can combine evidence and implementations from different research directions to guide their agents' subsequent experiments. However, poor experimental results can leave unclear whether to revise a hypothesis or its implementation, while overall program scores can hide components useful to other agents. To address these challenges, we introduce SwarmRSI, a framework that evolves scientific agent swarms for recursive self-improvement. We devise Feedback-Guided Swarm Mutation to refine hypotheses and their implementations using experimental feedback from other agents. We also propose Complementary Swarm Recombination to reuse retained hypotheses and complementary program components across agents, allowing partial results to support new research. Recursive Swarm Evolution integrates both mechanisms into a feedback loop, using new experimental evidence to guide subsequent research. Experiments on OpenProblems, NatureBench and MLE-Bench Lite demonstrate SwarmRSI's state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. Further evaluations show that accumulated research experience improves performance on held-out tasks. Biologists also reproduce its programs for follow-up biological analyses.
2610.20431.affiliation: Huawei Technologies / Leiden University / University of Groningen
2610.20431.abstract_zh: 科学研究中的递归自我改进（RSI）旨在通过智能体自身的实验经验提高其研究能力。科学智能体群可以结合不同研究方向的证据和实现，指导各智能体的后续实验。然而，实验结果不佳时，往往不清楚应该修改假设还是修改实现，而整体程序分数又可能掩盖对其他智能体有用的局部组件。为解决这些问题，我们提出 SwarmRSI，一种通过进化科学智能体群实现递归自我改进的框架。我们设计反馈引导的群体变异，利用其他智能体的实验反馈细化假设及其实现；同时提出互补群体重组，在智能体之间复用已保留的假设和互补程序组件，使局部结果也能够支持新研究。递归群体进化将两种机制整合到反馈闭环中，用新实验的证据指导后续研究。在 OpenProblems、NatureBench 和 MLE-Bench Lite 上的实验显示，SwarmRSI 达到最先进性能。进一步评估表明，累积的研究经验能够提高留出任务上的表现。生物学家还复现其程序以进行后续生物学分析。
2610.20431.update_target: Scientific hypotheses, program components and retained research experience
2610.20431.mechanism_en: Experimental feedback guides swarm mutation; complementary components and hypotheses are recombined and new evidence informs later research.
2610.20431.result_en: Reported gains span OpenProblems, NatureBench and MLE-Bench Lite; retained experience transfers to held-out tasks.
2610.20431.boundary_en: The paper reports biologists reproducing programs, not independent replication performed for this digest; scientific claims need their own evidence checks.

2610.20474.title: AdaRSI: On-Demand Recursive Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
2610.20474.authors: Peidong Wang , Ying Chang , Zhiming Ma , Xiaocui Yang , Shi Feng , Daqi Liu , Yuzhe Yang , Xu Cao , Chuang Wang , Jian Su , Daling Wang
2610.20474.abstract_en: Pretrained vision-language-action models (VLAs) often fail midway through unseen long-horizon tasks. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a remedy, but embodied RSI methods either refine the harness around a frozen executor and so cannot add a missing motion, or train the executor on persistent failures without asking whether a failure lies in how the executor is called or in what it can do. We ask when a self-improving embodied system should change the weights of its executor, and propose AdaRSI, an on-demand RSI framework for embodied agents. A coding agent first improves its skills and harness, then attributes persistent failures by retrying failing sub-steps from saved states, and fine-tunes only the sub-steps that remain unreliable, with demonstrations it collects itself and experience carried over from earlier tasks. On all 50 target tasks of RoboCasa365, with GR00T N1.5 as the executor and no human demonstrations, AdaRSI improves the VLA on all three suites and raises its success on unseen composite tasks from 4.6% to 13.8%. Compared with fine-tuning every sub-step, it reaches slightly higher success while using only 28% of the GPU time and 22% of the self-collected demonstrations, and fine-tuning without a harness trains more yet gains far less.
2610.20474.affiliation: Northeastern University / AgiBot / University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
2610.20474.abstract_zh: 预训练视觉语言动作模型（VLA）在未见过的长时程任务中，常会执行到一半便失败。递归自我改进（RSI）提供了一种补救途径，但现有具身 RSI 方法要么只改进冻结执行器周围的运行框架，因而无法补足缺失的动作能力；要么针对持续失败训练执行器，却不判断问题源于调用方式还是执行能力本身。我们研究自我改进的具身系统何时应该改变执行器权重，并提出按需进行改进的具身智能体 RSI 框架 AdaRSI。编码智能体先改进技能和框架，再从保存的状态重试失败子步骤以归因持续失败，随后仅对仍然不可靠的子步骤进行微调，使用其自行收集的演示以及从先前任务继承的经验。以 GR00T N1.5 为执行器、无需人类演示，AdaRSI 在 RoboCasa365 的全部 50 项目标任务上，在三个任务组中均改进了 VLA，并将未见组合任务的成功率从 4.6% 提高到 13.8%。相比微调每一个子步骤，它以略高的成功率，仅使用 28% 的 GPU 时间和 22% 的自采集演示；没有框架的微调虽然训练更多，收益却小得多。
2610.20474.update_target: Embodied skills/harness and selected executor weights
2610.20474.mechanism_en: Improve the harness first; saved-state retries diagnose persistent substeps, then self-collected demonstrations train only unreliable parts.
2610.20474.result_en: Unseen composite success rises 4.6% to 13.8%; selective training uses 28% GPU time and 22% demonstrations versus training every substep.
2610.20474.boundary_en: RoboCasa365 results concern simulation and a particular executor; no-human-demonstration does not remove pretrained capabilities or environment feedback.

2610.18933.title: The Agentic Scientist: Orchestrating Coding Agents for Automated Scientific (Co-)Discovery
2610.18933.authors: Robert Tjarko Lange , Luca Grillotti , Yutaro Yamada , Rujikorn Charakorn , David Ha
2610.18933.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.18933.abstract_en: Modern coding agents are fundamentally reshaping the role of human input for computational research: they write code, launch in silico experiments, analyze their results, and autonomously operate with ever-increasing time horizons. Despite these developments, fully autonomous research agents suffer from a limited ideation radius and myopic hill-climbing search dynamics. To bridge this gap, we introduce The Agentic Scientist, an end-to-end distributed pipeline for human researchers to conduct computational research alongside modern coding agents. Building on its predecessor, our system decomposes research into task drafting, idea generation, planning, sandboxed experimentation, result aggregation, baseline and ablation construction, post-hoc analysis, and report writing. Importantly, each step in the pipeline is powered by the next generation of coding agents and leverages agentic self-verification. The overall research process is driven by a meta-controller that manages parallel research agents and enforces rubric verification at each stage. This design enables the same orchestration layer to be reused across heterogeneous domains with different execution environments, agentic coding harnesses, and evaluation metrics. Our system can be used across a spectrum of autonomy: either as a co-scientist tool or to perform end-to-end scientific investigation. Within the co-scientist setting, we leveraged a development version of our system to submit a single research paper, which got accepted for publication at ALIFE 2026. We further apply The Agentic Scientist fully autonomously to open problem-solving tasks in machine learning, and demonstrate the system's capability of scientific discovery across different domains of computational research. Our ablations suggest that reliable scientific autonomy depends not only on base model capabilities, but also on the cross-agent orchestration layer.
2610.18933.abstract_zh: 现代编码智能体正在从根本上改变人类在计算研究中的投入方式：它们编写代码、启动计算机模拟实验、分析结果，并以不断延长的时间跨度自主工作。尽管如此，完全自主的研究智能体仍受到构思范围有限和短视爬山式搜索动力学的制约。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 The Agentic Scientist，一套让人类研究者与现代编码智能体共同开展计算研究的端到端分布式流程。在前代系统基础上，它将研究分解为任务起草、想法生成、规划、沙箱实验、结果汇总、基线与消融构建、事后分析和报告撰写。流程的每一步都由新一代编码智能体驱动，并利用智能体式自验证。整体研究过程由元控制器驱动，管理并行研究智能体并在每个阶段强制执行评分准则核验。该设计使相同的编排层能够跨不同执行环境、编码智能体运行框架和评估指标的领域复用。系统支持从协作科学家工具到端到端科学调查的不同自主程度。在协作科学家设置中，我们利用系统的开发版本提交了一篇研究论文，并获 ALIFE 2026 接收。我们进一步将 The Agentic Scientist 完全自主地用于机器学习开放问题求解，展示其在不同计算研究领域进行科学发现的能力。消融实验表明，可靠的科学自主性不仅取决于基础模型能力，也取决于跨智能体编排层。
2610.18933.update_target: Computational research artifacts and cross-agent orchestration
2610.18933.mechanism_en: A meta-controller organizes experiments, baselines, ablations and reports with stage-wise rubric verification; findings drive further research.
2610.18933.result_en: The authors report autonomous computational investigations and an ALIFE 2026 acceptance from co-scientist use of a development version.
2610.18933.boundary_en: Acceptance is an abstract-level author claim, not a verified venue label here; computational discovery is not physical experimentation or proven unbounded RSI.

2610.18938.title: Beyond Equation Search: Conjecture-Guided Discovery with SCOPE and ClosureBench
2610.18938.authors: Yuxiao Hu , Qian Li , Ding Wang , Siheng Chen , Linfeng Zhang , Jinyue Yan , Yuntian Chen
2610.18938.abstract_en: Most symbolic regression methods optimize candidate equations, but improving an equation's fit does not establish whether its underlying scientific conjecture should be retained, revised, or rejected. A conjecture may admit multiple mathematical realizations, and similarly accurate equations may imply different explanations. This motivates a shift from refining individual expressions to developing and testing the conjectures that guide them. We introduce SCOPE, a framework that sustains multiple conjecture-driven research trajectories. Multiple scientist agents independently pursue conjectures through equation modeling, question formulation, and active experimentation, then exchange evidence to revise their conjectures and research directions. Their findings are consolidated into a scientific report linking models, conclusions, and evidence. Existing equation-discovery benchmarks primarily assess recovered expressions, leaving the evidence and scientific conclusions established through the investigation underexamined. We therefore introduce ClosureBench, an interactive benchmark of 60 closure-discovery tasks across five scientific domains. ClosureBench focuses on closure-discovery tasks to give equation discovery a concrete scientific purpose. Each task embeds an unknown algebraic relation in a known PDE system, where agents control experimental conditions in OpenFOAM to acquire new data for equation discovery. Beyond equation accuracy, ClosureBench proposes three metrics to evaluate the discovery process: evidence faithfulness, mechanism insight, and experimental effectiveness. Compared with diverse baselines, SCOPE achieves higher equation accuracy on both ClosureBench and a real-world scientific discovery case, while producing more accurate, reliable, and effective scientific discoveries.
2610.18938.affiliation: Hong Kong Polytechnic University / Eastern Institute of Technology / Shanghai Jiao Tong University / DP Technology
2610.18938.abstract_zh: 多数符号回归方法优化候选方程，但方程拟合改善并不能确定其背后的科学猜想应该保留、修改还是拒绝。一个猜想可能对应多种数学实现，而准确度相近的方程也可能隐含不同解释。这促使我们从细化单个表达式转向发展和检验引导表达式的猜想。我们提出 SCOPE，一种维持多条由猜想驱动的研究轨迹的框架。多个科学家智能体独立开展方程建模、问题提出和主动实验，随后交换证据，以修改猜想和研究方向。它们的发现被整合为将模型、结论和证据关联起来的科学报告。现有方程发现基准主要评估恢复的表达式，对研究过程所建立的证据和科学结论考察不足。因此，我们提出 ClosureBench，一个覆盖五个科学领域、包含 60 项闭合关系发现任务的交互式基准。ClosureBench 聚焦闭合关系发现，使方程发现具有明确的科学目的。每项任务都在已知偏微分方程系统中嵌入一个未知代数关系，智能体通过控制 OpenFOAM 中的实验条件获取新数据，以发现方程。除方程准确性外，ClosureBench 还提出证据忠实度、机制洞察力和实验有效性三项指标来评估发现过程。与多种基线相比，SCOPE 在 ClosureBench 和真实科学发现案例上均获得更高的方程准确性，同时产生更准确、可靠、有效的科学发现。
2610.18938.update_target: Scientific conjectures, equations and research directions
2610.18938.mechanism_en: Independent trajectories run active experiments and exchange evidence to revise conjectures, then consolidate evidence-linked reports.
2610.18938.result_en: SCOPE improves equation accuracy on ClosureBench and a scientific case; ClosureBench has 60 tasks across five domains.
2610.18938.boundary_en: OpenFOAM experiments are computational simulations; equation fit and faithfulness of the resulting scientific explanation remain separate outcomes.

2610.19184.title: HERO: Harnessing Evidence for Test-time Refinement and Prompt Optimization in Program Generation
2610.19184.authors: Mingyu Lu , Timothy Ossowski , Tristan Naumann , Hoifung Poon , Peniel Argaw
2610.19184.abstract_en: Harness optimization improves LLMs by refining reusable prompts and scaffolding, yet requires further adaptation for program generation tasks such as text-to-SQL and text-to-Python. Existing methods often rely on LLM reflectors to propose harness updates, which can fix observed failures but also disrupt previously correct behavior. Text-to-code tasks offer a natural way to mitigate this issue: we can execute generated outputs, allowing us to evaluate and verify the effects of proposed updates directly. Building on this signal, we introduce \textsc{HERO} (\textbf{H}arnessing \textbf{E}vidence for \textbf{R}efinement and \textbf{O}ptimization), which combines offline and test-time harness optimization. At the first stage, \method{} learns reusable prompt updates from execution-verified successes and failures and validates candidate revisions before adoption. At test time, we treat the generated code as an instance-specific harness and refine it using execution feedback. Across four SQL, Cypher, and Python benchmarks, \method{} achieves the best offline performance, improving pass@1 by \(7.6\) points over the initial prompt, while test-time refinement adds another \(2.0\) points and improves execution efficiency.
2610.19184.affiliation: University of Washington / Microsoft Research / Recursion
2610.19184.abstract_zh: 运行框架优化通过细化可复用提示和支架来改进大语言模型，但在文本转 SQL、文本转 Python 等程序生成任务中还需要进一步适配。现有方法通常依赖大语言模型反思器提出框架更新，这虽然能修复已观察到的失败，也可能破坏原本正确的行为。文本到代码任务提供了一种自然的缓解方式：可以执行生成的输出，直接评估和验证所提更新的效果。基于这一信号，我们提出 HERO（利用证据进行细化与优化），结合离线和测试时框架优化。第一阶段，该方法从执行验证过的成功和失败中学习可复用提示更新，并在采纳前验证候选修改。测试时，我们将生成的代码视为实例特定的框架，通过执行反馈加以细化。在四个 SQL、Cypher 和 Python 基准上，该方法取得最佳离线表现，pass@1 比初始提示提高 7.6 分，测试时细化又进一步提高 2.0 分，并提升执行效率。
2610.19184.update_target: Reusable offline prompts and instance-specific code at test time
2610.19184.mechanism_en: Execution-verified successes and failures guide prompt revisions validated before adoption; later code refinement uses execution feedback.
2610.19184.result_en: Across four program-generation benchmarks, offline pass@1 rises 7.6 points and test-time refinement adds 2.0 points.
2610.19184.boundary_en: Offline persistent prompts and task-local code refinement are different update scopes; the official abstract includes unexpanded method macros.

2610.19234.title: Write Once, Plan Many: Building Reusable Visual Planning Systems from One Scene
2610.19234.authors: Ruixiao Yang , Yilun Hao , Mingxin Yu , Yang Zhang , Chuchu Fan
2610.19234.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) can reason about visual planning tasks, but querying them for every instance incurs repeated inference cost and latency. Generating reusable planning programs offers an alternative, but constructing reliable planning systems for new problem domains without extensive supervision remains challenging. We present a training-free framework that constructs reusable perception and planning programs from a domain specification and a single practice scene without a paired solution. The central challenge is obtaining useful feedback from the limited input. Our framework addresses it by leveraging VLM's ability to provide a renderer and a dynamic model based on its scene understanding. Rendering detected states enables comparison with the practice scene, while checking simulated action outcomes against the domain specification helps expose errors in rule implementation. Together, these checks guide refinement of the grounding program and planner without requiring solution labels. After refinement and component selection, the programs are frozen and solve new instances without further VLM calls. The same framework constructs systems across domains without manual pipeline redesign. Across fifteen domain variants spanning 2D and 3D scenes with discrete and continuous state, our systems achieve 99.3% average planning success, compared with 80.9% for the strongest domain-level program-generation baseline and 90.7% for the strongest instance-level baseline. Cost analyses show a favorable success-cost trade-off, and ablations confirm the contributions of the executable domain model, execution feedback, and component selection.
2610.19234.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）能够推理视觉规划任务，但为每个实例都调用模型会反复产生推理成本和延迟。生成可复用规划程序是一种替代方案，但在缺乏大量监督的情况下，为新问题领域构建可靠规划系统仍然困难。我们提出一种无需训练的框架，仅依据领域规范和一个没有配对解答的练习场景，就能构建可复用的感知与规划程序。核心挑战是如何从有限输入获得有用反馈。我们的框架利用 VLM 根据场景理解提供渲染器和动力学模型的能力解决这一问题。渲染检测到的状态，可以将其与练习场景比较；依据领域规范检查模拟动作结果，可以暴露规则实现中的错误。两种检查共同指导视觉落地程序和规划器的细化，而不需要解答标签。完成细化和组件选择后，程序被冻结，无需进一步调用 VLM 即可解决新实例。同一框架能够跨领域构建系统，无需人工重新设计流程。在涵盖离散与连续状态、二维与三维场景的 15 个领域变体中，我们的系统平均规划成功率为 99.3%，而最强领域级程序生成基线为 80.9%，最强实例级基线为 90.7%。成本分析显示其成功率与成本之间的权衡更优，消融实验确认了可执行领域模型、执行反馈和组件选择的贡献。
2610.19234.mechanism_en: Renderer comparisons and simulated action checks guide program refinement and component selection; frozen programs then solve new instances.
2610.19234.result_en: Across 15 domain variants, average planning success is 99.3% versus 80.9% domain-level and 90.7% instance-level baselines.
2610.19234.boundary_en: One unlabeled practice scene still uses a domain specification and model-generated dynamics; frozen transfer is not continued deployment evolution.

2610.19298.title: Verifier-Grounded Agentic RL for Provably Correct Code
2610.19298.authors: George Ma , Yuhao Zhang , Bing He , Zeren Shui , Ferhat Erata , Murali Krishna Ramanathan , Somayeh Sojoudi , Hao Zhou
2610.19298.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning for code usually rewards passing tests, which a model can do while remaining wrong on the inputs the tests do not cover. A program verifier instead decides whether a program satisfies a formal specification for all inputs. Language models are almost always paired with verifiers at inference time only, and turning a verifier into a reward raises two difficulties. It reports only acceptance or rejection, which gives no gradient when every attempt fails, and a policy can cheat it, most simply by telling it to assume what the proof was supposed to establish. We build an agentic environment and reward that address both. The reward reads the verifier's diagnostics rather than its verdict, scoring a candidate by the weighted fraction of proof obligations it discharges, extended with hidden probes from a reference proof's annotations. An integrity audit outranks the verifier, rejecting any candidate that alters the specification or assumes what it was meant to prove. The model works as an agent against a live verifier over many turns, with a separately trained proof specialist as a frozen collaborator. Across Qwen3 models from 1.7B to 14B and a 35B Qwen3.6 mixture-of-experts model, held-out verification on code generation rises from 66.1% to 93.5% on DafnyBench and from 56.3% to 100% on SWE-Proof. This reward leads every other training signal we compare, including a binary pass-or-fail reward trained under otherwise identical settings, with the widest margin on code generation. When the agent must also deliver the repository patch, graded by each project's withheld tests, the fraction of held-out issues it resolves rises from 59.6% to 72.5%. Evaluated unchanged on three verification suites withheld from training, the checkpoints improve on all of them, including one whose language and verifier are absent from training.
2610.19298.abstract_zh: 面向代码的强化学习通常奖励通过测试，但模型可能通过测试，却在未被覆盖的输入上仍然错误。程序验证器则判断程序是否对所有输入都满足形式化规范。语言模型几乎总是只在推理时与验证器配合，将验证器转为奖励存在两个难题：它通常只报告接受或拒绝，所有尝试都失败时没有梯度；策略也可能欺骗它，最简单的方式就是让它直接假设本应证明的结论。我们构建能够解决这两点的智能体环境和奖励。奖励读取验证器诊断而非仅仅读取裁决，按候选程序已完成证明义务的加权比例计分，并加入来自参考证明注解的隐藏探测。完整性审计优先级高于验证器，会拒绝任何修改规范或直接假设待证结论的候选。模型以智能体形式与实时验证器多轮交互，并由一个单独训练、保持冻结的证明专家协作。在从 1.7B 到 14B 的 Qwen3 模型和 35B Qwen3.6 混合专家模型上，代码生成的留出验证率在 DafnyBench 上从 66.1% 提高到 93.5%，在 SWE-Proof 上从 56.3% 提高到 100%。该奖励优于所有比较的训练信号，包括在其他设置完全相同下训练的二元通过奖励，其中代码生成上的优势最大。当智能体还必须交付由各项目隐藏测试评分的代码仓库补丁时，留出问题解决率从 59.6% 提高到 72.5%。将检查点不作改动地用于训练时留出的三个验证套件，表现均有改善，其中一个套件的语言和验证器在训练中都未出现。
2610.19298.update_target: Code-generating policy weights with a frozen proof specialist
2610.19298.mechanism_en: Live-verifier diagnostics grade proof obligations; hidden probes and an overriding integrity audit reject specification tampering before RL reuse.
2610.19298.result_en: Held-out code verification rises 66.1% to 93.5% on DafnyBench and 56.3% to 100% on SWE-Proof; issue resolution rises 59.6% to 72.5%.
2610.19298.boundary_en: Formal guarantees are relative to intact specifications and verifier assumptions; the separately trained collaborator and hidden probes are supervision resources.

2610.19372.title: Policy-Verified Self-Training: Learning Agent Compliance from Verifiable Policy Rewards
2610.19372.abstract_en: Runtime policy verifiers can prevent agents from executing disallowed actions, but their decisions are typically used only for enforcement and discarded afterward. We ask whether these decisions can instead become verifiable policy rewards for training the agents they guard. We introduce Policy-Verified Self-Training (PVST), a post-training paradigm in which an agent generates its own interaction trajectories and an executable policy verifier, here a deterministic gate compiled from a written policy, evaluates whether each action complies. Compliant trajectories are reinforced, and violations become negatives for preference optimization; beyond the gate and the benchmark's task-success signal, PVST needs no stronger teacher model, no human preference labels and no attack-specific supervision, although rollouts are collected in the benchmark's attacked environment. On held-out AgentDojo tasks under prompt injection, policy-verified preference training of Qwen3-8B reduces violating trajectories from 37.2% to 10.3 $\pm$ 0.9% (three seeds) and successful attacks from 12.4% to 0.5% at equal or higher pooled task utility, although utility falls on travel, compared with 22.0% when negatives are selected by an attack oracle and 31.9 $\pm$ 0.9% with negatives that contain no violation. The learned behavior holds under an attack template never used in training (37.7% to 11.0%) and on a suite excluded from training (34.8% to 16.7%), and the retained verifier's intervention rate falls from 39.2% to 8.8% (seed 0). Our analysis identifies two conditions under which the verdict is most informative: success must not already imply compliance, and guarded actions must appear in both permitted and forbidden contexts.
2610.19372.abstract_zh: 运行时策略验证器能够阻止智能体执行不允许的动作，但其决策通常仅用于强制执行，随后被丢弃。我们研究这些决策能否转化为训练受保护智能体的可验证策略奖励。我们提出策略验证自训练（PVST）：智能体生成自己的交互轨迹，由可执行策略验证器——此处为从书面策略编译得到的确定性门控——逐动作评估是否合规。合规轨迹被强化，违规轨迹成为偏好优化中的负例。除门控和基准的任务成功信号外，PVST 不需要更强教师模型、人类偏好标签或特定攻击监督，但轨迹是在基准受攻击的环境中收集的。在受到提示注入的留出 AgentDojo 任务上，对 Qwen3-8B 进行策略验证偏好训练，将违规轨迹从 37.2% 降到 10.3±0.9%（三个随机种子），成功攻击从 12.4% 降到 0.5%；汇总任务效用相同或更高，但旅行任务的效用下降。相比之下，用攻击预言机挑选负例时违规轨迹为 22.0%，使用不含违规的负例时为 31.9±0.9%。所学行为在训练中未用过的攻击模板下仍保持（37.7% 降到 11.0%），在训练排除的任务套件上也保持（34.8% 降到 16.7%）；保留验证器的干预率从 39.2% 降到 8.8%（种子 0）。分析指出，验证裁决在两个条件下最有信息量：任务成功不应已隐含合规，并且受保护动作应同时出现在允许和禁止的语境中。
2610.19372.mechanism_en: A deterministic policy gate judges self-generated trajectories; compliant examples and violating negatives feed reinforcement/preference training.
2610.19372.result_en: Qwen3-8B violating trajectories fall 37.2% to 10.3 ± 0.9%; measured successful attacks fall 12.4% to 0.5%.
2610.19372.boundary_en: Travel utility falls despite equal or higher pooled utility. Training uses attacked environments and benchmark success feedback; the gate is not self-evolved.

2610.19380.title: Learning What to Keep: Transfer-Aware Personal Skill Learning from User Feedback
2610.19380.authors: Li Wang , Chen Zhang , Yirong Yang , Xingyu Chen , Jinkun Zhao , Tianhao Peng , Wenjun Wu
2610.19380.abstract_en: User feedback enables LLMs to refine reusable personalized skills, but often mixes persistent preferences with request-specific corrections. Indiscriminately retaining both risks negative transfer, motivating selective retention at the level of individual requirements. We frame this challenge as selective transfer over atomic rules and propose SkillGrain, a framework for learning reusable personalized skills from user feedback. SkillGrain decomposes feedback into independently actionable rules, predicts their transferability, and retains only those suitable for future requests. To learn these decisions, we combine rubric-guided skill rewards with fine-grained credit assignment that separately evaluates rule content and retention decisions. We further jointly optimize skill induction and skill-conditioned generation through reinforcement learning, ensuring that learned skills support downstream personalization. We construct a benchmark spanning five personalized writing tasks to evaluate cross-request generalization. Experiments across three base models in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings show that SkillGrain achieves the best overall average performance among competing methods.
2610.19380.affiliation: Beihang University / Chengdu University of Information Technology / Nanyang Technological University / Hangzhou International Innovation Institute / Beijing Advanced Innovation Center for Future Blockchain and Privacy Computing
2610.19380.abstract_zh: 用户反馈能够帮助大语言模型细化可复用的个性化技能，但反馈经常混合持久偏好与特定请求的修正。不加区分地保留两者会带来负迁移风险，因此需要在单条要求层面选择性保留。我们将这一挑战表述为原子规则上的选择性迁移，并提出从用户反馈学习可复用个性化技能的框架 SkillGrain。SkillGrain 将反馈分解为可独立执行的规则，预测其可迁移性，仅保留适合未来请求的规则。为学习这些决策，我们结合评分准则引导的技能奖励和细粒度信用分配，分别评估规则内容及保留决策。我们还通过强化学习联合优化技能归纳与技能条件生成，确保所学技能支持下游个性化。我们构建覆盖五类个性化写作任务的基准，以评估跨请求泛化。在三个基础模型、域内及域外设置中的实验显示，SkillGrain 在比较方法中取得最佳总体平均表现。
2610.19380.update_target: Personalized atomic rules and the skill induction/generation policy
2610.19380.mechanism_en: Feedback is split into rules; separate content/retention credit and rubric rewards jointly train skill induction and conditioned generation.
2610.19380.result_en: Five writing tasks and three backbones show the best reported overall average across in-domain and out-of-domain settings.
2610.19380.boundary_en: Retention decisions must distinguish persistent preference from request-local correction; aggregate personalization scores do not prove every retained rule transfers.

2610.19381.title: EvoWeave: Composing Reusable Agent Experience through Operation Level Graphs
2610.19381.authors: Guanhua Zhu , Bo Shen , Lei Zhang , Fadi Deek , Zhi Wei , Mengnan Du , Chenxi Yuan
2610.19381.abstract_en: Different tasks often require interactive agents to perform similar operations at intermediate steps. Retrieving an entire past workflow can introduce irrelevant steps, whereas retrieving isolated operations can discard the dependencies needed to reuse them. We introduce EvoWeave, a framework for experience memory that represents abstract states as nodes and reusable operations as directed edges with input and output contracts, provenance, and capability references. A planner decomposes the current task into a dependency graph; operation retrieval and bounded directed search then assemble relevant experience fragments. An execution agent can inspect these fragments and their referenced capabilities, while reflection separates concrete execution evidence from reusable abstractions. We study the framework across four benchmarks, five evaluation settings, and three language model backbones. Across backbones, AppWorld Normal and Challenge task goal completion average 51.91 and 27.99, respectively, exceeding the baseline without memory by 6.99 and 4.99 percentage points. An AppWorld ablation associates directed connections with an additional improvement of 2.08 points over independent operation cards. The results motivate composition of reusable operations while exposing tradeoffs in retrieval overhead and conditions for valid reuse.
2610.19381.affiliation: New Jersey Institute of Technology / Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen
2610.19381.abstract_zh: 不同任务往往需要交互式智能体在中间步骤执行相似操作。检索整条过去的工作流可能引入无关步骤，而检索孤立操作又可能丢失复用所需的依赖关系。我们提出经验记忆框架 EvoWeave，用节点表示抽象状态，用带有输入输出契约、来源和能力引用的有向边表示可复用操作。规划器将当前任务分解为依赖图，随后通过操作检索和有界有向搜索组装相关经验片段。执行智能体能够检查这些片段及其引用能力，反思则将具体执行证据与可复用抽象分离。我们在四个基准、五种评估设置和三个语言模型骨干上研究这一框架。跨骨干模型，AppWorld Normal 和 Challenge 的任务目标完成率平均分别为 51.91 和 27.99，比无记忆基线高 6.99 和 4.99 个百分点。AppWorld 消融将有向连接与相对于独立操作卡片额外提高的 2.08 分联系起来。结果支持复用操作的组合，同时揭示检索开销与有效复用条件之间的权衡。
2610.19381.update_target: Reusable operation graphs and capability references
2610.19381.mechanism_en: Input/output contracts and provenance support bounded directed composition; reflection separates execution evidence from reusable abstractions.
2610.19381.result_en: AppWorld Normal/Challenge gains over no memory average 6.99/4.99 points; directed links add 2.08 points over independent cards in one ablation.
2610.19381.boundary_en: Valid composition depends on contracts and retrieval overhead; these are external-memory changes, not policy-weight learning.

2610.19386.title: STRATA: Self-Maintaining Structured Experience Graphs for Self-Evolving Language Agents
2610.19386.authors: Guanhua Zhu , Hanwen Li , Zhi Wei , Mengnan Du , Chenxi Yuan
2610.19386.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can self-evolve at test time by accumulating experience: retrieving relevant memories before acting and writing new lessons back afterwards. Yet most are single-level: trajectories, distilled workflows and reasoning items all land in one undifferentiated pool indexed by embedding similarity, with no typed abstraction hierarchy. They never forget or deduplicate, and are prone to negative transfer, where a superficially similar but directionally opposite experience is recalled and its concrete steps are copied verbatim, actively harming the agent. We introduce STRATA, a structured, outcome-grounded, self-maintaining memory that organizes experience into a three-layer graph of atomic skills and code snippets, task workflows and generalized meta-frameworks, connected by typed edges. STRATA maintains itself through five mechanisms sharing one similarity geometry: a multi-dimensional similarity that scores retrieval by operation and target; a typed reflector crystallizing procedures from successes and pitfalls from failures; community detection that induces meta-frameworks; pressure-triggered garbage collection with articulation-point protection; and contrast edges that flag confusable, direction-opposite experiences. Across four interactive benchmarks (AppWorld, WebArena, ALFWorld, ScienceWorld), two frozen backbones and seven baselines, STRATA attains the best average score while simultaneously using the lowest latency and fewest environment steps of any memory-augmented method, and 44% fewer lines of injected memory than the most context-hungry baseline. We isolate two failure modes of prior memories: single-level memory degrades sharply as the task set grows, and single-level concrete memories suffer catastrophic negative transfer, which contrast edges repair, lifting ScienceWorld from 78.7 to 96.7 within the same system.
2610.19386.affiliation: New Jersey Institute of Technology / Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen
2610.19386.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以在测试时通过积累经验实现自我进化：行动前检索相关记忆，行动后写回新教训。但多数方法仅有单一层次，轨迹、提炼的工作流和推理条目都进入同一个没有类型化抽象层级、仅按嵌入相似度索引的记忆池。它们从不遗忘或去重，容易发生负迁移：表面相似、方向相反的经验被召回，其具体步骤被逐字照搬，反而伤害智能体。我们提出 STRATA，一种结构化、以结果为依据且能自维护的记忆，将经验组织成三层图：原子技能与代码片段、任务工作流和通用元框架，各层由类型化边连接。STRATA 通过五种共享同一相似性几何的机制进行自维护：按操作和目标评分检索的多维相似度；从成功中提炼程序、从失败中提炼陷阱的类型化反思器；通过社区发现归纳元框架；带有关节点保护的压力触发垃圾回收；以及标记易混淆且方向相反经验的对比边。在四个交互基准（AppWorld、WebArena、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld）、两个冻结骨干和七个基线上，STRATA 获得最高平均分，同时在所有记忆增强方法中具有最低延迟和最少环境步数，注入记忆的行数比上下文使用最多的基线少 44%。我们分离出以往记忆的两个失败模式：任务集增大时单层记忆明显退化，单层具体记忆会遭受灾难性负迁移；对比边能够修复后者，将同一系统的 ScienceWorld 分数从 78.7 提高到 96.7。
2610.19386.mechanism_en: Outcome-grounded reflection, community induction, protected garbage collection and contrast edges maintain reusable skills/workflows/meta-frameworks.
2610.19386.result_en: Four benchmarks and two frozen backbones yield the best reported average; contrast edges lift ScienceWorld 78.7 to 96.7 in the same system.
2610.19386.boundary_en: The memory-management mechanisms are designed policies; self-maintaining content does not automatically mean that the updater itself learns.

2610.19414.title: Recursive Formation and First-Class Reuse of Compositional Capabilities
2610.19414.abstract_en: We introduce FormCraft, a framework for representing acquired operations as first-class capabilities that can be recursively composed, directly invoked, and selectively retained in a persistent library through domain-specific verification. The framework separates capability well-formedness and public callability from later admission to persistent storage while preserving formation provenance and operational identity. We formalize recursive compositional closure over a uniform capability space and show that formed composites can be reused through the same public interface without re-forming their historical derivation. Experiments across continuous, discrete, propositional, and sequence domains demonstrate instance-independent reuse, independent checking, persistent acquisition, and reduced reuse-time search work under first-class exposure.
2610.19414.abstract_zh: 我们提出 FormCraft，一种将已获得操作表示为一等能力的框架，使其能够递归组合、直接调用，并通过领域特定验证有选择地保留在持久库中。该框架将能力的良构性、公开可调用性与之后进入持久存储的准入分离，同时保留形成来源和操作身份。我们在统一能力空间中形式化递归组合闭包，并证明形成的组合能力可以通过相同公开接口复用，无需重新形成其历史推导。覆盖连续、离散、命题与序列领域的实验，展示了独立于具体实例的复用、独立检查、持久能力获取，以及以一等对象暴露能力后复用阶段搜索工作的减少。
2610.19414.update_target: A persistent library of compositional capabilities
2610.19414.mechanism_en: Domain-specific verification separates formation and public invocation from storage admission; composites preserve identity and provenance for reuse.
2610.19414.result_en: Experiments across four domain types support instance-independent reuse and reduced reuse-time search under first-class exposure.
2610.19414.boundary_en: Recursive composition is not evidence that the improvement algorithm improves itself; the checked paper provides no confirmed institutional affiliation.

2610.19433.title: EvoProbe: Evaluation-Driven Benchmark Evolution for LLM Agents
2610.19433.authors: Qianhong Guo , Wei Xie , Xiaofang Cai , Shuoyoucheng Ma , Chengxin Hu , Baosheng Wang
2610.19433.abstract_en: Static benchmarks for large language model (LLM) agents face saturation and data contamination risks, motivating continual updates to evaluation tasks. However, aggregate scores and success rates offer limited insight into specific problem-solving bottlenecks and provide limited guidance for subsequent task design. We propose EvoProbe, an evaluation-driven benchmark evolution framework that integrates task generation, diagnostic evaluation, and feedback-driven regeneration into a closed loop. It combines verifiable subtask outcome scoring with evidence-supported multi-judge trajectory evaluation and distills phase-level bottlenecks, success patterns, and failure patterns into diagnostic feedback for generating new executable tasks. Across two rounds of cybersecurity experiments, evaluations of eight models on 66 tasks reveal phase-level performance differences and common failure patterns beyond aggregate scores. In a cross-round comparison with the Examiner model set and solver configuration held fixed, all eight models achieve lower Outcome scores on the updated tasks, with relative decreases of 11.8\% in mean Outcome and 40.0\% in mean Pass\textasciicircum{}3. These results support using fine-grained diagnostics to guide iterative task updates and probe agents' current capabilities and limitations.
2610.19433.affiliation: National University of Defense Technology / Institute of Information Engineering, CAS
2610.19433.abstract_zh: 静态大语言模型智能体基准面临性能饱和及数据污染风险，因此需要持续更新评估任务。然而，汇总分数和成功率很难揭示具体求解瓶颈，也难以指导后续任务设计。我们提出评估驱动的基准进化框架 EvoProbe，将任务生成、诊断评估和反馈驱动再生成整合为闭环。它结合可验证的子任务结果评分与有证据支撑的多裁判轨迹评估，并将阶段性瓶颈、成功模式和失败模式提炼为诊断反馈，用于生成新的可执行任务。在两轮网络安全实验中，对八个模型、66 项任务的评估揭示了汇总分数之外的阶段性性能差异和常见失败模式。在固定 Examiner 模型集合与求解器配置的跨轮比较中，所有八个模型在更新任务上的 Outcome 分数均更低，平均 Outcome 相对下降 11.8%，平均 Pass^3 相对下降 40.0%。结果支持使用细粒度诊断指导迭代任务更新，并探测智能体当前的能力与局限。
2610.19433.mechanism_en: Subtask outcomes and evidence-supported trajectory judges diagnose bottlenecks; feedback regenerates the next task batch.
2610.19433.result_en: Two cybersecurity rounds cover eight models and 66 tasks; fixed-solver mean Outcome and Pass^3 fall 11.8% and 40.0% relatively.
2610.19433.boundary_en: Harder evolved tasks do not establish improved solver capability or unchanged benchmark validity; judge consistency and task checks matter.

2610.19458.title: PFedMA: Who Should Join Next as Federated Multi-Agent Orchestration Evolves?
2610.19458.authors: Shuai Li , Shengyuan Liu , Fan Qi , Xiaoshan Yang
2610.19458.abstract_en: Federated Multi-Agent Systems (FedMAS) offer a promising paradigm for collaborative reasoning among LLM-based agents while keeping raw client data decentralized. However, reliable multi-round collaboration remains challenging. Agent selection must take into consideration evolving task requirements and the agent's historical reliability, while privacy rules must adapt to changing collaboration contexts and meet the client's personalized needs. To address these challenges, we propose PFedMA, a federated multi-agent framework for feedback driven multi-round collaboration under heterogeneous privacy requirements. Across rounds, PFedMA maintains historical capability and reliability states to guide agent selection, evaluates task responses before aggregation, and refines subsequent queries according to accumulated collaboration feedback. PFedMA enables bidirectional local to global and global to local private rule evolution across heterogeneous clients. Clients generalize locally updated privacy rules and selectively incorporate globally maintained rules, thereby facilitating cross-client privacy rule evolution while preserving personalized constraints. Extensive experiments across reasoning, privacy sensitive, and adversarial settings show that PFedMA improves task performance, reduces measured privacy leakage, and improves system robustness.
2610.19458.affiliation: Tianjin University of Technology / Inner Mongolia University / Institute of Automation, CAS
2610.19458.abstract_zh: 联邦多智能体系统（FedMAS）为基于大语言模型的智能体提供了协作推理范式，同时将原始客户端数据保持分散。但可靠的多轮协作仍然困难：智能体选择需要考虑不断变化的任务需求和历史可靠性，隐私规则也必须适应变化的协作语境，满足客户端的个性化需要。为解决这些挑战，我们提出 PFedMA，一种在异构隐私要求下进行反馈驱动多轮协作的联邦多智能体框架。PFedMA 跨轮维护历史能力与可靠性状态以指导智能体选择，在聚合之前评估任务回复，并依据累积协作反馈细化后续查询。PFedMA 支持异构客户端之间从本地到全局、再从全局到本地的双向私有规则进化。客户端将本地更新的隐私规则泛化，并有选择地吸收全局维护的规则，从而在保持个性化约束的同时实现跨客户端隐私规则进化。推理、隐私敏感和对抗设置中的大量实验显示，PFedMA 提高任务表现，降低测得的隐私泄漏，并增强系统鲁棒性。
2610.19458.update_target: Federated routing states and local/global privacy rules
2610.19458.mechanism_en: Historical reliability guides selection; evaluated responses refine queries, and generalized local rules and selected global rules are exchanged.
2610.19458.result_en: Reasoning, privacy-sensitive and adversarial evaluations report improved performance and lower measured leakage.
2610.19458.boundary_en: Rule exchange and measured leakage are not a universal privacy guarantee; validation of changing personalized constraints must remain explicit.

2610.19479.title: Active Generative Simulation: Meta-Learning What to Simulate for Sim-and-Real Policy Co-Training
2610.19479.authors: Liqian Ma , Vaibhav Saxena , Utkarsh Aashu Mishra , Shuo Cheng , Yongxin Chen , Danfei Xu
2610.19479.abstract_en: Sim-and-real co-training is an effective way to scale robot learning by augmenting limited real-world demonstrations with simulation data. However, existing approaches typically treat simulators as fixed data sources, relying on uniform generation, offline retrieval, or manual parameter alignment by domain experts. We formulate \textit{Active Generative Simulation}: optimizing a simulator's data-generation distribution to maximize downstream real-world performance. To solve this problem, we propose MetaGenSim, a meta-learning framework that trains an auxiliary rater network via meta-gradients to automatically discover high-utility data-generation distributions within a user-specified simulation parameter space, without manual parameter alignment. Across simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, MetaGenSim outperforms uniform generation and retrieval baselines, achieves a 150% relative improvement in real-world full-task success over uniform generation, and matches expert manual alignment. We further show that distributions curated with a lightweight proxy policy transfer to VLA fine-tuning, and that MetaGenSim can exploit partial alignment through atomic skill stitching and object-receptacle composition when exact sim-and-real task alignment is unavailable. Project website: this https URL
2610.19479.abstract_zh: 模拟与真实数据协同训练通过仿真数据增强有限的真实世界演示，是扩展机器人学习的有效方式。然而，现有方法通常将模拟器视为固定数据源，依赖均匀生成、离线检索或领域专家手工对齐参数。我们提出主动生成式仿真这一问题：优化模拟器的数据生成分布，使下游真实世界性能最大化。为解决它，我们提出元学习框架 MetaGenSim，在用户指定的仿真参数空间内，通过元梯度训练辅助评分网络，自动发现高效用的数据生成分布，无需人工参数对齐。在仿真和真实世界操作任务上，MetaGenSim 优于均匀生成和检索基线，真实世界完整任务成功率相对均匀生成提高 150%，并达到专家手工对齐水平。我们进一步表明，以轻量代理策略筛选的分布能够迁移到 VLA 微调；当模拟和真实任务无法精确对齐时，MetaGenSim 还能够通过原子技能拼接及物体—容器组合利用部分对齐。项目网站见原文链接。
2610.19479.update_target: Simulator data-generation distribution and auxiliary rater
2610.19479.mechanism_en: Meta-gradients optimize data utility within a specified simulation parameter space for downstream real-world policy training.
2610.19479.result_en: Real-world full-task success improves 150% relatively over uniform generation and matches expert alignment; proxy-curated distributions transfer to VLA tuning.
2610.19479.boundary_en: 150% is a relative gain, not 150 percentage points; simulator parameterization, real-data supervision and rater cost are part of the loop.

2610.19495.title: Robota-Embed: Unified VLA Embeddings for Robot In-Context Learning and Evolution
2610.19495.authors: Yunze Liu , Jing Wang , Shenrui Wu , Wenkun He , Guanqi Zhan , Xianzheng Ma , Junyu Chen , Wenhang Ge , Haozhan Tang , Yuchao Gu , Zhuoyang Zhang , Zekai Wang , Dantong Niu , Zhen Dong , Yuke Zhu , Trevor Darrell , Linxi "Jim" Fan , Song Han , Han Cai
2610.19495.categories_text: Robotics (cs.RO) ; Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
2610.19495.abstract_en: Retrieving useful context for a robot requires matching its task, execution stage, and the continuation that should follow. We introduce Robota-Embed, to our knowledge the first vision-language-action (VLA) embedding model to jointly encode all three modalities in both current-state queries and recorded future continuations. Predictive retrieval training aligns these endpoints, enabling historical continuations to serve as context at inference time. We construct a multi-source corpus of 1,695,684 cleaned training anchors and introduce Robota-Embed-Bench, with 4,000 queries and a shared 8,000-entry gallery. Robota-Embed achieves 47.33% clip-level and 81.77% episode-level R@1, exceeding action-free Gemini Embedding 2 by 22.09 and 33.47 percentage points. Controlled retrieval studies show that removing native action degrades retrieval more than removing vision. We study two complementary applications. Embed2ICL uses retrieved experience for training-free and training-based policy conditioning, increasing success from 47.0% to 56.3% in DROID-Sim and from 86.4% to 92.8% on the LIBERO difficult subset, while improving task progress on real robots. Embed2Evolve uses execution feedback to grow task-local memory and refine context use around a frozen GPT-6 Astra policy. Across five ManiSkill tasks, it achieves 68% success, compared with 24% for GPT-6 Astra Direct and 33% for a harness independently evolved with Omni-Embed-Nemotron-3B under the same protocol. Relative to the latter, it uses approximately 79.5% fewer policy tokens per test rollout, counting both successes and failures. These results show that a unified, action-aware retrieval space can support robot in-context learning and task-local context evolution.
2610.19495.affiliation: NVIDIA / MIT / UCB / Oxford / CMU (source abbreviations)
2610.19495.abstract_zh: 为机器人检索有用上下文，需要匹配其任务、执行阶段以及接下来应发生的延续。我们提出 Robota-Embed，据我们所知，它是首个在当前状态查询和记录的后续片段中联合编码视觉、语言、动作三种模态的视觉语言动作（VLA）嵌入模型。预测式检索训练对齐这两个端点，使历史延续片段能够在推理时用作上下文。我们构建包含 1,695,684 个清洗后训练锚点的多源语料库，并提出 Robota-Embed-Bench，其中有 4,000 个查询和共享的 8,000 条图库。Robota-Embed 达到片段级 47.33%、回合级 81.77% 的 R@1，比不使用动作的 Gemini Embedding 2 分别高 22.09 和 33.47 个百分点。受控检索研究表明，移除原生动作比移除视觉更损害检索。我们研究两个互补应用。Embed2ICL 使用检索经验进行无需训练或基于训练的策略条件化，使 DROID-Sim 成功率从 47.0% 提高到 56.3%，LIBERO 困难子集从 86.4% 提高到 92.8%，并提高真实机器人任务进度。Embed2Evolve 利用执行反馈围绕冻结的 GPT-6 Astra 策略增长任务局部记忆、细化上下文使用。在五项 ManiSkill 任务上，它达到 68% 成功率，而 GPT-6 Astra Direct 为 24%，在相同协议下用 Omni-Embed-Nemotron-3B 独立进化的框架为 33%。相较后者，计入成功与失败后，每次测试执行的策略词元数约减少 79.5%。这些结果表明，统一且具有动作感知的检索空间能够支持机器人上下文学习和任务局部上下文进化。
2610.19495.update_target: VLA embedding weights and task-local experience context
2610.19495.mechanism_en: Predictive retrieval training aligns states/continuations; Embed2Evolve uses execution feedback to grow memory around a frozen policy.
2610.19495.result_en: Embed2Evolve reaches 68% on five ManiSkill tasks versus 24% Direct and 33% an alternative evolved harness.
2610.19495.boundary_en: Task-local context evolution, corpus-trained embeddings and physical-robot progress are distinct evidence; the quoted 68% result is simulation.

2610.19517.title: VLRLA: Deployment-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language-Action Models through In-Context Reinforcement Learning
2610.19517.authors: Diyuan Shi , Yiqi Tang , Hongyin Zhang , You Wu , Donglin Wang
2610.19517.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models connect visual perception and language understanding with robot control, providing a foundation for instruction-conditioned manipulation. However, conventional pretrained VLA policies lack a mechanism for gradual adaptation through accumulated interaction experience during deployment. We therefore propose VLRLA, a general framework that equips existing VLA models with \textit{in-context reinforcement learning} capabilities for deployment-time adaptation. Our approach augments a VLA model with a reinforcement learning module that learns from historical observations, actions, rewards, and termination signals. During deployment, the policy gradually refines its action generation and progressively improves task success while keeping model parameters fixed. Our approach is also designed for general applicability and compatibility with diverse learning history construction strategies and model training pipelines. Finally, through extensive experiments, we systematically investigate the learning properties of VLRLA in simulation and demonstrate its ability to adapt to unseen scenarios during real-world deployment.
2610.19517.abstract_zh: 视觉语言动作（VLA）模型将视觉感知、语言理解和机器人控制连接起来，为指令条件操作提供基础。但传统预训练 VLA 策略缺少在部署中通过累积交互经验逐步适应的机制。因此，我们提出通用框架 VLRLA，为现有 VLA 模型赋予用于部署时适应的上下文强化学习能力。我们的方法为 VLA 模型增加一个强化学习模块，使其从历史观测、动作、奖励和终止信号中学习。部署期间，策略在保持模型参数固定的同时，逐步细化动作生成并提高任务成功率。该方法也针对通用适用性设计，兼容多种学习历史构建策略和模型训练流程。最后，我们通过大量实验，系统研究 VLRLA 在仿真中的学习性质，并展示其在真实世界部署中适应未见场景的能力。
2610.19517.update_target: Deployment history and in-context action conditioning
2610.19517.mechanism_en: A trained RL module consumes observations, actions, rewards and termination history; deployed weights stay fixed as experience accumulates.
2610.19517.result_en: Simulation studies and real-world deployment demonstrate adaptation to unseen settings.
2610.19517.boundary_en: This is parameter-frozen in-context adaptation, not online weight learning; account for the module training and history construction.

2610.19581.title: XferAgent: Cross-Agent Experience Transfer for Self-Improving LLM Agents
2610.19581.authors: Weihao Li , Jun Bai , Shijie Chen , Qincheng Lu , Xinyu Wang , Ziyang Song
2610.19581.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can reuse experience from prior task executions to improve performance on subsequent tasks. Although existing methods enable cross-agent experience sharing, differences in agents' execution histories and task requirements make shared experiences difficult to reuse effectively. We propose XferAgent, a framework for cross-agent experience transfer that organizes reusable experience in local and shared experience graphs. XferAgent reconciles compatible contributions from heterogeneous agents while avoiding unreliable merges. For each new task, it selects shared experiences and integrates them with the target agent's local experience to support task execution. Experiments across diverse task domains show improvements over representative memory-based methods and effective experience transfer between heterogeneous agent frameworks. Cumulative task success also increases over successive task passes as agents update and reuse their experiences.
2610.19581.affiliation: McGill University / Northwestern University / Mila / Ohio University
2610.19581.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体能够复用先前任务执行中的经验，提高后续任务表现。尽管现有方法支持跨智能体经验共享，但不同智能体的执行历史和任务需求存在差异，使共享经验难以有效复用。我们提出跨智能体经验迁移框架 XferAgent，将可复用经验组织到本地和共享经验图中。XferAgent 协调来自异构智能体的兼容贡献，同时避免不可靠的合并。对每个新任务，它选择共享经验，并与目标智能体的本地经验整合，以支持执行。不同任务领域的实验显示，该方法优于代表性的记忆方法，并能够在异构智能体框架之间有效迁移经验。随着智能体更新和复用经验，累积任务成功率也随连续多遍任务执行而提高。
2610.19581.mechanism_en: Contributions are reconciled with compatibility checks; shared experience merges with local evidence and updated graphs support later task passes.
2610.19581.result_en: Multiple domains and heterogeneous frameworks show improved experience transfer; cumulative success increases over successive passes.
2610.19581.boundary_en: Repeated task passes can include familiarity effects; quantify new-task transfer separately from revisiting the same tasks.

2610.19591.title: L3M: A Verifiable Harness and Runtime for Self-Extending and Self-Improving Agents
2610.19591.authors: Carson Eisenach , Robert Joseph George , Vincent Quenneville-Belair , Kate Gwimm , Dean Foster
2610.19591.abstract_en: The lasting gains in AI have come from methods that absorb more computation, and language models already scale computation within a call. Useful work, though, happens across calls: over hours or days, through tools and external systems, among many agents and the humans they work for, and increasingly through code the agents write themselves. Whether that work compounds is enabled by the harness around it, and the harness faces a constraint the model does not: of the three participants in such a computation, the human, the model and code, only the human's attention does not scale, so the computation can grow only if the human is not in every loop. L3M is a runtime built on that premise, written in Lean 4 so that one language implements the harness, states its invariants, and is the language agents extend it in. One computation spans humans, agents, models and code, and all of its state lives in Git: a rich state trajectory -- rather than a chat conversation -- is an object the runtime can resume, rewind, fork, compare and merge. Waiting, communication, delegation and undo are primitives, not patterns the model reasons through each time. When an agent works out a procedure, it can write it once as a sealed Lean program whose type is its permission request, and the harness offers it back as a tool -- machinery for the model to use. To take the human out of the loop, L3M uses reversibility to decide where that is safe: a tool's review tier follows from how far its effects can be undone, so agents act freely where the runtime can recover. Because the machinery can change, the properties that make this safe are stated as kernel-checked theorems about the code that runs. On Terminal-Bench, an untuned L3M reaches about two thirds of its (unsafe) shell-equipped pass rate using only safe (not needing human review) tools.
2610.19591.abstract_zh: 人工智能的持久进步来自能够吸收更多计算的方法，语言模型也已能在单次调用内扩展计算。然而，有用的工作发生在多次调用之间：跨越数小时或数天，通过工具和外部系统，在多个智能体及其服务的人类之间，并越来越多地通过智能体自行编写的代码完成。此类工作能否复利增长，取决于外围运行框架，而框架面对一个模型没有的约束：参与计算的人类、模型、代码三方中，只有人类注意力无法扩展，因此只有人类不处于每个循环之中，计算才能增长。L3M 是以此为前提构建的运行时，用 Lean 4 编写，让同一种语言实现框架、陈述其不变量，并成为智能体扩展框架的语言。一次计算贯穿人类、智能体、模型和代码，所有状态保存在 Git 中：丰富的状态轨迹，而非聊天对话，成为运行时能够恢复、回退、分叉、比较和合并的对象。等待、通信、委派和撤销是原语，而不是模型每次都要自行推理的模式。当智能体找到一种程序时，可以将其写成封装的 Lean 程序，其类型就是权限请求，框架再把它作为工具交还，成为模型可用的机制。为使人类退出循环，L3M 利用可逆性判断何处安全：工具的审查等级取决于其效果能够撤销到什么程度，因此智能体在运行时能够恢复的地方自由行动。由于机制本身能够改变，保证安全的属性被写成关于实际运行代码、由内核检查的定理。在 Terminal-Bench 上，未经调优的 L3M 只使用安全工具（无需人工审查），就达到其配备不安全 shell 时通过率的大约三分之二。
2610.19591.update_target: Lean tool programs and persistent runtime state
2610.19591.mechanism_en: Git-backed state and permission-typed sealed programs support reuse; kernel-checked invariants bound changes and reversibility sets review tiers.
2610.19591.result_en: An untuned runtime attains about two thirds of its unsafe-shell pass rate using only tools that require no human review.
2610.19591.boundary_en: This is a runtime/verification result, not measured long-term recursive gain; theorem scope and external effects remain assumptions to inspect.

2610.19864.title: Euler: Towards Human-Centered Multi-Agent Mathematical Discovery
2610.19864.authors: Qiuyu Chen , Qi Wang , Liang Xu , Xin Jin , Baao Xie , Wenjun Zeng
2610.19864.abstract_en: Mathematical research drives scientific discovery, and recent advances in AI for mathematics have shown that language-model agents can solve challenging problems and develop substantial mathematical proofs. Yet much of today's AI-for-mathematics work centers on obtaining a final answer. This emphasis leaves the exploration behind a result difficult for researchers to understand, while long-running investigations face fragmented context and the risk of unsupported claims propagating across reasoning steps. We present Euler, a human-centered mathematical research system built around a shared, structured representation of the research process. Euler organizes mathematical statements, assumptions, proof dependencies, alternative approaches, failed attempts, and verification evidence into connected research graphs. This representation allows researchers to trace how results are developed and supplies agents with persistent, task-relevant knowledge for planning, collaboration, and verification across sessions. Researchers can also select a graph node linked to a saved team state, revisit the agents' earlier reasoning, and explore alternative directions through continued interaction. We illustrate Euler's capabilities through three mathematical research case studies and describe the implemented system and its software validation.
2610.19864.affiliation: Shanghai Jiao Tong University / Institute of Automation, CAS / Zhongguancun Academy / Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo Institute of Digital Twin
2610.19864.abstract_zh: 数学研究推动科学发现，近期人工智能数学研究已表明，语言模型智能体能够解决有挑战的问题并发展较为实质的数学证明。然而，目前许多工作以获得最终答案为中心，使结果背后的探索过程难以被研究者理解；长时间调查还面临上下文割裂和缺乏支撑的断言在推理步骤之间传播的风险。我们提出以人为中心的数学研究系统 Euler，围绕共享且结构化的研究过程表示构建。Euler 将数学命题、假设、证明依赖、替代方法、失败尝试和验证证据组织成相连的研究图。这种表示让研究者能够追踪结果如何形成，并为智能体跨会话规划、协作和验证提供持久且与任务相关的知识。研究者也可以选择一个与已保存团队状态相连的图节点，重新查看智能体之前的推理，并通过继续交互探索其他方向。我们通过三个数学研究案例展示 Euler 的能力，并介绍已实现的系统及其软件验证。
2610.19864.mechanism_en: Statements, assumptions, failed attempts and verification evidence guide cross-session planning; saved team states permit alternative branches.
2610.19864.result_en: Three mathematical research case studies illustrate the implemented system and its software validation.
2610.19864.boundary_en: Case studies and software checks are not blanket correctness proofs for every mathematical claim or measured autonomous RSI.

2610.20022.title: Memorizing Who, Knowing How: Benchmarking Personal and Procedural Memory for Persistent Assistants
2610.20022.authors: Maosheng Qin , Qi Zhang , Mingxuan Xia , Jinglei Chen , Jiexiang Wang , Sheng Guo , Cheng Peng , Haobo Wang
2610.20022.abstract_en: Memory systems for persistent personal agents must move beyond isolated memories, maintaining both personal memory about whom they serve and procedural memory about how to act. Crucially, in harness-based personal assistance, procedures or skills are inherently user-conditioned: personal context determines which procedures apply, how they are instantiated, and when they should change. Existing benchmarks typically emphasize either personal or procedural memory, leaving their interaction underexplored. We introduce PraxisMemBench, a harness-based benchmark for persistent personal assistance across daily-life and work trajectories, where personal and procedural memory evolve together and later tasks depend on both. Experiments show that maintaining two memory types separately is insufficient, with completion dropping from single-type to interdependent dependencies (84.6% to 77.9%). More broadly, across existing methods, relation-related failures increase from early to late sessions as interaction history grows (59.8% to 72.9%), revealing a continual-maintenance challenge: writing correct memories is not enough if their evolving content and organization cannot be preserved for later retrieval. To address this, we propose PraxisMem, which uses privileged joint-state supervision to internalize the ability to maintain memory content and organization into the memory manager, with location-aware GRPO and dynamic residual-routed OPSD. PraxisMem reaches 40.78% overall Session Success Rate, compared with 20.60% for Claude Code's native memory.
2610.20022.abstract_zh: 持久个人智能体的记忆系统必须超越彼此孤立的记忆，同时维护关于服务对象的个人记忆和关于如何行动的程序记忆。关键在于，在基于运行框架的个人辅助中，程序或技能本质上依赖用户：个人上下文决定哪些程序适用、如何实例化以及何时应该改变。现有基准通常强调个人记忆或程序记忆之一，较少研究两者的交互。我们提出 PraxisMemBench，一种基于框架的持久个人辅助基准，覆盖日常生活与工作轨迹，个人及程序记忆共同演化，后续任务依赖两者。实验表明，仅将两类记忆分别维护并不足够：从单一类型依赖转为相互依赖时，完成率从 84.6% 降到 77.9%。更广泛地看，随着交互历史增长，现有方法中与关系相关的失败从早期会话的 59.8% 增加到后期的 72.9%，揭示持续维护挑战：仅写入正确记忆还不够，必须保持其不断变化的内容和组织，以便之后检索。为此，我们提出 PraxisMem，利用特权联合状态监督，通过位置感知 GRPO 和动态残差路由 OPSD，将维护记忆内容和组织的能力内化到记忆管理器中。PraxisMem 的总体会话成功率达到 40.78%，而 Claude Code 原生记忆为 20.60%。
2610.20022.update_target: Personal/procedural memory organization and manager weights
2610.20022.mechanism_en: Privileged joint-state supervision with location-aware GRPO and residual-routed OPSD trains maintenance of evolving memory relations.
2610.20022.result_en: PraxisMem reaches 40.78% overall Session Success Rate versus 20.60% native Claude Code memory.
2610.20022.boundary_en: Privileged training state is additional supervision; user-conditioned procedures and memory relations should be evaluated jointly on later sessions.

2610.20312.title: Reflect After Failure: Brain-Inspired Self-Evolving Agents for Embodied Spatial Intelligence
2610.20312.authors: Xin Li , Xiaohuan Gu , Yifan Wang , Shaobin Ling , Tianli Shi , Jingao Xu , Zhimeng Yin , Dapeng Wu , Yun Wang
2610.20312.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have made substantial progress in spatial reasoning, and self-evolving agents further extend these capabilities to embodied environments by learning from interactions. However, current self-evolution remains particularly challenging in embodied spatial tasks, complex and multi-step decisions from partial visual evidence making it difficult to determine why an execution fails. The failure may stem from misperception, insufficient exploration, or incorrect planning, yet execution feedback alone rarely reveals which component is responsible. As a result, simply accumulating interaction experience can reinforce ineffective strategies. To address this, we propose HiMeco, a brain-inspired self-evolving agent for embodied spatial intelligence, inspired by metacognitive monitoring and hippocampal memory consolidation. Through Hippocampal-Metacognitive Reflection, HiMeco diagnoses failures in perception-exploration-planning (PEP), then compares execution attempts to derive reusable strategies and guidance for avoiding recurring errors. It also abstracts interaction programs into parameterized skills, using evidence contracts and execution-based validation to determine their retention and reuse. These strategies and skills guide subsequent interactions, with memory updated only between rounds and model parameters kept frozen. HiMeco achieves state-of-the-art performance on ESI-Bench, and it also improves accuracy on EmbSpatial-Bench by 3.94 percentage points without evolution.
2610.20312.affiliation: City University of Hong Kong / East China Normal University / University of Electronic Science and Technology of China / Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen / University of Hong Kong
2610.20312.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在空间推理方面已取得显著进展，自我进化智能体通过从交互中学习进一步将能力扩展到具身环境。但具身空间任务中的自我进化仍然十分困难：依据局部视觉证据进行复杂多步决策，使执行失败的原因难以确定。失败可能来自误感知、探索不足或规划错误，而仅有执行反馈很少能够揭示具体负责的组件，因此简单累积交互经验可能强化无效策略。我们提出受元认知监控和海马体记忆巩固启发、面向具身空间智能的脑启发自我进化智能体 HiMeco。通过海马体—元认知反思，HiMeco 诊断感知—探索—规划（PEP）中的失败，再比较执行尝试，形成可复用策略和避免重复错误的指导。它还将交互程序抽象为参数化技能，利用证据契约和基于执行的验证决定保留与复用。这些策略和技能指导后续交互；记忆仅在轮次之间更新，模型参数保持冻结。HiMeco 在 ESI-Bench 上达到最先进性能，并在不进行进化的情况下，将 EmbSpatial-Bench 准确率提高 3.94 个百分点。
2610.20312.update_target: External strategies and parameterized embodied skills
2610.20312.mechanism_en: Perception/exploration/planning diagnosis compares attempts; evidence contracts and execution validation gate between-round memory retention.
2610.20312.result_en: HiMeco reports leading ESI-Bench results; EmbSpatial-Bench accuracy improves 3.94 points without evolution.
2610.20312.boundary_en: The transfer headline without evolution must not be attributed to test-time learning; model weights stay frozen.

2610.20318.title: Efficient Test-Time Adaptation For Robot Policies
2610.20318.authors: Motasem Alfarra , Pietro Mazzaglia , Markus Peschl , Daniel Dijkman , Christos Louizos
2610.20318.abstract_en: Reinforcement-learning policies for robot locomotion can fail at deployment when operating conditions shift (e.g., rough or slippery terrain, payload changes, sensing degradation), and retraining or manual recalibration is often infeasible under on-device latency and memory constraints. We study test-time adaptation (TTA) for robotic control: adapting a pretrained policy online and in a self-supervised manner during execution, without access to rewards. Our starting point is a lightweight baseline that updates only the actor using a frozen pretrained critic as a deployment-time performance surrogate. Building on this, we introduce TEMPO, a test-time entropy-regularized, memory-guided policy optimization method that stabilizes critic-driven updates under severe shift. TEMPO combines (i) an entropy-promoting regularizer on the critic's predictive distribution to mitigate overconfident extrapolation, and (ii) a score-based memory, inspired by prioritized replay, that prioritizes low-value ("hard") observations and applies importance sampling to focus limited computation on the most informative deployment conditions. Across Go1, Go2, and G1 in MuJoCo Playground under four representative shifts and multiple architectures, TEMPO yields consistent gains, reaching up to 80% improvement in a single-device setting. We further validate on a physical Unitree Go2 with an added calf payload, where fully on-device adaptation improves performance over the non-adapted baseline across real-world episodes.
2610.20318.abstract_zh: 机器人运动控制的强化学习策略可能在部署条件变化时失败，例如崎岖或湿滑地形、载荷变化和感知退化，而设备端延迟及内存限制往往使重新训练或人工标定不可行。我们研究机器人控制的测试时适应（TTA）：在执行期间无需奖励，在线、以自监督方式适配预训练策略。起点是一个轻量基线，仅更新 actor，并使用冻结的预训练 critic 作为部署时性能代理。在此基础上，我们提出测试时熵正则化、记忆引导的策略优化方法 TEMPO，以稳定严重分布偏移下由 critic 驱动的更新。TEMPO 结合两项机制：（i）在 critic 预测分布上使用促进熵的正则项，缓解过度自信的外推；（ii）受优先经验回放启发的基于分数的记忆，优先保留低价值的困难观测，并采用重要性采样，将有限计算集中到最有信息量的部署条件。在 MuJoCo Playground 中对 Go1、Go2、G1、四种代表性偏移和多种架构的实验中，TEMPO 持续取得收益，单设备设置下提升最多 80%。我们还在小腿增加载荷的真实 Unitree Go2 上验证，完全在设备端进行的适应，在真实世界各回合中均优于不适配基线。
2610.20318.update_target: Actor weights and prioritized deployment memory
2610.20318.mechanism_en: A frozen critic supplies the surrogate; entropy regularization and importance-weighted hard observations stabilize reward-free actor updates.
2610.20318.result_en: Go1/Go2/G1 simulation gains reach 80% in one-device settings; physical Go2 payload experiments favor on-device adaptation.
2610.20318.boundary_en: The frozen critic may extrapolate incorrectly under shift; surrogate reward-free adaptation is bounded online optimization, not recursive improver evolution.

2610.20399.title: Cortex: Consolidating Context into Parametric Memory
2610.20399.authors: Jintian Zhang , Feng He , Xinnian Liang , Ziwen Xu , Haoming Xu , Haojing Huang , Shuangzhi Wu , Ningyu Zhang
2610.20399.categories_text: Computation and Language (cs.CL) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
2610.20399.abstract_en: Context can improve large language model performance, but these gains may be lost after context removal. Inspired by biological systems consolidation, we formulate Memory Consolidation (MC) as internalizing these gains while preserving non-target capabilities, connecting context-specified editing, skill learning, and behavioral steering under a common objective. We introduce a five-task-family testbed measuring consolidation and retention under single, batch, and sequential updates. We propose Cortex, which generates prospective queries to anticipate uses of context and distills context-conditioned outputs into mergeable low-rank or structural feed-forward network updates. Across 4B--120B dense and mixture-of-experts backbones, including both text-only and multimodal models, Cortex lies on the empirical consolidation--retention Pareto frontier in most evaluated settings. After 50 sequential factual edits on a 14B model, Cortex-Structural recovers 88.9% of the context-induced gain while retaining 99.8% of original non-target performance.
2610.20399.affiliation: Zhejiang University / ByteDance Seed / Tsinghua University
2610.20399.abstract_zh: 上下文能够提高大语言模型性能，但移除上下文后，这些收益可能消失。受生物系统巩固启发，我们将记忆巩固（MC）表述为：在保留非目标能力的同时将这些收益内化，并将上下文指定编辑、技能学习和行为引导纳入统一目标。我们提出包含五类任务的测试平台，在单次、批量和顺序更新下测量巩固与保留。我们提出 Cortex，通过生成前瞻查询预判上下文的用途，并将依赖上下文的输出蒸馏为可合并的低秩更新或前馈网络结构更新。在从 4B 到 120B 的稠密及混合专家骨干上，包括纯文本和多模态模型，Cortex 在大多数评估设置中位于经验上的巩固—保留帕累托前沿。在一个 14B 模型上顺序进行 50 次事实编辑后，Cortex-Structural 恢复了上下文所带来收益的 88.9%，同时保留原始非目标性能的 99.8%。
2610.20399.update_target: Low-rank or structural feed-forward weight updates
2610.20399.mechanism_en: Prospective queries distill context-conditioned behavior into mergeable parameter changes; consolidation and non-target retention are jointly measured.
2610.20399.result_en: After 50 factual edits on a 14B model, structural Cortex recovers 88.9% of context gains and retains 99.8% non-target performance.
2610.20399.boundary_en: This Cortex is distinct from the earlier coding-skill tool of the same name; consolidation gains do not imply recursive updater improvement.

2610.20563.title: Scaling Discovery Requires Forgetting
2610.20563.authors: Shangyin Tan , Ben Zhou , Lakshya A Agrawal , Jialin Zhang , Yilin Chen , Qiuyang Mang , Donghyun Lee , Dennis Jacob , Koushik Sen , Alex Dimakis , Matei Zaharia
2610.20563.abstract_en: Automated research with LLM agents has shown promising results in various domains. Through iterative refinement and scored verifiers, LLM agents are capable of discovering new ideas. There are different ways to scale automated research: let one agent iterate for longer, run several agents in parallel, or further let the parallel agents communicate and build on one another's candidates. However, we find that all three strategies eventually plateau as the agents accumulate history. Each agent becomes anchored to its own past attempts, making fewer and smaller edits. Beyond this point, additional budget brings little further improvement. In this paper, we show that the key to scaling discovery further is to forget. Periodically discarding the search state, including every agent's session and the candidate history, and restarting from the best candidate found so far, unblocks the search and pushes the same budget further. We implement forgetting in a team of agents with communication and evaluate it on four tasks spanning heuristic programming, kernel optimization and model training. The results show up to 15% improvement compared to parallel agents, and up to 39% compared to a single agent. Our results suggest that, for open-ended discovery, what an agent is allowed to remember matters as much as how much compute it is given.
2610.20563.abstract_zh: 利用大语言模型智能体进行自动化研究，在多个领域已显示出前景。通过迭代细化和评分验证器，智能体能够发现新想法。扩展自动化研究有多种方式：让单个智能体迭代更久、并行运行多个智能体，或让并行智能体进一步通信并基于彼此候选继续构建。然而，我们发现三种策略都会随着历史累积最终进入平台期。每个智能体都被自己的过去尝试锚定，修改越来越少、幅度越来越小。超过这一点后，增加预算几乎不再带来改进。本文表明，进一步扩展发现的关键是遗忘。定期丢弃搜索状态，包括所有智能体会话和候选历史，并从目前找到的最佳候选重新开始，可以解除搜索阻塞，让同等预算走得更远。我们在可通信的智能体团队中实现遗忘，并在覆盖启发式编程、内核优化和模型训练的四项任务上评估。结果显示，相比并行智能体最多提高 15%，相比单个智能体最多提高 39%。结果表明，在开放式发现中，允许智能体记住什么，与给予它多少计算同样重要。
2610.20563.update_target: Search state and retained best research candidate
2610.20563.mechanism_en: Periodically clear sessions and candidate history, then restart from the best candidate to escape historical anchoring.
2610.20563.result_en: Four tasks show gains up to 15% over parallel agents and 39% over one agent at the studied budgets.
2610.20563.boundary_en: The best artifact survives while history is discarded; forgetting is a designed search intervention, not unconditional deletion of useful evidence.

2610.20597.title: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents
2610.20597.authors: Haofei Yu , Yixing Chen , Yining Zhao , Xuyan Ye , Yuxiang Liu , Zhigang Hua , Yan Xie , Shuang Yang , Jiaxuan You
2610.20597.abstract_en:
Training language agents is bottlenecked by the high cost of long-horizon rollouts, yet standard agentic reinforcement learning (RL) learns only from a terminal scalar reward, leaving the supervision in intermediate steps largely unused. Prior work exploits this supervision through value targets that estimate per-step success probabilities or observation targets that fit environment response. Both are hard to construct well: (1) value targets come from the same single scalar signal for each step in the trajectory, and (2) observation targets, such as web pages and terminal logs, are long and noisy and reach only one step ahead. We propose 
ame, which adds a third kind of multi-step action targets. On successful on-policy trajectories, 
ame trains the policy backbone to generate the action sequences that follows each history. Each action is also supervised when forecast from the preceding histories, forming a temporal ensemble that the shared backbone absorbs during training, and this enables acting and forecasting to co-evolve. The policy still acts one step at a time at inference, with no overhead. Across five benchmarks (ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, WebShop, $	au^2$-bench, and AppWorld), 
ame (1) achieves stronger aggregate performance than GRPO and RL baselines with predictive auxiliary targets across simulated environments, while improving overall performance on both realistic applications; (2) delivers up to $1.9	imes$ and $2.0	imes$ higher sample efficiency than ECHO and GRPO, respectively, on ScienceWorld; and (3) achieves these gains with a single policy backbone, without additional models, separate pretraining, or inference overhead. The codebase is available at this https URL .
2610.20597.affiliation: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign / University of California San Diego / Meta AI
2610.20597.abstract_zh:
语言智能体训练受限于长时程执行的高成本，但标准智能体强化学习只从终端标量奖励学习，忽略了中间步骤中的大量监督。已有工作通过两种目标利用这些监督：估计逐步成功概率的价值目标，以及拟合环境响应的观测目标。两者都难以良好构建：（1）轨迹中每一步的价值目标都来自同一个标量信号；（2）网页和终端日志等观测目标冗长、嘈杂，且仅面向下一步。我们提出 
ame，增加第三类多步动作目标。在成功的同策略轨迹上，
