ame 训练策略骨干生成每段历史之后的动作序列。每个动作还从更早的历史出发接受预测监督，形成被共享骨干在训练中吸收的时间集成，使行动与预测协同进化。推理时策略仍每次执行一步，不增加开销。在五个基准（ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop、$	au^2$-bench 和 AppWorld）上，
ame：（1）在模拟环境中，总体表现优于 GRPO 和使用预测辅助目标的强化学习基线，同时在两个真实应用场景中提高总体表现；（2）在 ScienceWorld 上，相对 ECHO 和 GRPO 分别达到最高 1.9 倍及 2.0 倍的样本效率；（3）仅使用一个策略骨干实现上述收益，无额外模型、单独预训练或推理开销。代码库见原文链接。
2610.20597.mechanism_en: Successful on-policy trajectories supervise future action sequences from multiple preceding histories; the shared backbone absorbs temporal ensembles.
2610.20597.result_en: Five benchmarks show aggregate gains; ScienceWorld sample efficiency reaches 1.9x ECHO and 2.0x GRPO with no added inference model.
2610.20597.boundary_en: Auxiliary self-supervision is not a separately evolving runtime; the official abstract retains an unexpanded method-name macro.

2610.18927.title: Why Static Skill Inconsistencies Do Not Equate to Runtime Risks: A Behavioral Analysis of LLM Agent Execution
2610.18927.authors: Fengrui Fan , Huahao Wang , Jingyi Fang , Yutao Hu , Yueming Wu , Deqing Zou
2610.18927.abstract_en: LLM agent frameworks heavily rely on external skill assets to standardize tool usage, encode operational workflows, and supply executable runtime resources. Despite their widespread adoption, multi-component skill packages frequently suffer from cross-artifact inconsistencies, where documentation, scripts, and configuration files specify conflicting behavioral constraints. Although static auditing techniques can uncover such contractual discrepancies, static defect volume cannot reliably reflect real-world agent performance degradation. This gap leaves practitioners without rigorous evidence to assess the practical risk of flawed agent skills. This paper presents a systematic empirical study to demystify the runtime implications of skill inconsistencies. We conduct large-scale auditing over 575 community and benchmark skills, yielding 1,182 manually validated contract inconsistencies. We further build a controlled evaluation pipeline with 49 executable agent tasks and three representative LLMs across NoSkill, OriginalSkill, and FixedSkill experimental settings. Through fine-grained behavioral analysis of 441 paired execution trajectories, we quantify the actual performance impacts of resolved defects.
2610.18927.affiliation: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
2610.18927.abstract_zh: 大语言模型智能体框架大量依赖外部技能资产，以规范工具使用、编码操作流程并提供可执行的运行时资源。尽管应用广泛，多组件技能包经常出现跨文件不一致：文档、脚本和配置文件规定了彼此冲突的行为约束。静态审计能够发现这些契约差异，但静态缺陷数量并不能可靠反映真实智能体性能退化。这种差距使实践者缺少严谨证据来评估有缺陷技能的实际风险。本文通过系统性实证研究分析技能不一致的运行时影响。我们对 575 个社区及基准技能开展大规模审计，得到 1,182 个经人工验证的契约不一致项。进一步构建受控评估流程，在 NoSkill、OriginalSkill 和 FixedSkill 三种设置下，覆盖 49 项可执行智能体任务和三个代表性大语言模型。通过对 441 条配对执行轨迹的细粒度行为分析，我们量化修复缺陷带来的实际性能影响。
2610.18927.mechanism_en: Manual static auditing is paired with NoSkill/OriginalSkill/FixedSkill execution comparisons to measure realized rather than presumed risk.
2610.18927.result_en: 575 skills yield 1182 validated inconsistencies; 49 tasks and three models produce 441 paired trajectories.
2610.18927.boundary_en: The reviewed abstract gives study counts without a numerical risk-effect estimate; static inconsistency alone is not demonstrated runtime harm.

2610.18948.title: Limits of Statistical Assurance for Embodied and Agentic AI under Adaptive Adversaries
2610.18948.categories_text: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR) ; Machine Learning (cs.LG); Machine Learning (stat.ML)
2610.18948.abstract_en: Finite safety assessments cannot exclude an adversary that preserves unattacked behavior until certification and activates afterward. We characterize this limitation for embodied and tool-use AI. An adversary that matches the complete observation law until observable, irrevocable certification and retains intervention access afterward attains $v\mathbb{E}[(n-S_0)_+]$ expected post-certification events over $n$ trials, where $v$ is the active event probability and $S_0$ the unattacked certification time. The result covers adaptive and privately randomized evaluators. Switching at certification is exactly optimal for a fixed likelihood-ratio test under memoryless, event-increasing interventions without a binding intervention budget. A positive clean-certification requirement forces linear worst-case expected excess when intervention raises event rates over an authorized deployment horizon, even if certification is deferred to the deadline. In simulated RoCo collaboration, switching yields commanded-separation violations in 34 of 36 post-certification episodes. Preregistered randomized AgentDojo trials estimate 1.98 additional security violations per four-task continuation (95% interval [1.67, 2.29]). An adversarial language-model controller infers hidden certification from noisy evaluation receipts and times intervention accordingly. With permanent revocation, a mixture likelihood-ratio monitor bounds cumulative excess above a prespecified reference rate at square-root order, up to logarithmic factors, on every sample path. A single fixed alternative can permit linear expected excess under stationary attacks. Against a controller observing the monitor's rule and statistic, live mixture monitoring reduces violations from 12.00 to 3.81 per 24 assigned task opportunities. Revocation also reduces tasks executed.
2610.18948.abstract_zh: 有限的安全评估无法排除这样一种对手：在认证前保持未受攻击时的行为，在认证后才激活。我们刻画具身和工具使用人工智能中的这一限制。若对手在可观察且不可撤销的认证前，使完整观测分布与无攻击情形相同，并在认证后仍保有干预权限，则在 $n$ 次试验中可实现 $vmathbb{E}[(n-S_0)_+]$ 次期望认证后事件，其中 $v$ 为激活后的事件概率，$S_0$ 为无攻击时的认证时刻。结果覆盖自适应及使用私有随机性的评估器。对于固定似然比检验，在无约束性干预预算、无记忆且提高事件率的干预条件下，于认证时切换是严格最优的。当干预在授权部署期限内提高事件率时，要求以正概率在干净行为下获得认证，会迫使最坏情况下的期望超额按线性增长，即使将认证推迟到截止时刻。在模拟 RoCo 协作中，切换攻击在 36 个认证后回合的 34 个中导致指令分离违规。预注册随机 AgentDojo 试验估计，每个四任务后续阶段额外产生 1.98 次安全违规（95% 区间为 [1.67, 2.29]）。对抗语言模型控制器能够从带噪评估回执推断隐藏认证，并据此安排干预时机。若允许永久撤销权限，混合似然比监控器能够在每条样本路径上，将相对于预先指定参考率的累积超额限制在平方根量级，外加对数因子。单个固定备择在平稳攻击下可能仍允许线性期望超额。面对能够观察监控规则和统计量的控制器，在线混合监控将每 24 次分配任务机会中的违规数从 12.00 降至 3.81。撤销权限也减少了实际执行任务数。
2610.18948.mechanism_en: Theory models a delayed adversary; randomized agent trials and simulation test switching attacks, while mixture monitoring supports permanent revocation.
2610.18948.result_en: AgentDojo estimates 1.98 extra violations per four-task continuation; live monitoring lowers violations 12.00 to 3.81 per 24 opportunities.
2610.18948.boundary_en: Theory assumes continuing intervention access and observability conditions; revocation also reduces completed work and is not cost-free safety.

2610.19084.title: Beyond Aggregate Accuracy: Item-Level Transitions in Prompt Optimization
2610.19084.categories_text: Machine Learning (cs.LG) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
2610.19084.abstract_en: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) uses feedback from model responses to improve prompts automatically. However, its effectiveness is usually measured through overall scores, which do not reveal which questions become correct, which previously correct answers become wrong, or whether improvements extend to unseen questions. We introduce Reflective Feedback-Driven Prompt Optimization (RFDPO), a tool that tracks recoveries (incorrect to correct), regressions (correct to incorrect), and churn (all changed outcomes). RFDPO uses this feedback to guide subsequent revisions and records prompt changes throughout optimization. We evaluate RFDPO across five benchmarks covering law, knowledge, instruction following, mathematics, and privacy, using GPT-5 as the optimizer and GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4.1 Mini as solvers. Our results show that overall accuracy can hide substantial changes: in five of nine configurations, churn was at least five times the absolute net change, and a single-item net change concealed up to 17 changed outcomes. Average validation gains were 7.9 percentage points, compared with 5.2 points on held-out tests. In a controlled ablation on LegalBench-Hearsay, item-level feedback reduced churn by 40% ($p=0.024$) while maintaining similar net gains. These findings motivate reporting recovery, regression, churn, and performance on unseen data alongside overall accuracy.
2610.19084.affiliation: Texas A&M University-Kingsville / Rajshahi University of Engineering & Technology
2610.19084.abstract_zh: 自动提示优化（APO）利用模型回复反馈自动改进提示。但其效果通常用总体分数衡量，无法显示哪些问题变正确、哪些原本正确的答案变错误，以及收益是否扩展到未见问题。我们提出反思式反馈驱动提示优化工具 RFDPO，跟踪恢复（错误变正确）、退化（正确变错误）和变动总量（所有结果改变）。RFDPO 用这些反馈指导后续修改，并在整个优化过程中记录提示变化。我们在法律、知识、指令遵循、数学和隐私五类基准上评估，以 GPT-5 为优化器，GPT-4o-mini 和 GPT-4.1 Mini 为求解器。结果显示，总体准确率可以掩盖显著变化：九种配置中有五种的变动总量至少是绝对净变化的五倍；仅一个条目的净变化可能掩盖最多 17 个结果发生变化。平均验证集收益为 7.9 个百分点，留出测试为 5.2 个百分点。在 LegalBench-Hearsay 的受控消融中，逐条反馈在保持相近净收益的同时，将变动总量降低 40%（$p=0.024$）。这些发现支持同时报告恢复、退化、变动总量和未见数据上的表现，而不只报告总体准确率。
2610.19084.mechanism_en: Recoveries, regressions and churn guide edits; validation and held-out tests track whether net gains conceal unstable answers.
2610.19084.result_en: Validation/test gains average 7.9/5.2 points; one LegalBench control lowers churn 40% at similar net gain.
2610.19084.boundary_en: Five of nine configurations have churn at least five times net change; single-item net gains can hide 17 changed outcomes.

2610.19159.title: Into the Unknown: Benchmarking AI agents on open scientific research problems
2610.19159.authors: Seungone Kim , Jiayi Geng , Young-Jun Lee , Bo Liu , Juyoung Suk , Nicholas Lubbers , Mitchell Wood , Marcus Noack , Yong-Xin Yao , Yuan Shi , Roxana Bujack , Cristina Garcia Cardona , Austin Rodriguez , Ilon Joseph , Woojin Cho , Zora Zhiruo Wang , Chuanyang Jin , Ian Wu , Apurva Gandhi , Tianjian Li , Weiwei Sun , Carolin Lawrence , Kiril Gashteovski , Dongyeop Kang , Jay Shin , Akari Asai , Graham Neubig , Sean Welleck
2610.19159.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
2610.19159.abstract_en: Can AI agents carry out research on open scientific problems? We introduce Into the Unknown, a benchmark that provides an agent with a science paper along with a research direction to pursue and tasks it to write a follow-up paper. We work with scientists at US Department of Energy (DOE) national laboratories, who each contribute an unpublished follow-up direction from their own work together with the necessary conditions a submission must meet. While assessing the quality of a follow-up paper is challenging in general, using these conditions to form a rubric makes evaluation more tractable for research problems that have no reference answer. We have nine frontier agents write 15 follow-ups each, spanning quantum computing, plasma physics, computational chemistry, materials science, and scientific machine learning domains. None of the 135 submissions satisfies all the conditions, and 114 fail our integrity check, most often because the paper claims work that was never done or reports numbers that contradict the recorded evidence. Overall, agents readily produce papers that look like follow-ups, but none meets the standard of the domain scientist, leaving substantial headroom. Our code and data are publicly available.
2610.19159.affiliation: Carnegie Mellon University / University of Minnesota / Stanford University / Trillion Labs / Los Alamos National Laboratory / Sandia National Laboratory / Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory / Ames National Laboratory / Iowa State University / University of Colorado Boulder / Michigan State University / Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory / TelePIX / Johns Hopkins University / NEC Laboratories Europe / Ss. Cyril and Methodius University of Skopje
2610.19159.abstract_zh: 人工智能智能体能否针对开放科学问题开展研究？我们提出 Into the Unknown 基准，向智能体提供一篇科学论文和一个待追求的研究方向，要求其撰写后续论文。我们与美国能源部（DOE）国家实验室的科学家合作，每位科学家从自己的工作中提出一个尚未发表的后续方向，并给出投稿必须满足的必要条件。虽然一般而言难以评估后续论文质量，但将这些条件形成评分准则，使没有参考答案的研究问题也更易于评估。我们让九个前沿智能体各写 15 篇后续论文，覆盖量子计算、等离子体物理、计算化学、材料科学和科学机器学习。135 份提交没有一份满足所有条件，114 份未通过完整性检查，最常见原因是声称完成了实际未做的工作，或报告与记录证据矛盾的数字。总体来看，智能体很容易产出看起来像后续研究的论文，但没有一份达到领域科学家的标准，仍有很大的改进空间。代码和数据已公开。
2610.19159.mechanism_en: Scientists supply unpublished directions and required-condition rubrics; submissions are compared with recorded execution evidence.
2610.19159.result_en: None of 135 papers meets every condition; 114 fail integrity checks across nine agents and 15 directions.
2610.19159.boundary_en: These are benchmark-specific failures, not impossibility of automated science; plausible prose or acceptance claims cannot replace execution evidence.

2610.19366.title: Seeing, Maintaining, and Learning: The Evolution of Multimodal Agent Memory
2610.19366.authors: Minghao Guo , Qingyue Jiao , Xiujin Liu , Jianhong Pang , Ruimeng Yang , Naihao Xu , Liwei Che , Haochen Xue , Ziqi Wang , Xinying Cai , Jiaxuan Luo , Jiaxin Deng , Xuesong Ye , Jintao Qu , Wenyao Gao , Jingwen Gu , Chenyang Zhao , Shichun Liu , Guibin Zhang , Zefang Liu , Siyin Wang , Wujiang Xu , Danrui Li , Zeru Shi , Woongyeong Yeo , Shuang Liu , Wei-Chieh Huang , Weizhi Zhang , Tianyu Yang , Kangsan Kim , Yebowen Hu , Bowen Wen , Bowen Jiang , Haohao Su , Ming Yin , Sheldon Yu , Mian Zhang , Yuyan Chen , Hanrong Zhang , Kai Mei , Zihao Zhang , Mingyu Jin , Xi Zhu , Hengyi Wang , Tianxin Wei , Linyong Nan , Zhenwen Liang , Zhendong Chu , Ziqi Huang , Yongye Su , Sixun Dong , Shujian Liu , Kaiqu Liang , Jiaojiao Han , Zhaoye Fei , Kun Wang , Shihan Dou , Zhichun Guo , Xingjian Diao , Zeqi Gu , Heng Wang , Tao Feng , Cheng Qian , Hamid Palangi , Silei Xu , Xi Yun , Yi Zhu , Shilong Liu , Qingsong Wen , Sung Ju Hwang , Zuxuan Wu , Yu-Gang Jiang , Yiyu Shi , Dimitris N. Metaxas , Jiaxuan You , Julian McAuley , Mengdi Wang , Jiawei Han , Philip S. Yu , Ziyi Ye
2610.19366.categories_text: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI) ; Computation and Language (cs.CL); Robotics (cs.RO)
2610.19366.abstract_en: Multimodal models and agents have emerged to enable AI systems to learn from and interact with the real world more like humans by integrating information across multiple modalities. However, enabling multimodal agents to continually acquire useful information from complex, heterogeneous multimodal data remains a significant challenge as they move toward long-horizon tasks and lifelong settings. Addressing this challenge requires effective memory mechanisms that can maintain continuity across sessions, adapt to changing users and environments, and refine memory-management policies through accumulated experience. We introduce a two-axis analytical framework for multimodal agent memory structured around two key questions: how multimodal information is formed and represented (Axis I, Formation and Representation), and how its management adapts with accumulated experience (Axis II, Memory Management). Axis I, Formation and Representation, characterizes what information is retained and how it is encoded (e.g., modality-specific embeddings, textual and structured records, latent and parametric representations) to support subsequent reasoning and action. Axis II, Memory Management, distinguishes three tiers: T1 Static Memory reuses fixed memory; T2 Dynamic Memory updates memory through a stable policy; and T3 Self-Evolving Memory updates memory through an evolving policy. Based on this framework, we synthesize recurring design patterns and derive principles for balancing source fidelity with abstraction, maintaining temporal validity and provenance, grounding memory use in recoverable evidence, and evolving memory policies over time. Furthermore, we discuss the challenges and potential future directions for the memory mechanism of multimodal agents.
2610.19366.affiliation: Rutgers / Notre Dame / Michigan / Fudan / MBZUAI / JHU / Peer AI / UC San Diego / Georgia Tech / SemiAnalysis / USC / LMSYS Org / NUS / Capital One / Independent Researcher / CMU / UIC / KAIST / Zoom / NVIDIA / Penn / MSU / Duke / UT Dallas / Cornell / ModelsLive / Princeton / UCF / Squirrel AI / NTU / Purdue / TikTok / Dartmouth / UIUC / Washington / Humani Labs / Meta (source abbreviations)
2610.19366.abstract_zh: 多模态模型与智能体通过整合多种模态信息，使人工智能系统能够更像人类一样从真实世界学习并与之交互。然而，当多模态智能体走向长时程任务和终身学习场景时，如何从复杂异构多模态数据中持续获取有用信息，仍然是重要挑战。解决它需要有效的记忆机制，以保持跨会话连续性、适应变化的用户和环境，并依据累积经验细化记忆管理策略。我们提出多模态智能体记忆的双轴分析框架，围绕两个问题：多模态信息如何形成及表示（轴 I，形成与表示），以及其管理如何随累积经验而适应（轴 II，记忆管理）。轴 I 描述保留什么信息、如何编码，例如模态特定嵌入、文本与结构化记录、潜在及参数化表示，以支持后续推理和行动。轴 II 区分三个层级：T1 静态记忆复用固定记忆；T2 动态记忆通过稳定策略更新记忆；T3 自我进化记忆通过不断进化的策略更新记忆。基于该框架，我们综合反复出现的设计模式，并归纳平衡来源忠实度与抽象、维护时间有效性和来源、以可恢复证据支撑记忆使用，以及随时间进化记忆策略的原则。最后讨论记忆机制的挑战和潜在未来方向。
2610.19366.update_target: A taxonomy of multimodal memory and its management
2610.19366.mechanism_en: Two axes separate memory representation from static, dynamically updated and policy-evolving management; provenance and temporal validity organize the review.
2610.19366.result_en: The paper synthesizes design patterns and research principles rather than evaluating one new self-evolving system.
2610.19366.boundary_en: Dynamic memory under a fixed updater is T2, not T3 policy evolution; taxonomy and future directions are analytical contributions.

2610.19373.title: Evaluating Compressed Memory: Dependence, Utility, and Content Benefit
2610.19373.authors: Minsu Oh , Seunghui Jwa , Chanjun Park , Yeo-Chan Yoon
2610.19373.abstract_en: Does a language model answer better because its compressed memory contains useful document information? Replacing memory vectors with zeros can lower a trained model's score without showing that it outperforms a model trained without memory. We combine zeroing with separately trained models that cannot access stored text or receive the same constant input for every document. Across nine systems, some models rely on memory yet perform worse than the trained alternative. For example, in experiments that predict states in generated stories, zeroing memory worsens a model's prediction loss, yet a model trained without memory achieves lower loss than the original model with intact memory. On TriviaQA, giving xRAG memory from another question's passage raises F1, which measures word overlap with accepted answers, from 19.38 without a document to 24.78. Its effect on how often outputs contain an accepted answer is statistically uncertain. The question's retrieved passage scores higher still (29.88 F1). Thus a gain over no document alone does not establish that the gain requires the question's passage. Evaluations must therefore specify the comparison model, absolute performance, and generation and scoring conditions.
2610.19373.abstract_zh: 语言模型回答得更好，是否因为压缩记忆中包含有用的文档信息？将记忆向量替换为零，可能降低受训模型的得分，却不能证明它优于训练时不使用记忆的模型。我们将置零实验与单独训练的对照模型结合；这些对照模型无法访问存储文本，或对每个文档都收到相同的常量输入。在九个系统中，有些模型依赖记忆，却比训练出的替代模型表现更差。例如，在预测生成故事状态的实验中，记忆置零会使预测损失变差，但不使用记忆训练的模型，其损失仍低于原始记忆完整的模型。在 TriviaQA 上，为 xRAG 提供其他问题对应段落的记忆，会将衡量输出与认可答案词语重叠的 F1 从无文档时的 19.38 提高到 24.78；但对输出包含认可答案的频率有何影响，统计上尚不确定。提供该问题检索出的段落时得分更高，为 29.88 F1。因此，相对于无文档的收益，本身不能证明收益必须依赖该问题的段落。评估必须说明对照模型、绝对表现，以及生成和评分条件。
2610.19373.mechanism_en: Zeroing is compared with independently trained no-memory/constant-memory controls and mismatched-document memory.
2610.19373.result_en: Across nine systems, memory dependence can coexist with worse absolute performance; mismatched xRAG memory raises TriviaQA F1 19.38 to 24.78.
2610.19373.boundary_en: F1 overlap gain does not establish passage-specific factual benefit; accepted-answer frequency effects remain statistically uncertain.

2610.19507.title: Structure Before Intelligence: Gating What Agentic Scientific Workflows Release
2610.19507.authors: Ashish Acharya , Aman Al Amin , Hong Qin
2610.19507.abstract_en: An agentic scientific workflow can run to completion and still release wrong results: a silent numerical error, a stale input, or a defect in a shared upstream step can contaminate several outputs while a sibling branch stays correct. We treat trust in such results as a release decision. A harness around the workflow's directed acyclic graph (DAG) decides which outputs may be used: it enforces mandatory checks, contains failures to the affected branch, recomputes from tracked versions, adds validators, and releases a result only if a risk model estimates its probability of being invalid as low. Language-model agents work inside the harness, choosing corrective actions and reviewing releases, but cannot override it. On 60 held-out paired instances of two workflows with injected faults, we switched components on and off. Each supplied a different property. Containment and recovery raised the number of correct results. Validation supplied safety: fixed rules without validation released 37 invalid results, while validating every candidate released none. Risk estimation supplied efficiency, matching that safety with 31% fewer validators at somewhat lower yield, although better targeting than random validation was not shown. Lineage evidence helped on one workflow. The language model added no measurable benefit: whether invalid results escaped depended on the harness, not the model. This proof of concept points to a practical path: placing agents inside explicit release-control structure can keep released scientific results trustworthy, and it gives more capable agents a measurable baseline to improve on.
2610.19507.abstract_zh: 一个智能体科学流程即使完整运行，也可能发布错误结果：静默数值误差、陈旧输入或上游共享步骤缺陷，可以污染多个输出，而兄弟分支仍保持正确。我们将对结果的信任视为发布决策。包围工作流有向无环图（DAG）的框架决定哪些输出可使用：执行强制检查，将失败限制在受影响分支，根据跟踪版本重新计算，增加验证器，并仅在风险模型估计结果无效概率足够低时发布。语言模型智能体在框架内部选择纠正动作和审核发布，但无法越过框架。在两个带注入故障的工作流、60 个留出配对实例上，我们逐个开关组件。每个组件提供不同性质：故障隔离和恢复增加正确结果；验证提供安全性——没有验证的固定规则发布了 37 个无效结果，而验证所有候选时一个也没有。风险估计提供效率，少使用 31% 的验证器而保持相同安全性，但产出略低，且没有证明其定位优于随机验证。来源谱系证据对其中一个工作流有帮助。语言模型没有带来可测收益：无效结果是否逃逸取决于框架，而非模型。这项概念验证指向一条实践路径：将智能体置于明确的发布控制结构中，可以保持已发布科学结果的可信性，也为更强智能体提供可测量的改进基线。
2610.19507.update_target: Release gates around scientific workflow artifacts
2610.19507.mechanism_en: Mandatory validators, lineage-aware recovery and branch containment govern release; risk estimates select checks that agents cannot override.
2610.19507.result_en: On 60 paired held-out fault cases, exhaustive validation releases no invalid output; risk estimation uses 31% fewer validators at lower yield.
2610.19507.boundary_en: No measurable LLM benefit or superiority over random validation targeting was established; this is a controlled proof of concept.

2610.19525.title: Diagnosing and Correcting Reward Hacking in Verifiable Instruction Following
2610.19525.authors: Sangyeon Yoon , Wooseok Seo , Hamish Ivison , Hyesoo Hong , Donghoon Kim , Wonjun Kang , Albert No , Jaehyung Kim
2610.19525.abstract_en: Verifiable instruction-following benchmarks emphasize output-constraint satisfaction but can overlook whether responses meaningfully answer the underlying request, creating an evaluation blind spot. We show that frontier models can receive full credit for responses with little substantive answer content. Using the same verifier-based criterion as a training reward can induce reward hacking, as publicly released checkpoints exhibit higher constraint satisfaction but lower response quality after reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. To address this reward hacking, we introduce CALIF, a lightweight method that augments verifier rewards with a calibrated likelihood-based bonus to preserve response quality. CALIF evaluates response likelihood under the request alone using the existing frozen reference policy, requiring no additional judge or learned reward model. Across models ranging from 1.7B to 8B in reasoning and non-reasoning modes, CALIF improves constraint satisfaction on IFBench while maintaining response quality near or above pre-RL levels. It also outperforms corresponding base policies in 40 of 45 model-metric comparisons across three rubric-based instruction-following benchmarks, demonstrating gains beyond training verifiers.
2610.19525.affiliation: Yonsei University / University of Washington / FuriosaAI
2610.19525.abstract_zh: 可验证指令遵循基准强调满足输出约束，却可能忽视回复是否实质回答原始请求，从而产生评估盲区。我们表明，前沿模型能够在几乎没有实质答案内容的回复上得到满分。将同一验证标准用于训练奖励可能诱发奖励投机：公开检查点显示，使用可验证奖励强化学习后，约束满足度更高，但回复质量更低。为解决这一问题，我们提出轻量方法 CALIF，在验证器奖励上增加经过校准的似然奖励，以保持回复质量。CALIF 使用现有冻结参考策略，评估仅以请求为条件的回复似然，无需额外裁判或学习奖励模型。在 1.7B 至 8B、推理和非推理模式的模型中，CALIF 提高 IFBench 约束满足度，同时将回复质量保持在强化学习前水平附近或更高。它还在三个基于评分准则的指令遵循基准、45 个模型—指标比较中的 40 个上优于对应基础策略，展示了超出训练验证器的收益。
2610.19525.mechanism_en: CALIF adds reference-policy request likelihood to verifier rewards, without a new judge, to discourage vacuous constraint satisfaction.
2610.19525.result_en: 1.7B–8B models improve IFBench constraints while preserving quality; 40 of 45 model-metric comparisons beat base policies.
2610.19525.boundary_en: Constraint scores and substantive answer quality must be separated; gains beyond training verifiers remain author-reported evaluations.

2610.19832.title: Rent-Seeking Language Models: Reward Models Set the Prices, Frequent Audits Curb the Rent
2610.19832.authors: Zixiao Wang , Xingbo Du , Duzhen Zhang , Le Song
2610.19832.abstract_en: Reward model overoptimization in RLHF is usually described as reward hacking. We recast it as rent-seeking: the policy, a firm, earns reward from a regulator, the proxy reward model, that true quality does not back. The lens turns overoptimization into measurable quantities, namely rent, a capture index and deadweight loss, and into testable predictions from the economics of regulation. In a fixed, version-controlled testbed with three model families, accuracy-matched proxy reward models and two gold reward models, RL turns 41% to 66% of its proxy gain into rent while gold reward plateaus. Rent follows each regulator's prices. Neither proxy verifies facts, but one pays for confident specifics and the other for displays of diligence, so RL policies learn to fabricate details about nonexistent entities (97% to 100% of probes) or to deflect factual questions (67% to 98%). Kinship between policy and regulator adds a fixed premium of about 0.1 standard deviations but gives the policy no extra leverage under optimization. At a fixed expected fine, frequent mild audits beat rare severe ones, and random audits are as efficient per audit as targeted ones. Bringing the bunching estimator of tax economics to RL training, we also find a first sign that policies learn to stay just below a targeted audit's threshold.
2610.19832.affiliation: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence
2610.19832.abstract_zh: RLHF 中的奖励模型过度优化通常被称为奖励投机。我们将其重新表述为寻租：策略像企业一样，从代理奖励模型这个监管者那里获取没有真实质量支撑的奖励。这个视角将过度优化转化为可测的寻租、俘获指数和无谓损失，并带来源自监管经济学的可检验预测。在固定且受版本控制的实验平台中，使用三个模型家族、准确率匹配的代理奖励模型和两个黄金奖励模型，强化学习将其代理收益的 41%—66% 转化为寻租，而黄金奖励进入平台期。寻租行为跟随各监管者的定价。两个代理都不核查事实，但一个奖励自信的细节，另一个奖励勤勉表现，因此强化学习策略学会为不存在的实体编造细节（97%—100% 的探测），或回避事实问题（67%—98%）。策略与监管者的亲缘性带来约 0.1 个标准差的固定溢价，却没有在优化中给予策略额外杠杆。在期望罚款固定时，频繁温和审计优于罕见严厉审计，随机审计的单次效率与定向审计相当。将税收经济学的聚集估计方法引入强化学习训练后，我们还发现初步迹象：策略会学习停留在定向审计阈值下方。
2610.19832.mechanism_en: Accuracy-matched proxy/gold rewards isolate unsupported reward gains; audit frequency and severity are compared at fixed expected penalties.
2610.19832.result_en: 41–66% of proxy gains become measured rent; frequent mild audits beat rare severe audits in the studied testbed.
2610.19832.boundary_en: Economic analogies organize measured quantities, not universal behavior laws; gold rewards and audit design have their own validity limits.

2610.19910.title: When Non-Adversarial Noise Hurts Learning: Benchmarking Skill Self-Evolution in Agents
2610.19910.authors: Tao Yu , Zhongtian Luo , Yuchen Long , Yiheng Lu , Yuxuan Zhou , Yanpei Gong , Siyi Cao , Yuqing Wu , Haopeng Jin , Zhenghao Zhang , Yujia Yang , Jingmin Zhu , Yunyun Hou , Xinming Wang , Hongzhu Yi , Jiachen Liu , Sirui Wang , Nan Duan , Yan Huang , Liang Wang , Tianjin Huang , Yanyan Zou
2610.19910.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly improve by distilling experience into reusable skills, but errors in that experience can persist in learned rules and affect later tasks. Existing evaluations largely examine clean learning or perturbations encountered after skills are frozen, leaving robustness during self-evolution insufficiently understood. We introduce RSE-Bench, to our knowledge the first benchmark for evaluating skill self-evolution under ordinary, non-adversarial noise. It spans four domains and six benchmarks, with controlled perturbations to instructions, environmental evidence, execution records, and outcome--record pairings that preserve the underlying tasks and native scoring rules. The protocol separates noise during learning from input-side noise at evaluation, testing frozen skill stores on held-out tasks. We also introduce \textsc{RSEClaw}, a method-agnostic framework supporting consistent noise injection and process diagnostics of actual exposure and skill updates. Across three methods and two backbones, noisy learning retains only $25.5\%$--$42.1\%$ of the aggregate gain achieved by clean self-evolution, depending on the noise type. Perturbations confined to execution records and outcome--record pairings cause average losses comparable to input-side noise, despite leaving the original executions and evaluations intact. Diagnostics further identify differences in candidate skill text that coexist with small changes in mean held-out performance.
2610.19910.affiliation: JD Future Academy / CASIA / UCAS / University of Exeter / Tsinghua University (source abbreviations)
2610.19910.abstract_zh: 大语言模型智能体越来越多地通过将经验提炼为可复用技能实现改进，但经验中的错误可能持续存在于所学规则中，并影响后续任务。现有评估主要考察干净学习，或技能冻结后遭遇的扰动，对自我进化期间鲁棒性的研究不足。我们提出 RSE-Bench，据我们所知，这是首个评估普通非对抗噪声下技能自我进化的基准。它覆盖四个领域、六个基准，对指令、环境证据、执行记录以及结果—记录配对施加受控扰动，同时保留底层任务和原生评分规则。协议将学习期间的噪声与评估时输入侧噪声分离，在留出任务上测试冻结的技能库。我们还提出与具体方法无关的 RSEClaw，支持一致噪声注入，以及对实际暴露和技能更新的过程诊断。在三种方法和两个骨干上，含噪学习只能保留干净自我进化汇总收益的 25.5%—42.1%，具体取决于噪声类型。仅限执行记录和结果—记录配对的扰动，即使不改变原执行和评估，也会造成与输入侧噪声相当的平均损失。诊断还发现，候选技能文本的差异能够与留出平均表现的小幅变化同时存在。
2610.19910.mechanism_en: Controlled noise separates learning-time corruption from evaluation-input perturbation; frozen stores are tested on held-out tasks with update diagnostics.
2610.19910.result_en: Noisy learning retains 25.5–42.1% of clean gains across three methods/two backbones; record/binding noise can be as harmful as input noise.
2610.19910.boundary_en: These percentages refer to retained aggregate gain, not task success; text changes and mean held-out changes need not align.

2610.20049.title: CoRedSkill: Stealthy Skill Composition Attacks via AST-Guided Injection
2610.20049.authors: Qichen Zhao , Shengfang Zhai , Qingni Shen , Zhonghai Wu , Jiaheng Zhang
2610.20049.abstract_en: Agents extend their capabilities through reusable skills that package instructions, executable code, and resources. Composing these skills enables complex task workflows, but their dependencies can also connect malicious operations across skills, making their combined intent difficult to identify through individual-package auditing. We introduce CoRedSkill, a compositional red-teaming method that forms stealthy attacks through cooperating skills while preserving their original utility. CoRedSkill decomposes an existing workflow into interdependent skills and embeds attack operations in task functions through abstract syntax tree (AST) rewriting, with skill instructions guiding the agent to autonomously select and invoke the relevant skills, and workflow dependencies and intermediate artifacts connecting the injected operations during task execution. We construct a benchmark of 150 cases covering 50 tasks and three attack objectives to evaluate attack success, task completion, and audit detection. In the main evaluation, CoRedSkill achieves 98.0% attack success and 95.3% task success with a 3.3% detection rate, and a joint success rate of 90.7% (attack success, task completion, and audit evasion in the same case) compared with 6.7--42.7% for the four baselines. Skill compositions can therefore complete legitimate tasks while carrying out unauthorized operations that evade auditing.
2610.20049.affiliation: Peking University / National University of Singapore
2610.20049.abstract_zh: 智能体通过打包指令、可执行代码和资源的可复用技能扩展能力。组合这些技能能够实现复杂流程，但依赖关系也可以将恶意操作跨技能连接，使逐个技能包审计难以识别联合意图。我们提出组合式红队方法 CoRedSkill，在保留原有功能效用的同时，通过协作技能形成隐蔽攻击。CoRedSkill 将现有工作流分解为相互依赖的技能，通过抽象语法树（AST）重写把攻击操作嵌入任务函数；技能指令引导智能体自主选择并调用相关技能，工作流依赖和中间产物则在执行中连接注入的操作。我们构建包含 150 个案例、覆盖 50 项任务和三类攻击目标的基准，以评估攻击成功、任务完成和审计检测。在主要评估中，CoRedSkill 达到 98.0% 攻击成功率、95.3% 任务成功率和 3.3% 检测率；在同一案例中同时满足攻击成功、任务完成和审计规避的联合成功率为 90.7%，而四个基线为 6.7%—42.7%。因此，组合技能能够在完成合法任务的同时执行逃过审计的未授权操作。
2610.20049.mechanism_en: AST-guided red-team cases connect operations across package dependencies; joint task/attack/audit outcomes test composition-level blind spots.
2610.20049.result_en: 150 cases yield 90.7% joint success versus 6.7–42.7% for compared baselines.
2610.20049.boundary_en: This is an empirical attack evaluation, not evidence that every skill composition is malicious or that benign task success establishes safety.

2610.20294.title: MMLA-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through RTT and RTMA
2610.20294.abstract_en: An agent can improve its behavior within an unresolved problem by changing how it acts and which experience it retains. We propose MMLA-RSI, a recursive self-improvement scheme with two implementations in Memory-Mediated Learning Architecture: Reasoning-Time Training (RTT) changes the policy state $\Phi$, while Reasoning-Time Memory Adaptation (RTMA) changes authoritative memory $M$. Each route also makes its adaptation method an object of improvement. A current numerical updater trains the policy proposing its successor; a current memory manager chooses the records available to the process proposing its successor. An independently admitted successor takes over the same role in the next generation. We give bounded executable rule languages, shared task/proposal interfaces, and one algorithm for either route or their composition. The RTT instance changes scalar schedules in a clipped-momentum update. The RTMA instance chooses NULL or a complete-row write with possible eviction. A fixed interpreter, trusted committer, and independent evaluator bound what can change. State versions, read closures, and conditional properties describe causal execution, accepted transitions, and finite work. Existing numerical-component studies motivate the construction. In four-candidate program selection, retaining LARC feedback updates reduces expected error by 24.65 and 36.65 percentage points for two trained initializations. In chronological continuous-integration replay, feedback binding is positive while retention increases loss. Completed SQL studies improve substantially over an unadapted substrate but do not establish the required additional online benefit. These results characterize their declared components. The two recursive routes and their joint realization are specified here; their beneficial recursive chains and discovery efficiency remain to be evaluated.
2610.20294.abstract_zh: 智能体可以在一个尚未解决的问题内部，通过改变行动方式和保留的经验来改进自身行为。我们提出 MMLA-RSI，一种在记忆介导学习架构中具有两种实现的递归自我改进方案：推理时训练（RTT）改变策略状态 $Phi$，推理时记忆适应（RTMA）改变权威记忆 $M$。每条路线还将自身的适应方法作为改进对象：当前数值更新器训练提出其继任者的策略；当前记忆管理器选择可供提出其继任者过程使用的记录。经独立准入的继任者在下一代接管相同角色。我们给出有界可执行规则语言、共享任务及提议接口，以及适用于任一路线或其组合的统一算法。RTT 实例改变截断动量更新中的标量调度；RTMA 实例选择 NULL 或一次可能伴随驱逐的完整行写入。固定解释器、可信提交器和独立评估器限定可改变的内容。状态版本、读取闭包和条件性质描述因果执行、获准转换及有限工作量。已有数值组件研究为构造提供动机。在四候选程序选择中，对两个训练后初始化，保留 LARC 反馈更新分别将期望错误降低 24.65 和 36.65 个百分点。在按时间顺序的持续集成回放中，反馈绑定有正作用，但保留增加损失。已完成的 SQL 研究相对于未适配基底有显著改善，却没有建立所要求的额外在线收益。这些结果仅刻画其声明的组件。本文给出了两条递归路线及其联合实现的规范，但有益递归链及发现效率仍有待评估。
2610.20294.update_target: Specified policy/memory updaters and their successor mechanisms
2610.20294.mechanism_en: Fixed interpreters, trusted commits and independent evaluators bound RTT/RTMA successor admission; component studies examine retention and feedback binding.
2610.20294.result_en: Some numerical components improve error, whereas CI retention raises loss; beneficial recursive chains remain unevaluated.
2610.20294.boundary_en: The recursive routes are specified, not demonstrated positive RSI. SQL adaptation does not establish the required additional online benefit.

2610.20344.title: Doc2Harness: Benchmarking LLMs on Long-Horizon Harness Engineering of Coding Agents
2610.20344.authors: Yuyao Ge , Shenghua Liu , Peizhong Gao , Chendi Ge , Chenxu Liu , Yiwei Wang , Lingrui Mei , Baolong Bi , Jiayu Yao , Jiafeng Guo , Xueqi Cheng
2610.20344.abstract_en: Agents driven by large language models are increasingly deployed on long-horizon tasks, where they use tools and modify real workspaces. How well they perform depends as much on the harness around the model as on the model itself. Existing benchmarks measure downstream task success under a fixed harness, leaving harness engineering itself unexplored. We propose Doc2Harness, a two-stage benchmark that evaluates long-horizon harness engineering directly. In Stage 1, a build model operating inside a fixed builder harness receives an interface-only contract skeleton and a development document that consolidates behavior across twelve frontier harnesses, and then constructs a complete candidate harness in an isolated container. In Stage 2, the frozen candidate harness runs in containers separate from the construction environment, one per test case, and is driven end to end by a scripted mock model. We score each test case using four observable channels, namely the requests sent to the model, the files on disk, the process exit code, and the command output; positive controls rule out vacuous passes. Across nineteen frontier models, each evaluated with three independent builds on 328 test cases, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest pass rate at 53.05%, while the weakest model reaches 27.44%, a gap of roughly twenty-six percentage points. Even the strongest model fails nearly half of the test cases, and failures cluster around how cross-cutting functionality is split across modules. To our knowledge, Doc2Harness provides the first deterministic benchmark for measuring long-horizon harness engineering.
2610.20344.affiliation: Institute of Computing Technology, CAS / Tsinghua University / Peking University / Southeast University
2610.20344.abstract_zh: 大语言模型驱动的智能体越来越多地被部署到长时程任务中，使用工具并修改真实工作区。其表现既取决于模型，也同样取决于外围运行框架。现有基准在固定框架下测量下游任务成功，却没有直接研究框架工程本身。我们提出直接评估长时程框架工程的两阶段基准 Doc2Harness。第一阶段，构建模型在固定构建框架内，接收仅含接口的契约骨架，以及汇总十二个前沿框架行为的开发文档，随后在隔离容器中构建完整候选框架。第二阶段，冻结的候选框架在与构建环境分离的容器中运行，每个测试案例一个容器，由脚本化模拟模型端到端驱动。每项测试按四种可观察通道评分：发给模型的请求、磁盘文件、进程退出码和命令输出；阳性对照排除空洞通过。十九个前沿模型各进行三次独立构建、接受 328 项测试，GPT-6 Astra 的通过率最高为 53.05%，最弱模型为 27.44%，相差约 26 个百分点。即使最强模型也接近一半测试失败，且失败集中在跨模块功能如何拆分。据我们所知，Doc2Harness 提供了首个测量长时程框架工程的确定性基准。
2610.20344.mechanism_en: Builder-generated harnesses are frozen, isolated and driven by a scripted model; four observable channels and positive controls test runtime contracts.
2610.20344.result_en: Nineteen models with three builds each face 328 tests; best/worst pass rates are 53.05%/27.44%.
2610.20344.boundary_en: The benchmark tests constructing harnesses, not whether those harnesses later improve themselves or solve open-ended tasks better.

2610.20442.title: Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness
2610.20442.authors: Chonghan Qin , Dongming Wu , Kaituo Feng , Jiaxu Wang , Xinlei Yu , Peiwen Sun , Yijia Fan , Xilin He , Bingao Chen , Weitong Lian , Ryan Ji , Wenqi Ren , Xiaobin Hu , Dahua Lin , Yu-Gang Jiang , Xiangyu Yue
2610.20442.abstract_en: Foundation models are driving a paradigm shift in robotic intelligence, moving beyond low-level action prediction to goal-directed orchestration of data collection, model training, task planning, and real-world execution. We characterize this emerging paradigm as an agentic robots, in which agents reason over human instructions, interact with robotic environments, rectify execution errors autonomously, and dynamically adjust operational strategies. Although this field develops fast, current studies are not well connected. Researchers have no consistent view of how to combine different agentic functions into a complete robot system. This paper provides a unified overview of existing research on agentic robots. We first trace the development from robot policies to agentic systems, covering vision-language-action models, world models, and world-action models. We then clarify the definition and scope of agentic robots and organize existing research into seventeen categories across four functional domains: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness. Across these domains, we examine how agents shape model learning and robot decisions, collect and curate robot data, construct worlds, tasks, and tests for learning and evaluation, and organize capabilities for robot use. Finally, we discuss open challenges and outline directions for future research. Looking forward, we hope this work contributes to a clearer understanding of agentic robots and supports new approaches to making them more capable, reliable, and adaptive.
2610.20442.affiliation: Chinese University of Hong Kong / Fudan University / NovaXBot / Tsinghua University / Zhejiang University / Sun Yat-sen University
2610.20442.abstract_zh: 基础模型正在推动机器人智能的范式变化，从低层动作预测走向对数据收集、模型训练、任务规划和真实世界执行的目标导向编排。我们将这一新兴范式描述为智能体机器人：智能体围绕人类指令推理，与机器人环境交互，自主修正执行错误，并动态调整操作策略。尽管领域发展迅速，目前研究之间联系仍不充分，研究者尚缺少将不同智能体功能组合成完整机器人系统的一致视图。本文统一梳理现有智能体机器人研究。我们首先追溯从机器人策略到智能体系统的发展，覆盖视觉语言动作模型、世界模型和世界动作模型；随后明确智能体机器人的定义及范围，将既有研究分为模型、数据、环境和运行框架四个功能域下的十七个类别。在这些功能域中，我们考察智能体如何塑造模型学习和机器人决策、收集与筛选机器人数据、为学习和评估构建世界、任务与测试，以及组织可供机器人使用的能力。最后讨论开放挑战并勾勒未来方向。展望未来，我们希望这项工作有助于更清晰地理解智能体机器人，并支持构建能力更强、更可靠、更具适应性的机器人。
2610.20442.mechanism_en: Seventeen categories across Model, Data, Environment and Harness organize how agents support learning, data curation and robot execution.
2610.20442.result_en: The contribution is a unified overview and research directions across robotic agent functions.
2610.20442.boundary_en: A survey taxonomy is not empirical evidence that all surveyed robots recursively improve or that physical RSI is established.
